Hong Kong honours six outstanding public toilet attendants | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong honours six outstanding public toilet attendants
Hong Kong's Food and Hygiene Department has named three male and three female outstanding public toilet attendants for 2026. The department is using smart technology, including IoT sensors and fall-detection systems, to improve cleanliness and safety, while stressing a people-first approach.
The Hong Kong Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) has selected six outstanding public toilet attendants for 2026, recognising three men and three women who serve facilities across the city. The award aims to highlight the importance of high-quality public sanitation in maintaining the city's image as a global financial hub.
Deputy Secretary for Food and Hygiene Yuen Yuk-kin said: “As an international financial centre, Hong Kong needs efficient urban life. A city's quality depends not only on major infrastructure but also on whether public services are meticulous and considerate. Public toilets are a very routine yet extremely important service. Clean, comfortable toilets directly affect residents' quality of life and, for visitors, are a window into the city's management standards. Good toilet service not only improves the city's image but also meets the actual needs of every user.”
The award-winning attendants serve at public toilets in Aberdeen (Southern District), Hoi Hing Road (Tsuen Wan), New Hung Hom Ferry Pier (Kowloon City), Warren Street (Wan Chai), Ma Wan (Kwun Tong), and Ma Liu Shui Waterfront (Sha Tin). FEHD has been upgrading facilities through a multi-pronged renovation plan, expanding smart-toilet systems to 50 toilets with IoT sensors for real-time odour monitoring, and installing fall-detection systems in about 40 toilets. It has also added nano-bubble ozone systems for enhanced disinfection and deodorisation in high-use facilities, and uses ATP bioluminescence testing to objectively assess surface hygiene.
Yuen encouraged the awardees, noting that facility upgrades and technology are only aids. “Providing quality service is always people-first. With heavy usage, maintaining cleanliness requires not only hard work but also careful observation, timely problem-solving, and a commitment to high standards. Their work is demanding, and their professionalism deserves respect,” he said.
FEHD is also splitting toilet management from street-cleaning contracts, introducing specialised contracts in more districts to boost competition and efficiency. New contracts require attendants to undergo professional training and obtain recognised qualifications; more than 1,800 trainees have completed the programme. A small-works order recording system has also improved maintenance efficiency.
In 2026, FEHD's cross-department team won the Ombudsman's Merit Award (Team Award) for the project “Using innovative technology and optimising inspection systems to improve public toilet service quality.” A department spokesman said: “FEHD will continue its people-first, technology-enabled approach to renovate toilets and implement smart management. Keeping toilets clean in the long term also requires public cooperation. We call on citizens and visitors to treasure the facilities and cooperate with frontline staff to maintain public hygiene.”

title: 接近黄仁勋的女间谍由中国国安部招募
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: JULIAN E. BARNES, TRIPP MICKLE, 孟建国, MAGGIE HABERMAN2026年11月9日 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋是特朗普总统颇具影响力的盟友，也是全球围绕人工智能主导地位的激烈竞争中的关键人物。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times 据听取过相关情报简报的人士透露，今年春天，一份在特朗普政府高级决策官员之间传阅的备忘录援引情报称，一名与英伟达首席执行官关系密切的中国女商人是中国国家安全部的间谍。 知情
content:
JULIAN E. BARNES, TRIPP MICKLE, 孟建国, MAGGIE HABERMAN2026年11月9日
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋是特朗普总统颇具影响力的盟友，也是全球围绕人工智能主导地位的激烈竞争中的关键人物。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times
据听取过相关情报简报的人士透露，今年春天，一份在特朗普政府高级决策官员之间传阅的备忘录援引情报称，一名与英伟达首席执行官关系密切的中国女商人是中国国家安全部的间谍。
知情人士称，这名女商人叫黄乐(Alice Huang)，她被招募来搜集英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的情报。此举是中国最高情报机构的一项行动，目的是进一步了解美国的人工智能芯片，并谋求影响英伟达，促使该公司推动向中国出售其最先进的芯片。
黄仁勋是特朗普总统有影响力的盟友，也是全球关于人工智能主导地位的激烈竞争的关键人物。英伟达的先进芯片在世界各地大受欢迎，公司的增长也成为过去几年推动股市上涨的重要力量。
这份备忘录的存在以及美国官员认定黄乐直接为中国主要情报机构工作的结论此前均未见报道。这些新披露的信息为中国长期以来从事工业间谍活动的一个尤为大胆的案例提供了重要的新细节。
中国为何对黄仁勋感兴趣、北京希望通过让一名情报人员与他建立密切关系达到什么目的一直是美国情报机构关注的重点。这些问题现在也引起了国会的兴趣。周四，众议院三个重要委员会的共和党领导人要求黄仁勋在本月晚些时候出席一场闭门简报会，就他与黄乐的往来情况给出说明。
2024年6月，黄仁勋与Megaspeed高管黄乐及其他科技企业高管在台北参加一场行业聚会。照片由NetThunder公司发布在领英上。
《纽约时报》上周报道，黄仁勋是中国一项情报行动的目标，美国情报机构已对身为中国公民的黄乐实施了至少一年的电子监控。《纽约时报》还报道，特朗普去年曾听取有关黄仁勋与黄乐关系的简报，但决定不采取任何行动。
见过黄乐的人说，她英语流利，与人工智能芯片行业的最高层保持着联系，包括黄仁勋和技嘉科技(Gigabyte)的领导人，技嘉科技是英伟达超级计算机的主要组装商之一。黄乐曾出席行业会议和高管私人晚宴。
目前不清楚黄乐第一次见到英伟达领导人是什么时候。2024年，两人在台北一家酒吧合影前后，她的公司Megaspeed开始采购价值数十亿美元的先进人工智能微芯片。
在许多业内人士看来，Megaspeed手握雄厚资金突然大举进军人工智能领域令人颇感意外。
黄乐与一个集中在上海和浙江省的企业及投资者网络存在联系。这个网络利用与上海地方官员的关系，积极推动业务从手机游戏向数据中心扩张。数据中心提供人工智能运行所需的算力。
Megaspeed一直在东南亚建设数据中心，然后将算力出租给中国互联网巨头阿里巴巴，使中国得以通过一条间接渠道使用英伟达的先进芯片。美国限制英伟达直接向中国销售这些芯片。
除了地方关系，这个企业网络还通过投资中国电子科技集团旗下的一家网络安全子公司与中国军工体系存在财务联系。中国电子科技集团是中国最大的军事技术制造商之一。
去年在华盛顿举行的一场英伟达大会展览活动上，人们参观计算技术展示。 Eric Lee for The New York Times
中国政府已制定目标，要在2030年前超越美国，成为全球人工智能技术的领导者。中国政府内部负责国家安全的部门日益重视人工智能，其中就包括招募黄乐的情报机构。
中国国家安全部曾经是一个不起眼的边缘部门。但习近平2012年成为中国领导人后开始加大对该机构的投入。如今，国安部的规模已是美国中央情报局的数倍，既搜集人力情报，也截获电子通信信息，同时还开展反间谍行动。
曾任美国中央情报局反间谍分析师的彼得·马蒂斯表示，中国的情报机构已将技术列为工作重点，认为技术是“争夺全球经济主导地位的关键战场”。
“他们关注科技领域正在发生的变化、正在开发的技术有哪些具体规格，以及如何影响与这些技术相关的决策，”现任国家安全智库詹姆斯敦基金会主席的马蒂斯说。“黄仁勋正是他们希望施加影响的人，因为他拥有巨大的影响力，而且身处一项足以改变世界的技术的关键位置。”
英伟达发言人约翰·里佐表示，公司不会与客户分享机密信息，客户也不会要求英伟达向美国政府施压，改变对华芯片销售政策。
他还说，中国政府“一直在中国推广包括华为在内的本土替代产品，并严格限制进口我们的数据中心产品”。
里佐一直坚称，黄仁勋与黄乐的往来“并无异常”，与他同英伟达众多客户举行的其他会面没有区别。
中国驻美国大使馆发言人刘畅表示，《纽约时报》的报道“毫无根据”，“纯属对中国的污蔑”。记者近日多次尝试联系黄乐请其置评，但均未得到回应。里佐此前表示，黄仁勋与黄乐的往来“并无异常”，而且黄仁勋每年都会与数千名同英伟达有业务往来的高管交谈。
过去几年里，黄仁勋始终坚定主张美国政府应允许芯片制造商向中国销售人工智能技术。他认为，这样做可以为中国科技巨头华为制造竞争，从而减缓其人工智能技术的发展。
今年9月，黄仁勋与特朗普总统在白宫出席一场人工智能主题午宴。 Doug Mills/The New York Times
2025年，他说服特朗普撤销对华销售人工智能芯片的禁令，允许英伟达向中国出售一款性能较低的芯片。后来，他又与特朗普达成协议，允许公司向中国销售其性能第二强的芯片，美国政府则从销售额中抽取25%。此后，特朗普还考虑过允许英伟达向中国出售其最新的Blackwell芯片，但最终放弃了这一想法。
今年5月，黄仁勋在一场投资者会议上表示，中国不应获得英伟达最先进的技术，例如Blackwell芯片或即将推出的Rubin芯片。他说，美国应该“最先拿到、拿到最多、拿到最好的技术，但与此同时，所有美国公司都应该参与全球竞争”。
中国国家安全部成立于1983年，一直以来未能赢得国家领导层的信任。多年来，中国人民解放军的间谍和网络黑客部门一直被视为北京主要的情报搜集力量。
据研究人员和美国官员称，2015年北京与华盛顿达成限制网络行动的协议后，国家安全部承担了更多中国的间谍活动。此后数年，美国司法部指控与国家安全部有关联的黑客试图窃取美国技术，并渗透美国的网络。
到2023年，国家安全部已发展成为美国中央情报局的竞争对手，并开始利用人工智能筛选情报目标、建立目标画像。该机构通过大规模招募扩大了间谍网络，还利用增加的预算，协助习近平实现挑战美国主导地位的雄心。
国家安全部还利用与多家中国公司的关系来扩展其在网络黑客、间谍活动和信息行动方面的工作。据估计，该机构拥有数十万名特工，远远超过美国反间谍人员的数量。
国家安全部在很大程度上仍继续在幕后运作，但在现任部长陈一新的领导下，它在中国社会生活中也扮演了更加公开的角色。2023年，该机构开设了一个微信公众号，主要用于国内宣传，并鼓励中国公民举报疑似外国间谍的人员。该公众号还被用来攻击美国，称其抱有所谓的冷战思维。
陈一新非常熟悉黄乐从事商业活动的华东地区。他是浙江人，在漫长的职业生涯中，大部分时间都在为该省的中共党组织工作。习近平在2000年代初主政浙江期间，陈一新曾在其手下任职。政治分析人士称两人关系密切。
陈一新一直直言不讳地谈论人工智能对中国共产党构成的风险。在9月发表于官方杂志《中国网信》的一篇文章中，他说中国需要加强对人工智能的控制，以维护国内政治稳定、防范日益复杂的网络攻击，并在军事领域与美国竞争。他表示，算法将帮助各国“赢得战场主动权”。

title: 英伟达先进芯片流向中国“空壳”公司
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览

content:
ANA SWANSON, KALLEY HUANG, KEITH BRADSHER2026年11月9日
北京的一处高科技企业工业园区。新矩阵公司将该建筑列为其地址，但园区公司名录中并未收录该企业。 The New York Times
在北京西北郊一个最近建成的工业园区里，一家名为新矩阵的公司登记地址空无一人，那是一个空荡荡的灰色房间，天花板上本该装灯的地方垂着电线。
今年早些时候，特朗普政府批准这家中国公司组装英伟达的先进芯片，用于创建人工智能的计算机。特朗普去年年底允许向中国出售这种名为H200的芯片。但在芯片出售之前，美国商务部必须对相关企业进行审查，以评估其是否存在国家安全风险。
新矩阵通过了这项审查。然而，《纽约时报》近期的核查发现，在中国国内，几乎没有证据表明这家公司真实存在，这引发了关于究竟是谁在幕后掌控这家公司的疑问。
关于这家17个月前成立的公司，网上只能找到极少信息。在新矩阵登记地址所在的大楼里，公司名录中没有这家公司。在附近工业园区的物业管理处，一名接待员和一名经理都说没有该公司的记录。
根据中国企业登记记录，新矩阵的所有者与一家知名中国私募股权基金有关联，该基金已于2024年被美国政府列入贸易黑名单。两名审查了公司记录和其他中文信息的分析师表示，他们认为新矩阵可能是与该基金有关公司的幌子。
芯片流向新矩阵似乎是令政府内外技术专家担忧的一种模式的一部分：美国商务部正在批准某些中国公司购买和处理英伟达芯片，而这些公司与此前被列入国家安全相关贸易限制的中国企业有关联。
英伟达的芯片是人工智能数据中心的关键技术，如今也是世界上最抢手的商品之一。它们也是美中经济与地缘政治竞争的核心。
公司记录显示，其他几家获准购买H200芯片或将其组装成服务器的中国公司与被美国政府列入黑名单的公司有关联，或者在中国担任军事承包商运营。
曾在特朗普和拜登政府时期担任白宫国家安全委员会中国事务主任的莉莎·托宾说，这些批准引发了疑问：特朗普政府在监管谁能获得英伟达芯片方面究竟有多严格。
“我有很多担忧，商务部和英伟达都没有进行必要的尽职调查，以确保许可条款得到遵守，”她说。
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋，该公司的芯片是人工智能数据中心的关键技术，如今已成为全球最抢手的商品之一。 Eric Lee for The New York Times
在拜登政府时期，美国开始更广泛地限制向中国出售人工智能芯片，担心该技术会帮助中国推进军事发展。但特朗普在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的游说下放松了部分限制，他在第二任期内与黄仁勋的关系日益密切。
去年12月，特朗普允许英伟达向中国出售H200——一款较旧但仍性能强大的人工智能芯片，条件是美国政府从销售中抽成。
在一项不同寻常的安排中，特朗普要求这些在台湾组装的芯片在运往中国途中经过美国，以便政府对其价值征收25%的关税。
英伟达目前只向中国出售少量H200芯片。中国政府一直缓慢批准本国公司购买，部分原因是它试图推广国产芯片。
尽管中国是人工智能技术的潜在巨大市场，但直接对华销售目前仅占英伟达收入的很小比例。在截至7月的财季中，向位于中国的客户交付H200的出货量不到英伟达数据中心收入的1%。公司还在8月表示，在对本财季度数据中心营收的预估中，并未将对华销售额纳入考量。
但许多中国企业正通过东南亚的数据中心获得英伟达芯片，而这些芯片似乎仍是北京关注的焦点。《纽约时报》上个月报道，英伟达的黄仁勋与一名女性关系密切，美国间谍机构认定她是中国的情报人员。她所在的公司Megaspeed在东南亚运营数据中心，为中国客户服务，并因涉嫌将一些芯片走私到中国而受到调查。周日，英伟达表示，在黄仁勋向公司董事会承认他与该女性有亲密关系后，公司正在调查黄仁勋与她的关系。
《纽约时报》记者走访时发现，获特朗普政府批准将英伟达的先进芯片组装成人工智能计算机的新矩阵公司登记地址处空无一人。 The New York Times
根据中国公司信息网站企查查，今年美国商务部对新矩阵给与批准之时，该公司的注册地址在北京郊区一个用于公司注册的园区，该园区还有数千家其他公司于名义上在此注册。但今年秋天，新矩阵的地址变更为《纽约时报》探访的工业园区那间空办公室。
截至11月6日，新矩阵的网站没有列出任何员工姓名，没有布任何招聘信息，也没有包含关于其历史的信息。但根据数据平台WireScreen，其两名主要所有者出现在一家受制裁的中国私募股权公司及其创始人的关联企业记录中，该创始人名为李斌。
2024年，美国政府将这家名为智路资本的私募股权公司列入商务部的“实体清单”，限制其与美国做生意。商务部称，智路资本曾协助中国政府收购拥有芯片技术的战略敏感企业。
李斌同时还担任清华紫光集团董事长，这是一家国有的科技集团。2021年，清华紫光的一家子公司新华三半导体技术有限公司因与中国军方合作而被列入实体清单。
新矩阵是第二家获准处理英伟达H200芯片、但其登记地址处似乎没有任何实体办公场所的中国公司。
今年9月，时报一名记者前往Maginfra的注册地址，那里看起来空无一人。 The New York Times
《纽约时报》于9月报道称，另一家名为Maginfra的中国新成立公司也获得了H200芯片的出口许可。与New Matrix类似，Maginfra 获批的身份似乎并非这批芯片的最终买家，而是一家为其他客户将芯片组装进人工智能服务器的代工企业。
但时报记者9月前往Maginfra在中国的注册地址时，发现那里也空无一人。一间上了锁的小房间里摆放着几把椅子和几张空桌子，没有任何标识。该楼层的员工表示从未见过有人使用过这间办公室，大楼的前台接待人员则表示从未听说过Maginfra这家公司。
分析人士认为，Maginfra是浪潮集团(Inspur)的子公司，而浪潮集团的总部就在Maginfra的注册地址附近。美国政府已将浪潮集团列入实体清单，理由是其与中国军方有业务往来。Maginfra和浪潮集团共享人员和专利，且两家公司均有国资背景。
据熟悉审判情况的人士和《纽约时报》看到的文件，其他获准购买英伟达H200芯片许可证的中国公司也通过其公司所有者与军事供应商存在关联。
其中一家名为浙江银盾云科技的公司与云计算巨头润泽智算科技集团有关联，润泽智算曾向军事承包商出售服务。银盾部分业务在润泽拥有的数据中心运营，其几名高管是润泽创始人的家庭成员。
润泽是河北省国防部门运营的一个卫星项目的云计算提供商，该公司在其网站上称该项目服务于“国防发展”的战略需求。它还在2016年成立了一家子公司，专注于为中国政府和军方提供量子通信。该子公司部分股权由一家公司拥有，美国因该公司为中国军队采购美国物品，已于2021年将其列入实体清单。
另一家获准购买H200芯片的公司上海嘉唐源自一家名为大唐电信的国有企业。大唐电信是一家向中国军方提供技术的芯片制造商。大唐由中国电信科学技术研究院控制，这是一家为中国军方开发密码技术的国有企业。
上海嘉唐、银盾云科技和Maginfra没有回应置评请求。

title: 黄仁勋承认出轨，英伟达调查其与疑似中国间谍的关系
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览

content:
TRIPP MICKLE, MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, ANA SWANSON2026年11月9日
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋是人工智能革命中最有影响力的人物之一，也是特朗普总统颇具影响力的盟友。 Demetrius Freeman for The New York Times
英伟达周日表示，已对公司首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋展开调查。此前，黄仁勋向公司董事会承认，他曾与一名企业高管发生亲密关系，而美国情报部门认定，该女子是中国间谍。
这名女子名叫黄乐(音，其英文名为Alice Huang)。美国政府的监控发现，她一直直接向北京提供情报，此后，黄仁勋与她的关系引起了美国政府的关注。这一发现引发了令人不安的种种可能性，因为黄仁勋不仅是人工智能革命中最有影响力的人物之一，也是特朗普总统的重要盟友。
黄仁勋在给公司的情况说明中道歉说：“我对妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”
英伟达董事会表示，“没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达的商业机密受到了损害”，但“董事会的调查将审查所有可获得的信息”。董事会表示，黄仁勋“完全支持此次审查，并承诺予以配合”。董事会没有透露调查的更多细节，也没有说明调查将持续多长时间。
董事会表示，63岁的黄仁勋将在调查期间继续领导公司。作为联合创始人，他在英伟达建立了一套独特的管理架构，掌控公司业务的方方面面，并直接管理约60名向他汇报的员工。
“今天的新闻不会拖慢英伟达的步伐，”公司发言人约翰·里佐说。“黄仁勋将继续不受干扰地履行首席执行官职责，领导英伟达。”
《纽约时报》上个月报道，美国情报机构发现，黄仁勋与一名中国公民建立了密切关系。此人从事芯片采购业务，美国官员认定她正在为北京搜集情报。
这名芯片采购商就是黄乐。据她的个人履历介绍，她曾在中国担任电视记者，之后成为一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心公司的高管。这家公司后来成为英伟达在东南亚最大的客户之一，自2024年6月以来购买了价值超过48亿美元的芯片。
这家公司名为Megaspeed。去年，《纽约时报》曾报道，美国商务部正在调查Megaspeed是否协助中国走私受到出口限制的人工智能芯片，但英伟达此后仍继续与该公司开展业务。
英伟达和黄仁勋最初坚称，他与黄乐的关系没有任何问题，也没有任何不寻常之处。上个月接受彭博新闻社采访时，黄仁勋表示，他与黄乐的往来“都与Megaspeed有关，完全正常，没有什么特别之处”。
这段关系和婚外情对黄仁勋来说是罕见的一次行差踏错。
过去三年里，黄仁勋可谓顺风顺水。他领导的芯片公司生产用于构建人工智能系统的关键技术，发展为全球市值最高的企业之一，也成为推动美国经济的数据中心建设热潮的核心力量。特朗普与他结为盟友，还邀请他乘坐“空军一号”总统专机。每逢出席活动，会有大批人群追着他索要签名。他每天穿着的黑色皮夹克也成了收藏者追捧的物品。
随着业务蓬勃发展，黄仁勋也让家人进入了公司的核心业务领域。他的儿子斯宾塞担任产品管理总监，在公司的机器人业务中发挥主导作用。女儿麦迪逊是产品营销高级总监，同样参与机器人业务，并负责公司的传播和营销工作。他的女婿尼科·卡普雷斯则在公司的业务拓展团队任职。
黄仁勋曾表示，自己创业成功离不开妻子洛丽的支持。两人于1985年结婚，最初相识时，黄仁勋还是俄勒冈州立大学一名十几岁的工程系学生。当时，在一个有250人的工程实验室里只有三名女生，洛丽就是其中之一。高中曾跳过两级的黄仁勋设法与她分到同一个实验小组，并试图用自己的聪明才智打动她。
“我知道我看起来像个孩子，所以她对我的第一印象是我很聪明，”2024年，黄仁勋在在香港科技大学谈起自己职业生涯时说。“我走到她面前说：‘你想看我的作业吗？’然后我向她承诺：‘如果你每周日都和我一起做作业，我保证，你肯定全拿A。’”
黄仁勋还向她承诺，到30岁时他会成为一家公司的首席执行官。1993年，他刚满30岁不久便联合创立了英伟达，兑现了这个承诺。
黄仁勋在播客“我是如何打造这一切的”中说：“洛丽照顾一切事情，我不记得她曾抱怨过一次。这是她送给我的礼物。”
美国政府一直在调查Megaspeed是否可能将英伟达先进人工智能芯片转运到中国，一年多前开始对黄乐进行监视。在监视过程中，他们发现她与一名被确认为黄仁勋的美国公民有通信。
看过该情报的官员说，他们确信两人之间存在恋爱关系。这削弱了英伟达过去一年向《纽约时报》和其他方面就黄仁勋与黄乐关系性质所作的最初误导性声明。
大约一年前，特朗普被告知美国情报界一直在对黄乐进行电子监视。
今年春天，国务卿鲁比奥监督起草了一份高度机密备忘录，详细说明情报显示黄乐被中国国家安全部招募来针对黄仁勋。该备忘录在今年早些时候总统访华前不久被传阅。
随着美国监视黄乐的新闻曝光，黄仁勋的回旋余地几乎消失。国会希望他作证——很可能是宣誓作证——而有关监视的报道让人更加相信，美国情报部门可能已经知晓他与黄乐关系的性质。
英伟达董事会也面临压力。上个月，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员、负责监督海外芯片销售的参议院银行委员会资深成员伊丽莎白·沃伦在社交媒体帖子中说，黄仁勋和公司董事会“有义务向国会解释”他与这名间谍之间的关系。
Megaspeed成立于2023年，当时一家中国网络游戏公司将其新加坡子公司剥离出来。不久之前，美国政府首次发布对华出售人工智能芯片的广泛禁令。公司成立时，黄乐被列为Megaspeed的董事总经理，后来她自称该公司首席执行官。
中国互联网上基本没有黄乐的背景信息，但根据一份网上简历，她曾在几家中国大型银行工作。根据WireScreen和Sayari平台汇编的公司和贸易记录，以及华盛顿非营利组织高级国防研究中心的分析，她随后加入了一家总部位于上海的基金，该基金与富有投资者和在中国有数据中心项目的科技公司有联系。
该网络中的公司帮助在上海郊外建设了一个大型数据中心，服务于中国公司腾讯。它还通过对中国电子科技集团一家网络安全子公司的投资，与中国军工体系产生了财务联系；中国电子科技集团是中国最大的军事技术制造商之一。
随着Megaspeed的芯片采购不断到来，黄仁勋和黄乐开始共处。2024年6月，在台北一场当地科技贸易展结束后，二人在台北一家酒吧见面。他们与其他人工智能高管一起喝威士忌。一年后，他们与其他高管在台北一家餐厅用餐。台湾媒体拍到她亲吻他的脸颊，以及他接受记者采访时她站在他身后的画面。
他们的关系成为华盛顿的关注焦点，此前官员们已经对Megaspeed的大量采购感到警觉。
“这是CCP惯用伎俩的典型手段——也是它为何永远不可信任的又一例证，” 得克萨斯州共和党众议员、众议院国土安全委员会副主席迈克尔·麦考尔在社交媒体上写道，他指的是中国共产党。“美国应立即暂停向中国出口先进的人工智能芯片，直到我们查明此事的真相，并确保我们的国家安全不受损害。”

Applicable November 4, 2026.
Kayden Jenson, Office II, AD/CVD Operations, Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, 1401 Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20230; telephone: (202) 482-0967.
On October 15, 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) received a countervailing duty (CVD) petition concerning imports of seamless carbon and alloy steel standard, line, and pressure pipe (seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe) from India, filed in proper form on behalf of Tenaris USA (Tenaris), Vallourec Star LP (Vallourec), and the United Steel, Paper and Forestry, Rubber, Manufacturing, Energy, Allied Industrial and Service Workers International Union, AFL-CIO, CLC (USW) (collectively, the petitioners), domestic producers of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe and a certified union, which represents workers engaged in the production of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe in the United States.[1] The CVD Petition was accompanied by antidumping duty (AD) petitions concerning imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from Georgia and India.[2]
Between October 20 and 26, 2026, Commerce requested supplemental information pertaining to certain aspects of the Petition in supplemental questionnaires.[3] Between October 22 and 28, 2026, the petitioners filed timely responses to these requests for additional information.[4]
In accordance with section 702(b)(1) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (the Act), the petitioners allege that the Government of India (GOI) is providing countervailable subsidies, within the meaning of sections 701 and 771(5) of the Act, to producers of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India, and that such imports are materially injuring, or threatening material injury to, the domestic industry producing seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe in the United States. Consistent with section 702(b)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.202(b), for those alleged programs on which we are initiating a CVD investigation, the Petition was accompanied by information reasonably available to the petitioners supporting their allegations.
Commerce finds that the petitioners filed the Petition on behalf of the domestic industry, because the petitioners are interested parties, as defined in sections 771(9)(C) and (D) of the Act.[5] Commerce also finds that the petitioners demonstrated sufficient industry support with respect to the initiation of the requested CVD investigation.[6]
Because the Petition was filed on October 15, 2026, the POI is January 1, 2025, through December 31, 2025.[7]
The product covered by this investigation is seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India. For a full description of the scope of this investigation, see the appendix to this notice.
Comments on the Scope of the Investigation
On October 20 and 26, 2026, Commerce requested information and clarification from the petitioners regarding the proposed scope to ensure that the scope language in the Petition is an accurate reflection of the products for which the domestic industry is seeking relief.[8] On October 22 and 28, 2026, the petitioners provided clarifications and revised the scope.[9] The description of merchandise covered by this investigation, as described in the appendix to this notice, reflects these clarifications.
As discussed in the Preamble to Commerce's regulations, we are setting ( printed page 70848) aside a period for interested parties to raise issues regarding product coverage ( i.e., scope).[10] Commerce will consider all scope comments received from interested parties and, if necessary, will consult with interested parties prior to the issuance of the preliminary determination. If scope comments include factual information, all such factual information should be limited to public information.[11] Commerce requests that interested parties provide at the beginning of their scope comments a public executive summary for each comment or issue raised in their submission. Commerce further requests that interested parties limit their public executive summary of each comment or issue to no more than 450 words, not including citations. Commerce intends to use the public executive summaries as the basis of the comment summaries included in the analysis of scope comments. To facilitate preparation of its questionnaires, Commerce requests that scope comments be submitted by 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) on November 24, 2026, which is 20 calendar days from the signature date of this notice. Any rebuttal comments, which may include factual information, and should also be limited to public information, must be filed by 5:00 p.m. ET on December 4, 2026, which is 10 calendar days from the initial comment deadline.
Commerce requests that any factual information that parties consider relevant to the scope of this investigation be submitted during that period. However, if a party subsequently finds that additional factual information pertaining to the scope of the investigation may be relevant, the party must contact Commerce and request permission to submit the additional information. All scope comments must be filed simultaneously on the records of the concurrent AD and CVD investigations.
All submissions to Commerce must be filed electronically via Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS), unless an exception applies.[12] An electronically filed document must be received successfully in its entirety by the time and date it is due.
Pursuant to sections 702(b)(4)(A)(i) and (ii) of the Act, Commerce notified the GOI of the receipt of the Petition and provided an opportunity for consultations with respect to the Petition.[13] Commerce held consultations with the GOI on November 3, 2026.[14]
Determination of Industry Support for the Petition
Section 702(b)(1) of the Act requires that a petition be filed on behalf of the domestic industry. Section 702(c)(4)(A) of the Act provides that a petition meets this requirement if the domestic producers or workers who support the petition account for: (i) at least 25 percent of the total production of the domestic like product; and (ii) more than 50 percent of the production of the domestic like product produced by that portion of the industry expressing support for, or opposition to, the petition. Moreover, section 702(c)(4)(D) of the Act provides that, if the petition does not establish support of domestic producers or workers accounting for more than 50 percent of the total production of the domestic like product, Commerce shall: (i) poll the industry or rely on other information in order to determine if there is support for the petition, as required by subparagraph (A); or (ii) determine industry support using a statistically valid sampling method to poll the “industry.”
Section 771(4)(A) of the Act defines the “industry” as the producers as a whole of a domestic like product. Thus, to determine whether a petition has the requisite industry support, the statute directs Commerce to look to producers and workers who produce the domestic like product. The U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC), which is responsible for determining whether “the domestic industry” has been injured, must also determine what constitutes a domestic like product in order to define the industry. While both Commerce and the ITC apply the same statutory definition regarding the domestic like product,[15] they do so for different purposes and pursuant to a separate and distinct authority. In addition, Commerce's determination is subject to limitations of time and information. Although this may result in different definitions of the like product, such differences do not render the decision of either agency contrary to law.[16]
Section 771(10) of the Act defines the domestic like product as “a product which is like, or in the absence of like, most similar in characteristics and uses with, the article subject to an investigation under this title.” Thus, the reference point from which the domestic like product analysis begins is “the article subject to an investigation” ( i.e., the class or kind of merchandise to be investigated, which normally will be the scope as defined in the petition).
With regard to the domestic like product, the petitioners do not offer a definition of the domestic like product distinct from the scope of the investigation.[17] Based on our analysis of the information submitted on the record, we have determined that seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe, as defined in the scope, constitutes a single domestic like product, and we have analyzed industry support in terms of that domestic like product.[18]
In determining whether the petitioners have standing under section 702(c)(4)(A) of the Act, we considered the industry support data contained in the Petition with reference to the domestic like product as defined in the “Scope of the Investigation,” in the appendix to this notice. To establish industry support, the petitioners provided the 2025 shipments of the domestic like product for the U.S. producers that support the Petitions, and compared this to the estimated total 2025 shipments of the domestic like ( printed page 70849) product for the entire domestic industry.[19] Because total production data for the domestic like product for 2025 are not reasonably available to the petitioners, and the petitioners have established that shipments are a reasonable proxy for production data,[20] we relied on data provided by the petitioners for purposes of measuring industry support.[21]
Our review of the data provided in the Petition, the First General Issues Supplement, and other information readily available to Commerce indicates that the petitioners have established industry support for the Petition.[22] First, the Petition established support from domestic producers and supporters accounting for more than 50 percent of the total production of the domestic like product and, as such, Commerce is not required to take further action in order to evaluate industry support ( e.g., polling).[23] Second, the domestic producers and supporters have met the statutory criteria for industry support under section 702(c)(4)(A)(i) of the Act because the domestic producers and supporters who support the Petition account for at least 25 percent of the total production of the domestic like product.[24] Finally, the domestic producers and supporters have met the statutory criteria for industry support under section 702(c)(4)(A)(ii) of the Act because the domestic producers and supporters who support the Petition account for more than 50 percent of the production of the domestic like product produced by that portion of the industry expressing support for, or opposition to, the Petition.[25] Accordingly, Commerce determines that the Petition was filed on behalf of the domestic industry within the meaning of section 702(b)(1) of the Act.[26]
Because India is a “Subsidies Agreement Country” within the meaning of section 701(b) of the Act, section 701(a)(2) of the Act applies to this investigation. Accordingly, the ITC must determine whether imports of the subject merchandise from India materially injure, or threaten material injury to, a U.S. industry.
Allegations and Evidence of Material Injury and Causation
The petitioners allege that imports of the subject merchandise are benefiting from countervailable subsidies and that such imports are causing, or threaten to cause, material injury to the U.S. industry producing the domestic like product. In addition, the petitioners allege that subject imports exceed the negligibility threshold provided for under section 771(24)(A) of the Act.[27]
The petitioners contend that the industry's injured condition is illustrated by a significant increase in the volume of subject imports; underselling and price depression and/or suppression; negative impact on financial performance; and declines in production, U.S. shipments, and employment variables.[28] We assessed the allegations and supporting evidence regarding material injury, threat of material injury, causation, as well as negligibility, and we have determined that these allegations are properly supported by adequate evidence, and meet the statutory requirements for initiation.[29]
Based upon the examination of the Petition and supplemental responses, we find that they meet the requirements of section 702 of the Act. Therefore, we are initiating a CVD investigation to determine whether imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India benefit from countervailable subsidies conferred by the GOI. In accordance with section 703(b)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.205(b)(1), unless postponed, we will make our preliminary determination no later than 65 days after the date of this initiation.
Based on our review of the Petition, we find that there is sufficient information to initiate a CVD investigation on 24 programs alleged by the petitioners. For a full discussion of the basis for our decision to initiate on each program, see the India CVD Initiation Checklist. A public version of the initiation checklist for this investigation is available on ACCESS.
In the Petition, the petitioners identified 16 companies in India.[30] Commerce intends to follow its standard practice in CVD investigations and calculate company-specific subsidy rates in this investigation. In the event that Commerce determines that the number of companies is large and it cannot individually examine each company based on Commerce's resources, where appropriate, Commerce intends to select mandatory respondents based on quantity and value (Q&V) questionnaires issued to the potential respondents. Commerce normally selects mandatory respondents in CVD investigations using U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) entry data for U.S. imports under the appropriate Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) subheadings listed in the “Scope of the Investigation,” in the appendix. However, for this investigation, some of the main HTSUS subheadings under which the subject merchandise would enter (7304.19.1020, 7304.19.1030, 7304.19.1045, 7304.19.1060, 7304.19.5020, 7304.19.5050, 7304.31.6050, 7304.39.0016, 7304.39.0020, 7304.39.0024, 7304.39.0028, 7304.39.0032, 7304.39.0036, 7304.39.0040, 7304.39.0044, 7304.39.0048, 7304.39.0052, 7304.39.0056, 7304.39.0062, 7304.39.0068, 7304.39.0072, 7304.51.5005, 7304.51.5060, 7304.59.6000) are basket categories under which non-subject merchandise may also enter. Therefore, instead of relying on CBP entry data in selecting respondents, we intend to issue Q&V questionnaires to each potential respondent for which there is complete address information on the record.
Commerce will post the Q&V questionnaire along with filing instructions on Commerce's website at https://www.trade.gov/​ec-adcvd-qv-questionnaire. Producers/exporters of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India that do not receive Q&V questionnaires may still submit a response to the Q&V questionnaire and can obtain a copy of the Q&V questionnaire from Commerce's website. Responses to the Q&V questionnaire must be submitted by the relevant Indian producers/exporters no later than 5:00 p.m. ET on November 18, 2026, which is two weeks from the signature date of this notice. All Q&V questionnaire responses must be filed electronically via ACCESS. An ( printed page 70850) electronically filed document must be received successfully, in its entirety, by ACCESS no later than 5:00 p.m. ET on the deadline noted above.
Interested parties must submit applications for disclosure under administrative protective order (APO) in accordance with 19 CFR 351.305(b). Instructions for filing such applications may be found on Commerce's website at https://www.trade.gov/​administrative-protective-orders.
In accordance with section 702(b)(4)(A) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.202(f), a copy of the public version of the Petition has been provided to the GOI via ACCESS. To the extent practicable, we will attempt to provide a copy of the public version of the Petition to each exporter named in the Petition, as provided under 19 CFR 351.203(c)(2).
Commerce will notify the ITC of its initiation, as required by section 702(d) of the Act.
The ITC will preliminarily determine, within 45 days after the date on which the Petition was filed, whether there is a reasonable indication that imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India are materially injuring, or threatening material injury to, a U.S. industry.[31] A negative ITC determination will result in the investigation being terminated.[32] Otherwise, this CVD investigation will proceed according to statutory and regulatory time limits.
Factual information is defined in 19 CFR 351.102(b)(21) as: (i) evidence submitted in response to questionnaires; (ii) evidence submitted in support of allegations; (iii) publicly available information to value factors of production under 19 CFR 351.408(c) or to measure the adequacy of remuneration under 19 CFR 351.511(a)(2); (iv) evidence placed on the record by Commerce; and (v) evidence other than factual information described in (i)-(iv). Section 351.301(b) of Commerce's regulations requires any party, when submitting factual information, to specify under which subsection of 19 CFR 351.102(b)(21) the information is being submitted [33] and, if the information is submitted to rebut, clarify, or correct factual information already on the record, to provide an explanation identifying the information already on the record that the factual information seeks to rebut, clarify, or correct.[34] Time limits for the submission of factual information are addressed in 19 CFR 351.301, which provides specific time limits based on the type of factual information being submitted. Interested parties should review the regulations prior to submitting factual information in this investigation.
Parties may request an extension of time limits before the expiration of a time limit established under 19 CFR 351.301, or as otherwise specified by Commerce. In general, an extension request will be considered untimely if it is filed after the expiration of the time limit established under 19 CFR 351.301, or as otherwise specified by Commerce.[35] For submissions that are due from multiple parties simultaneously, an extension request will be considered untimely if it is filed after 10:00 a.m. ET on the due date. Under certain circumstances, Commerce may elect to specify a different time limit by which extension requests will be considered untimely for submissions which are due from multiple parties simultaneously. In such a case, we will inform parties in a letter or memorandum of the deadline (including a specified time) by which extension requests must be filed to be considered timely. An extension request must be made in a separate, standalone submission; under limited circumstances we will grant untimely filed requests for the extension of time limits, where we determine, based on 19 CFR 351.302, that extraordinary circumstances exist. Parties should review Commerce's regulations concerning the extension of time limits and the Time Limits Final Rule prior to submitting factual information in this investigation.[36]
Any party submitting factual information in an AD or CVD proceeding must certify to the accuracy and completeness of that information.[37] Parties must use the certification formats provided in 19 CFR 351.303(g).[38] Commerce intends to reject factual submissions if the submitting party does not comply with the applicable certification requirements.
Interested parties must submit applications for disclosure under APO in accordance with 19 CFR 351.305. Parties wishing to participate in this investigation should ensure that they meet the requirements of 19 CFR 351.103(d) ( e.g., by filing the required letters of appearance). Note that Commerce has amended certain of its requirements pertaining to the service of documents in 19 CFR 351.303(f).[39]
This notice is issued and published pursuant to sections 702 and 777(i) of the Act, and 19 CFR 351.203(c).
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Operations.
The merchandise covered by this investigation is seamless carbon and alloy steel (other than stainless steel) pipes and redraw hollows, less than or equal to 16 inches (406.4 mm) in nominal outside diameter, regardless of wall-thickness, manufacturing process ( e.g., hot finished or cold-drawn), end finish ( e.g., plain end, beveled end, upset end, threaded, or threaded and coupled), or surface finish ( e.g., bare, lacquered or coated). Redraw hollows are any unfinished carbon or alloy steel (other than stainless steel) pipe or “hollow profiles” suitable for cold finishing operations, such as cold drawing, to meet the American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) or American Petroleum Institute (API) specifications referenced below, or comparable specifications. Specifically included within the scope are seamless carbon and alloy steel (other than stainless steel) standard, line, and pressure pipes produced to the ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106, ASTM A-333, ASTM A-334, ASTM A-589, ASTM A-795, ASTM A-1024, and the API 5L specifications, or comparable specifications, and meeting the physical parameters described above, regardless of application, with the exception of the exclusions discussed below.
Specifically excluded from the scope of this investigation are: (1) all pipes meeting ( printed page 70851) aerospace, hydraulic, and bearing tubing specifications, including: (a) aerospace tubing produced to SAE Aerospace Material Specifications (AMS) 6360, 6361, and 6362; (b) hydraulic tubing produced to ASTM A-822, SAE J524, and EN 10305-4 specifications; and (c) bearing tubing produced to the SAE AMS 6440 specification, including bearing tubing manufactured from steel meeting the chemical and metallurgical requirements of ASTM A-295; (2) all pipes meeting the chemical requirements of ASTM A-335, whether finished or unfinished; (3) unattached couplings; (4) all mechanical, boiler, condenser and heat exchange tubing, except when such products conform to the dimensional requirements, i.e., outside diameter and wall thickness, of ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106 or API 5L specifications; (5) oil country tubular goods consisting of drill pipe, casing, tubing, and coupling stock; and (6) all pipes meeting the chemical requirements of ASTM A-335 regardless of their conformity to the dimensional requirements of ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106 or API 5L.
Subject seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe are normally entered under Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) subheadings 7304.19.1020, 7304.19.1030, 7304.19.1045, 7304.19.1060, 7304.19.5020, 7304.19.5050, 7304.31.6050, 7304.39.0016, 7304.39.0020, 7304.39.0024, 7304.39.0028, 7304.39.0032, 7304.39.0036, 7304.39.0040, 7304.39.0044, 7304.39.0048, 7304.39.0052, 7304.39.0056, 7304.39.0062, 7304.39.0068, 7304.39.0072, 7304.51.5005, 7304.51.5060, 7304.59.6000, 7304.59.8010, 7304.59.8015, 7304.59.8020, 7304.59.8025, 7304.59.8030, 7304.59.8035, 7304.59.8040, 7304.59.8045, 7304.59.8050, 7304.59.8055, 7304.59.8060, 7304.59.8065, and 7304.59.8070. Subject merchandise may also enter under HTSUS subheadings 7304.31.6010, 7304.39.0002, 7304.39.0004, 7304.39.0006, 7304.39.0008, 7304.51.5015, 7304.51.5045, 7304.59.2030, 7304.59.2040, 7304.59.2045, 7304.59.2055, and 7304.59.2060. content:
资料照片：2026年1月5日，在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的年度国际消费类电子产品展览会(CES)前夕，英伟达创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋在英伟达举行的活动上发言。
芯片制造商英伟达(Nvidia)星期日(11月89日)表示，针对有关该公司首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)成为外国情报机构目标的报道，公司董事会启动了一项独立调查。同天，黄仁勋在发给员工的一则讯息中承认自己存在出轨行为。英伟达由黄仁勋于1993年联合创立，总部位于加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉市，该公司是全球领先的超级智能(通常被称为人工智能，AI)处理器供应商，目前市值为4.5万亿美元。
星期一开盘时，英伟达股价下跌了5%。在此之前，媒体上月曾有报道称，黄仁勋与一位名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的商界女性存在关联，而美国官员认定该女子为中国的情报资产。两人虽同姓，但无亲属关系。
董事会在星期日发表的一份声明中表示， “鉴于近期有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报活动的目标”，董事会决定启动一项独立调查。该调查将由独立董事组成的一个小组负责，并由外部律师提供协助。声明没有点名黄乐。
声明说：“尽管董事会没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达机密受到损害，但董事会的调查将审视所有可获取的信息。”
上个月，《纽约时报》(The New York Times)首先报道说，美国情报机构发现，黄仁勋与中国公民黄乐建立了密切关系，而她直接将信息传递给北京。
黄乐曾在中国做过电视台记者，后来成为位于新加坡的数据中心公司Megaspeed的高管。《纽约时报》报道说，该公司过去两年购买了48亿多美元的英伟达芯片。
追踪这项调查的美国媒体无法独立证实黄乐是否仍为Megaspeed工作。该公司星期一没有立即回复询问。
63岁的黄仁勋在星期日的讯息中说：“我对妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的子女。我所做的事情没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”他在这段讯息中没有提及黄乐。10月末，黄仁勋与彭博社(Bloomberg News)谈话时称他与她的交往“完全正常，并无异常”，这与Megaspeed有关。公司发言人约翰·里佐(John Rizzo)在星期日的一项声明中说：“黄仁勋致力于继续作为首席行政官领导英伟达，不会间断。”
从2022年起，美国对运往中国的高端超级智能芯片出口实施限制。美国官员一直在调查Megaspeed涉嫌帮助中国获取受出口限制的处理器的一事。
据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报机构怀疑黄仁勋在其敦促唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统批准英伟达向中国和世界其他市场出口英伟达芯片期间与黄乐有恋爱关系。对黄乐的监控发现了她与黄仁勋的关系，司法部今年从2024年末开始调查Megaspeed的商务部手中接管此案。
特朗普后来同意让英伟达向中国出口能力略逊的H200芯片，美国政府获取25%的收入。由于北京试图加强本土半导体行业，对这些芯片的进口一直有限。《华尔街日报》(The Wall Street Journal)报道说，英伟达如今跻身世界开放权重AI模型开放商之列，这些模型可被用户拿来改用，而该公司就敏感的AI政策与特朗普政府保持定期接触。《华尔街日报》形容黄仁勋在世界两大经济体美中之间做平衡，并提到他赞扬了中国的技术人才。
分别领导众议院外交委员会、常设情报委员会和中国问题特设委员会的共和党众议员布莱恩·J·马斯特(Brian J. Mast)、埃里克·A·“里克”·克劳福德(Eric A. “Rick” Crawford)和约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar) 要求在11月18日与黄仁勋举行闭门会议。
在这封发函日期注明为11月4日的信件中，三位议员写道：“至关重要的是，国会必须确定美国国家安全所面临的风险程度。”
星期日，特朗普总统说，他和黄仁勋没有讨论过此事。当被问到他是否本应对其收到的情报作出回应时，特朗普总统回答说：“不，我不这样认为。我认为他是个值得尊敬的人。我认为他可能为此有个借口。你必须听一听。”
国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)在前往巴黎参加七国集团会议前与记者们交谈时，拒绝谈论他所说的“公司内部事宜”。
中国外交部发言人郭嘉琨星期一对记者们说：“所谓‘中国间谍’的论调纯属捕风捉影，污蔑抹黑。”中国驻华盛顿大使馆同时发表了措辞类似的声明，使馆发言人刘畅称这些指称是“捕风捉影的污蔑抹黑”。
接下来今天将检验这场争议能走多远。投资者首先将于11月17日审视英伟达的财报。第二天是国会共和党人要求的闭门会议。目前还不清楚黄仁勋是否出席，而他的回应将预示，在公司董事会审查期间，他在多大程度上愿意与国会互动。对黄仁勋个人来说，董事会的结论可能最为关键，包括是否有任何信息送达北京，以及黄仁勋对据称的间谍行动的知情程度。没有听说黄仁勋或黄乐已受到刑事指控的报道。董事会星期日说，将“酌情”提供进一步的更新信息。

2025 年 9 月 17 日，波兰士兵在波兰奥日什举行的演习中发射“Piorun”便携式防空导弹。（Wojtek Radwanski/法新社，盖蒂图片社）
乌克兰基辅——欧洲官员本周宣布，数千名欧洲军队将于下周聚集在波兰，参加自愿联盟的首次大型军事演习，这是在与俄罗斯的战争结束后向乌克兰部署多国部队的预演。
特使史蒂夫·威特科夫周一表示，此次演习正值美国、俄罗斯和乌克兰谈判代表定于 11 月 10 日至 11 日在阿布扎比举行会议。这次会议为乌克兰和平谈判动荡的一年画上句号。自二月份美国和以色列开始袭击伊朗后，谈判陷入僵局，直到九月份维特科夫和特使贾里德·库什纳在莫斯科会见了普京，然后才以谈判代表身份前往基辅进行首次访问时，谈判才得以恢复。
英国和法国将于 11 月 9 日至 22 日联合领导 KOALICJA 26.2，汇集来自 11 个国家的 2,800 名士兵，在联军的军事力量乌克兰多国部队 (MNF-U) 的领导下，在波兰、法国和土耳其开展协调活动。美国军队不会参加。
英国国防部声明称，演习将联合空中、陆地和海上力量，“测试如何调动、保护和补给一支部队，以便在战斗结束后帮助重建乌克兰武装部队”。
比利时、爱沙尼亚、法国、德国、立陶宛、荷兰、西班牙、瑞典、土耳其和英国也参与其中。
法国外交部的声明称，此次训练将为部队的最终任务做好准备，其中可能包括保护关键基础设施、训练乌克兰军队、帮助保护天空和清除黑海的地雷，这是乌克兰更广泛的安全保障计划的一部分。
英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷在国防部新闻稿中表示：“这次演习表明，英国正在加紧与法国和我们的盟友一起，为乌克兰和平到来的那一天做好准备。这不是一个假设的计划；它是一支真正的力量，准备在战斗停止后帮助乌克兰。”
据报道，多国部队将不承担维持和平或停火监督任务，也不接受北约指挥。只有在停火后并应基辅的要求，它才会进入乌克兰。
前法国驻乌克兰大使盖尔·韦西埃尔 (Gaël Veyssière) 在四月份对《军事时报》表示，停火监测“将是一项与多国部队不同的任务，多国部队的目标本质上是不同的，因为它的目的是支持乌克兰军队的能力得到加强”。
据英国发布的消息称，演习还将测试“部队的指挥和控制安排”，并评估“不同组成部分如何作为一支多国部队进行整合和有效运作”。
英国正在派遣 300 名人员，包括来自被称为“沙漠老鼠”的英国陆军第七轻型机械化旅的士兵，来演练后勤行动。华沙将在战后管理多国部队的调动，但不会派遣其部队

European troops set to train in Poland for postwar Ukraine deployment

Polish soldiers fire a “Piorun” MANPAD during exercises in Orzysz, Poland, Sept. 17, 2025. (Wojtek Radwanski/AFP via Getty Images)
KYIV, Ukraine — Thousands of European troops will gather in Poland next week for the Coalition of the Willing’s first major military exercise, a rehearsal for deploying a multinational force to Ukraine once the war with Russia comes to an end, European officials announced this week.
The exercise comes as U.S., Russian and Ukrainian negotiators are set to meet in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10 and 11, special envoy Steve Witkoff said Monday. The meeting caps a tumultuous year for Ukraine’s peace talks, which stalled after the U.S. and Israel began striking Iran in February and revived only in September, when Witkoff and fellow envoy Jared Kushner met Putin in Moscow before traveling to Kyiv for their first visit as negotiators.
Britain and France will jointly lead KOALICJA 26.2 from Nov. 9 to 22, bringing together 2,800 troops from 11 nations for coordinated activities in Poland, France and Turkey under the coalition’s military arm, the Multinational Force-Ukraine (MNF-U). American troops will not participate.
The drills will combine air, land and sea forces to “test how to move, protect and supply a force that would help rebuild Ukraine’s Armed Forces once the fighting ends,” according to a British Ministry of Defence statement.
Belgium, Estonia, France, Germany, Lithuania, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, Turkey and Britain are also taking part.
The training will prepare troops for the force’s eventual missions, which could include securing critical infrastructure, training Ukraine’s military, helping protect the skies and clearing mines from the Black Sea, as part of a broader package of security guarantees for Ukraine, according to the French ministry’s statement.
“This exercise shows the UK is stepping up, alongside France and our allies, to prepare for the day peace comes to Ukraine. This isn’t a hypothetical plan; it’s a real force, ready to help Ukraine once the fighting stops,” British Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said in the ministry’s release.
The MNF-U will reportedly not have a peacekeeping or ceasefire-monitoring mandate or operate under NATO command. It would move into Ukraine only after a ceasefire and at Kyiv’s request.
Ceasefire monitoring “would be a different task from that of the multinational force, whose aim is different in nature because it is meant to support the Ukrainian army in its ability to be beefed up,” former French Ambassador to Ukraine Gaël Veyssière told Military Times in April.
The drills will also test “command-and-control arrangements for the force” and assess “how different components can integrate and operate effectively as one multinational force,” according to the British release.
Britain is sending 300 personnel, including soldiers from the British Army’s 7th Light Mechanised Brigade, known as the “Desert Rats,” to rehearse logistical movements. Warsaw will manage the movement of MNF-U troops after the war but will not send its own soldiers into Ukraine. Nearly 2,000 Polish soldiers will take part in addition to the foreign forces, the Polish ministry said.
France is sending “hundreds” of troops, including a unit equipped with about 50 “contact drones,” the second of its kind after one deployed to Romania, Army Chief of Staff Gen. Jacques de Montgros’s told lawmakers last month.
Turkey will not send troops to Poland, the French ministry said, but will stand up the MNF-U’s maritime element in Istanbul, “testing arrangements for maritime mine clearance to allow commercial shipping to safely return to Ukraine’s ports,” according to the British release.
“This exercise will show that the Multinational Force-Ukraine is a real, capable, readily deployable force that represents a serious commitment from Coalition of the Willing nations to Ukraine’s long-term stability and security,” said the commander of MNF-U, British Lt. Gen. Tom Bateman.
The exercise announcements do not specify the final size of a force that could deploy to Ukraine, but Britain and France said earlier this year that they were prepared to contribute roughly 5,000 troops each.
Even a minimal “tripwire” presence would require 10,000 to 25,000 troops, the Center for Strategic and International Studies assessed last year. Because only a third of any force is frontline-ready at a given time, rotations push that number far higher, Ed Arnold, a senior research fellow at the Royal United Services Institute and a former British military officer, told Military Times.
Russian President Vladimir Putin has rejected allowing a foreign troop presence in Ukraine, and he warned in September 2025 that Western forces deployed there would be legitimate targets.
Although the MNF-U is not a peacekeeping force, Polish defense officials said its presence is meant to ease Ukrainian fears of a renewed Russian attack once the war ends.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy pressed allies on Wednesday to move quickly, pointing out that Russian forces continue to batter Ukraine’s power grid and other critical infrastructure as the country braces for its fifth winter of full-scale war.
“Peace has no alternative, and postwar security guarantees must be truly cast-iron,” he said.
Katie Livingstone is the Ukraine correspondent for Defense News and Military Times. Based in Kyiv, she has covered Russia’s full-scale invasion since its first days. She is a former Fulbright fellow whose award-winning work has appeared in outlets across Europe and the U.S.

content:
黄仁勋的出轨风波会对英伟达造成怎样影响？图像来源: Jens Kalaene/dpa/picture alliance
（德国之声中文网）英伟达总裁黄仁勋承认与一名女子有婚外情，美国情报官员认为这名女子是中国间谍。此事可能对这家市值5万亿美元（4.47万亿欧元）的公司产生深远影响。
多年来密切报道英伟达和黄仁勋的亚洲科技记者卡尔潘（Tim Culpan）对德国之声表示，英伟达作为一家公司的基本优势依然存在，但黄仁勋个人因此事受到巨大伤害。
黄乐（Alice Huang）在自己的微信账号分享的合影。据媒体报道，她是一家科技公司的高管，被指与美国人工智能芯片巨头英伟达总裁黄仁勋发生婚外情，并且在此期间为中国从事间谍活动——以黄仁勋和英伟达作为收集情报的目标。图像来源: Newscom/picture alliance
他说：“他们仍然会造出出色的芯片，仍然会卖给全世界数以百万计想要最好的人工智能芯片的客户。”
“他（黄仁勋）的意见现在分量要轻得多。从长远看，这会影响到英伟达及其自身的企业利益。（对企业的）影响不会立竿见影。但事实上，仅仅因为这件事，他个人已经没有一周前可能拥有的那种影响力和权力了。”
科技分析师、研究公司Radio Free Mobile创始人温莎（Richard Windsor）说，鉴于几十年来英伟达在很大程度上围绕黄仁勋运转，这一消息对英伟达可能非常严重。
他说：“这个问题尤其严重，因为黄仁勋事必躬亲，也就是说，让公司取得成功的关键决策最终都是由他做出的，而且公司没有明显的接班人。”
“我怀疑我们即将看到，市场认为这家公司对其标志性的创始人兼首席执行官到底有多依赖。”
照片上坐在黄仁勋身旁的被认为就是黄乐（Alice Huang）。据称黄乐曾经供职于央视，后来成为Megaspeed高管。图像来源: Newscom/picture alliance
尽管黄仁勋与特朗普关系密切，英伟达和黄仁勋对中国及潜在中国客户的态度一直是美国情报官员的一个争议点。
黄仁勋多次游说特朗普放宽向中国销售英伟达芯片的限制。2025年的一项出口管制协议大幅限制了英伟达芯片的销售，但特朗普随后允许向中国出口较旧的英伟达H200芯片，条件是美国政府从销售额中抽成。
然而，由于华盛顿严格的出口许可审查，这项安排变得复杂且进展缓慢。尽管中国企业需求强劲，北京也启动了进口管制。中国无法获得最先进的人工智能芯片。北京希望开发自己的替代产品，但一直难以追赶。
黄仁勋认为，中国对英伟达芯片的依赖，可以阻止华为等竞争对手追赶上来，也可以阻止中国实现主导人工智能供应链的野心。
然而，许多美国情报官员不认同这一观点。他们担心，如果中国不受限制地获得最先进的英伟达芯片，将会推动中国国内人工智能产业发展，使中国的人工智能模型追上美国领先模型，还可能被用于中国的军事用途。
中美竞争已成为全球人工智能发展的核心主题，两国都在寻求在这项技术上占据上风。Anthropic公司的阿莫代（Dario Amodei）等美国人工智能企业领军人物认为，为了防止中国企业取得优势，美国人工智能企业承受不起为了让人工智能安全标准跟上而长时间暂停发展。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
华盛顿对黄仁勋这段婚外情的核心担忧是，这可能导致北京获得重要商业机密，或有关英伟达如何制造其最先进芯片的其他关键信息。
温莎认为，由于黄仁勋对公司举足轻重，他将挺过这场“严峻考验”。他还对北京及中国领先科技企业从英伟达芯片中学到了多少表示怀疑，并指出中国有自己的芯片野心，也承诺让本国企业购买国产半导体。
他说：“我难以相信中国人工智能从英伟达获得的技术或非法进口的芯片中实质性受益。”
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
此事发生在英伟达面临特殊挑战之际。作为人工智能应用所需尖端半导体的领先制造商，英伟达从人工智能热潮中获益巨大。
近年来，随着企业争相购买其芯片，英伟达估值飙升，2025年10月成为全球首家市值达5万亿美元的公司。
然而，外界怀疑耗资9万亿美元资本支出的人工智能热潮能否持续，这在最近几周引发了相关股票的大规模抛售。民主党在美国中期选举中大获全胜，加剧了这种疑虑，因为美国选民强烈反对兴建数据中心。

北京香山论坛多国代表对军用人工智能的潜在风险深表担忧。在美中两国准备举行高层会晤之际，武器自主化正急剧压缩决策时间，大国在此类技术管控上的分歧再度引发广泛讨论。
周一，中共为前总书记江泽民举行百岁冥诞纪念大会。周二，前总理朱镕基的遗体在八宝山公墓火化，天安门等地降半旗致哀。江泽民与朱镕基留给习近平怎样的遗产？习近平能否借助已经逝去的时代安抚当下的民心，进一步巩固自己的权力？
在欧盟释放信号，表示愿意让加拿大以“准成员”身份成为其特殊伙伴后，美国总统特朗普对此发出嘲讽，并表示，这一设想属于“敌对行为”。
为什么年收入6万多美元的美国家庭，依然觉得养不起孩子、存不到钱？两个普通家庭的经历，揭示了医疗支出与生活成本飙升下，美国民众面临的现实困境。
美国总统特朗普威胁，凡不使用SI（超级智能），而继续使用AI（人工智能）的，将被白宫视为敌人。但专家说，更名“超级智能”并不能缓解公众对人工智能的忧虑。
为期两天的G20财长与央行行长会议落幕。美国财政部长贝森特表示，有19个成员国同意采取行动，处理“非市场”政策及大量廉价出口造成的全球经济失衡，唯独中国持反对意见；北京则表示，对会议未能发表联合公报“深感遗憾”。

content:
白金汉宫一名幕僚表示，若英国政府提议英王查尔斯三世（King Charles III；查理斯国王）访问中国，国王将“小心考虑”。
这位幕僚是在查尔斯国王周末结束加勒比海多国巡访和出席英联邦政府首脑会议（CHOGM）之际，向一群媒体记者表达此说。
有关言论发表前不久，是已故英女王伊丽莎白二世（Queen Elizabeth II；伊利沙伯二世）1986年访华40周年。她是迄今唯一一位曾经访问中国的英国君主。
英国政府目前并未对此说法置评。国会下议院一个委员会上周发表报告，批评现政府在对华政策上“见步行步”。安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）就任首相至今尚未阐明其对英中关系的立场。
在刚结束的对加勒比海行程中，查尔斯国王先后访问了圭亚那（Guyana）和巡访了巴哈马（The Bahamas）、安提瓜和巴布达（Antigua and Barbuda）两国。三国均为英联邦（Commonwealth of Nations；大英国协）成员国，其中巴哈马与安提瓜和巴布达亦是英联邦王国（Commonwealth realm），奉查尔斯国王为国家元首。
英国报联社（Press Association, PA）报导，这位白金汉宫幕僚是在评论国王是次行程时谈及中国。
这位“高级幕僚”对随行采访的记者说：“要是政府说：‘国王能去中国吗？’我想我们会很小心地考虑这事情。”
现年78岁的查尔斯国王目前仍在接受癌症治疗——王室官僚并未透露其具体诊断。他在今年4月官式访美，期间如何与美国总统特朗普（Donald Trump；川普）互动，受到外界赞赏。
图像加注文字，安迪·伯纳姆首相（右）对会否请求查尔斯国王出访中国不置可否。
受香港局势、英国批评中国人权纪录、连串间谍指控，以及中国驻英国大使馆新馆建设争议等所影响，伦敦与北京关系近年持续处于低潮。
法新社向唐宁街10号首相府查询安迪·伯纳姆政府会否请求国王出访中国，其发言人答复称，君主要出访何处“由白金汉宫定夺”。
然而，国王接见访英外国首脑与否，实际上是“按外交部建议”决定。同理，邀请国王出访何国，同样是经由英国外交部操办。英国王室官网对此惯例有明文介绍，内阁办公室王室访问委员会（Royal Visits Committee, Cabinet Office）为相关决策实体。
图像加注文字，查尔斯国王长期与西藏达赖喇嘛关系友好，但北京视达赖喇嘛为分裂分子。
国王此行在安提瓜和巴布达出席英联邦政府首脑会议（CHOGM）时，在开幕致词中形容跨大西洋奴隶贸易是“历史上可耻的一章”，令他感到“极为悲痛”。安迪·伯纳姆首相同步透露，他愿意考虑由英国作出正式道歉。
法新社引述这位幕僚说：“我认为，我们正目睹一种非常清晰的模式显现出来：政府要求国王介入一些政治色彩浓厚、且颇具挑战性的局面。”
英国报联社引述该名白金汉宫高级幕僚说：“中国是个何其重要的国家，是个很复杂的国家，在制定访问计划时得应付诸多复杂因素。”
图像加注文字，已故英女王伊丽莎白二世（中）与王夫菲利普亲王（右）1986年访华是迄今唯一一次英国在位君主对中国的国事访问。
已故英女王伊丽莎白二世1986年的访问，是英国在位君主迄今唯一一次官式对华访问。女王当年10月12日抵达北京，先后会晤中国国家主席李先念、中共中央总书记赵紫阳和中共中央顾问委员会主任邓小平。行程从北京延伸至上海和广州，历时七天。女王结束访华后，紧接巡访当时的英属香港两天。
该次国事访问是在1984年《中英联合声明》签署10个月后进行，《声明》敲定了1997年香港主权自英国移交中国。
此文包含Google YouTube提供的内容。由于这些内容会使用曲奇或小甜饼等科技，我们在加载任何内容前会寻求您的认可。 您可能在给与许可前愿意阅读Google YouTube小甜饼政策和隐私政策。 希望阅读上述内容，请点击“接受并继续”。
查尔斯国王从未访问中国。在1999年时任中国国家主席江泽民访英，和现任中国国家主席习近平2015年访英时，当时的王储威尔士亲王查尔斯王子（Charles, Prince of Wales）并未出席欢迎国宴。
白金汉宫前幕僚马克·博兰德（Mark Bolland）曾形容，1999年的一次，查尔斯王子是“蓄意冷落”中方，因其并不认可中共政权。
博兰德解释，这是因为查尔斯王子是西藏流亡精神领袖达赖喇嘛的忠实支持者，认为对方遭受中共打压。中国长期指控达赖喇嘛长期阴谋将西藏从中国分裂出去。
2015年习近平访华时，查尔斯王子曾另行会晤对方。
图像加注文字，香港移交典礼日记曝光揭示时任英国王储查尔斯王子对中共领导人的负面观感。
图像加注文字，2015年习近平访英，王储查尔斯并未出席欢迎国宴，但另行会晤了习近平伉俪。
博兰德的描述源于2006年查尔斯王子起诉《星期日邮报》（The Mail on Sunday）母公司将其私人日记曝光的侵犯隐私诉讼。时任王储法律代表后来公开了这3000字日记，而《星期日邮报》母公司最终败诉。
这篇日记记载1997年6月30日至7月1日凌晨间，王储作为女王代表出席香港移交大典的经历。王储形容香港移交是“中国大外卖”，出席大典的中方官员是“糟透的陈旧蜡像”——当时出席的中方代表包括江泽民和总理李鹏，大典其中一项仪式是“糟糕的苏联风格”表演。
不过，向媒体记者放话的白金汉宫高级幕僚形容，按宪制惯例保持政治中立的查尔斯国王“乐于面对”其职责中“艰难的部分”，并且可以成为政府的“绝佳秘密武器”。
这位幕僚说：“无论是在环境议题上发挥领导作用，还是在一些涉及复杂政治问题的国家之间，更新、重建并重新注入活力于彼此关系方面，这正是他全心投入、热衷不已的事情。”

summary: 资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在北京中国国际供应链博览会开幕式后，被媒体包围。(2025年7月16日) 英伟达(Nvidia)首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情，引发美国和中国舆论关注。不过，与一般的企业高管私人生活丑闻不同，这起事件还牵涉有关中国情报活动的指控，以及美国超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)芯片产业面临的国家安全问题。 美国主流媒体的报道主要围绕黄仁勋与一名被怀疑可能与中国情报机构有关的女性有婚外情，并探讨这段关系是否可能涉及商业机密泄露，甚至危及美国国家安全。 中国官
content:
资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在北京中国国际供应链博览会开幕式后，被媒体包围。(2025年7月16日)
英伟达(Nvidia)首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情，引发美国和中国舆论关注。不过，与一般的企业高管私人生活丑闻不同，这起事件还牵涉有关中国情报活动的指控，以及美国超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)芯片产业面临的国家安全问题。
美国主流媒体的报道主要围绕黄仁勋与一名被怀疑可能与中国情报机构有关的女性有婚外情，并探讨这段关系是否可能涉及商业机密泄露，甚至危及美国国家安全。
中国官方媒体则采取了明显不同的报道角度。它们提及黄仁勋的婚外情，但着重质疑有关中国间谍活动的说法，指责西方媒体借此炒作中国威胁论，甚至可能试图破坏美中关系。
美国《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》以及其他西方媒体的报道，将这起事件置于美国与中国围绕超级智能技术展开竞争的大背景下。
相关报道指出，与黄仁勋有关系的女性黄乐(Alice Huang)据称与一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业超速国际(Megaspeed International)有关联。这家公司涉及英伟达先进超级智能芯片的商业活动，因此引起美国方面的关注。
《纽约时报》报道说，美国情报部门怀疑黄乐可能与中国情报机构存在联系，并向北京提供过信息。不过，这些指控目前尚未通过公开的司法程序得到证实。
《华尔街日报》星期一(11月9日)以时间线方式，详细报道从与黄乐有关的Megaspeed于2023年从一家中国公司分拆成立开始，回顾黄仁勋与黄乐在2024年、2025年同场出现，以及美国商务部随后调查Megaspeed是否将英伟达先进芯片转运至中国。
报道还梳理了特朗普政府对英伟达对华出口政策的讨论，以及美国情报部门在2026年春季向政府高层传阅机密备忘录的说法。到了11月8日，黄仁勋承认对妻子不忠，英伟达董事会随即启动独立调查。
黄仁勋事件之所以引人关注，与英伟达在美国科技产业和国家安全领域的重要地位密切相关。
作为全球领先的超级智能芯片制造商，英伟达不仅是美国科技产业的重要企业，也处于华盛顿对华高科技出口管制政策争论的中心。
黄仁勋过去多次公开反对过度限制美国企业向中国市场销售先进芯片，认为过于严厉的出口限制可能削弱美国企业的竞争力，同时推动中国加快发展自己的半导体产业。
目前没有公开证据证明黄仁勋明知对方从事情报活动，也没有确凿证据表明英伟达的商业机密已经因此泄露。
中国官方媒体对这起事件的报道呈现出明显不同的侧重点，主要通过否认和质疑间谍指控，批评美国媒体的报道方式及其背后的政治动机。
中国官媒《环球时报》将事件与当前美中关系联系起来，质疑有关指控出现的时机，认为有关报道可能意在制造美中之间的对立。
《环球时报》星期一发布题为《黄仁勋出轨，还能扯上中国？》的快评，称这一事件“让美国媒体为之疯狂”，并批评《纽约时报》有关黄仁勋婚外情对象可能是中国间谍的报道捕风捉影。
《环球时报》写道：“仅仅是几张有东方面孔的照片、英伟达此前推动放宽对华贸易限制的行动，在其中加入了所谓“知情人士”的话和媒体的“怀疑”，就足以将事情添油加醋为“中国女间谍渗透美国芯片公司”。向来自诩“客观”的美国媒体正是这样生产故事的。”
环球之后说，在美中关系趋于缓和之际，出现此类新闻，是有些人“在背后放冷枪”。
这篇评论随后被凤凰网、新浪、网易、腾讯等多家中国媒体转载，使其观点在中国网络媒体上得到进一步传播。
与美国媒体相比，这些报道较少深入讨论美国情报部门提出的具体疑点，也没有将相关情报指控作为报道的主要调查方向。报道的重点更多放在质疑美国媒体的消息来源、证据基础以及报道动机上。
中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆星期一在回应有关报道时，也否认中国从事相关间谍活动，称“所谓‘中国间谍’的论调纯属捕风捉影，污蔑抹黑。”
微博上，部分网民对黄仁勋的私人生活表示惊讶或失望。黄仁勋长期以来在中国科技界和商业界拥有较高知名度，不少中国公众将他视为华人科技企业家的代表人物。
在小红书上，除了讨论黄仁勋的婚外情及其可能涉及的间谍疑云，也有不少网友关注事件对英伟达股价的影响。
星期一早间，英伟达股价一度下跌超过8%，引发投资者讨论。有网友调侃说：“他犯的错，我买单。”
这些讨论显示，对不少中国网民来说，黄仁勋的私人生活、公众形象以及英伟达的市场表现，都是这起事件值得关注的方面。相比之下，间谍指控并非所有讨论的中心。

summary: 尽管美国限制出口，为何中国科技企业还是能用到英伟达提供的算力？图像来源: Dado Ruvic/REUTERS （德国之声中文网）英伟达CEO黄仁勋承认自己有婚外情的事件还在不断发酵。据称其出轨对象是中国籍女高管，任职于总部设在新加坡的Megaspeed公司，而美国怀疑这家公司参与将人工智能芯片走私进入中国。 这一丑闻使外界再次关注一个问题：作为全球人工智能强国之一的中国，究竟是如何在美国出口限制之下获得最先进芯片的？ 英伟达设计了一种最初用于处理电子游戏三维画面的先进元件，
content:
尽管美国限制出口，为何中国科技企业还是能用到英伟达提供的算力？图像来源: Dado Ruvic/REUTERS
（德国之声中文网）英伟达CEO黄仁勋承认自己有婚外情的事件还在不断发酵。据称其出轨对象是中国籍女高管，任职于总部设在新加坡的Megaspeed公司，而美国怀疑这家公司参与将人工智能芯片走私进入中国。
这一丑闻使外界再次关注一个问题：作为全球人工智能强国之一的中国，究竟是如何在美国出口限制之下获得最先进芯片的？
英伟达设计了一种最初用于处理电子游戏三维画面的先进元件，称为图形处理器（GPU）。
这种芯片拥有处理海量数据的能力，因此也被大规模用于训练和运行AI系统。
2022年ChatGPT的推出展示了人工智能的巨大潜力，引发了一场投资淘金热。各国政府和科技巨头竞相推进人工智能技术发展。
随着芯片订单不断涌进，英伟达的市值飙升至4.5万亿美元，目前与苹果（Apple）并列为全球最有价值的两家公司。
出于国家安全考虑，美国禁止向中国出口英伟达最先进的“Blackwell”和“Rubin”系列GPU，因为先进人工智能技术具有军事用途。
这项政策同时也有助于美国顶级人工智能实验室保持全球领先地位。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
黄仁勋一直游说美国政府允许向中国出售英伟达芯片。他警告说，相关限制措施正在推动中国本土替代产品的发展壮大。
今年，美国放宽了此前被禁止出口、性能相对较低的“H200”芯片的限制，并规定美国政府可从销售额中获得25%的分成。
但美国设定的审批条件使相关出口许可难以获批。与此同时，随着中国本土芯片产业的发展，北京方面对采购H200芯片也并不积极。
此前路透社引述两位知情人士的消息称，约60万块英伟达先进人工智能芯片目前存放在香港，等待运往中国内地。尽管中国科技企业存在需求，但北京方面尚未批准这些芯片的大规模进口。
包括Moonshot AI（月之暗面）、Z.ai（智谱AI）以及DeepSeek（深度求索）在内的中国人工智能初创企业，近期相继推出高性能模型，进一步加剧了与美国同行之间的竞争。
市场研究机构Omdia首席分析师苏连杰（Lian Jye Su）向法新社表示：“尽管存在出口管制，中国企业仍在使用最先进的英伟达芯片来训练模型。”
很多中国科技企业都渴望获得英伟达的高性能芯片图像来源: CFOTO/picture alliance
这些芯片可能通过两种方式被中国企业获得：一是走私。科技媒体The Information去年12月报道称，DeepSeek训练其新模型时使用了数千枚先在海外拆解、随后运入中国的芯片。
当时DeepSeek没有回应置评请求。英伟达则向该媒体表示，他们没有看到此类走私行为的证据，并称这一说法“似乎不太可信”。
二是利用云计算的制度漏洞，即在第三国的数据中心租用搭载英伟达芯片的算力，这些国家通常位于东南亚。
投资基金Carthage Capital创始人Stephen Wu解释说：“美国的出口管制限制的是芯片被运往何处，而不是谁在使用它。”
这意味着英伟达的GPU完全可以安装在比如马来西亚柔佛州的数据中心内，且符合出口规定，而深圳的客户则可以远程登录并使用这些芯片的算力。
白宫顾问Michael Kratsios今年夏天表示，人工智能公司Moonshot AI曾通过泰国获得高端英伟达芯片资源。
美国还指责一些中国人工智能实验室利用美国模型训练自己的系统，以模仿其能力。
科技分析媒体Hello China Tech创始人赵博（Poe Zhao）表示：“英伟达芯片依然能让顶级AI研发工作更快、更容易完成，但它已经不再是唯一选择。”
他指出，问题在于成本。使用中国国产芯片训练模型通常需要更多时间，也需要更多工程优化工作。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
华为目前是中国最主要的英伟达竞争对手。尽管中国制造的芯片正在快速进步，但是与这家美国巨头相比仍存在差距。
据报道，DeepSeek下一代重要人工智能模型将采用华为芯片进行训练。
华为今年9月宣布，其下一代人工智能芯片将于2027年第一季度问世，比原计划提前三个季度。
Stephen Wu认为，要提升国产芯片的整体性能，人工智能企业需要部署更多数量的芯片来弥补单芯片性能差距。
“他们付出的代价是更高的电力消耗和更高的总体成本，但他们可以负担得起，因为中国电价较低，而且这些芯片获得了政府补贴。”

title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
summary: The race is on to sue Nvidia | TechCrunch Image Credits:Justin Sullivan / Getty Images 2:23 PM PST · November 9, 2026 Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% on Monday, the first trading day after its board said it would investigate CEO Jensen Hua
content:
The race is on to sue Nvidia | TechCrunch
Image Credits:Justin Sullivan / Getty Images
2:23 PM PST · November 9, 2026
Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% on Monday, the first trading day after its board said it would investigate CEO Jensen Huang over his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive U.S. intelligence believes was spying for China.
Securities lawyers were already moving. At least four firms, including Schall, Brown & Schwartz and Levi & Korsinsky, announced investigations Monday into whether Nvidia misled investors. Robert Bartlett, a Stanford Law professor and securities law expert, expects them to have plenty of company.
“I would definitely wager that there’ll be a filing,” Bartlett said in an interview Monday morning, adding that he wouldn’t be surprised if a case had been filed by the end of the day. Plaintiffs’ lawyers have good reasons to be first in line; under federal securities law, the first complaint triggers a public notice, and investors then have 60 days to ask the court to be named lead plaintiff. A firm that files early gets a head start on signing up investors with large losses, as well as on shaping the story of the case. Bartlett was right, in fact. A case surfaced Monday afternoon in the Northern District of California, where Nvidia is headquartered.
Rosen Law Firm, a New York-based plaintiffs’ firm that specializes in securities class actions, filed it on behalf of Mark Kistenmacher, a retail investor who made seven purchases totaling roughly $20,500 this year, according to a schedule attached to the complaint. (Rosen was lead counsel in a $250 million settlement with Alibaba and ranks among the most active filers of such cases.) The proposed class covers anyone who bought Nvidia securities between Oct. 9, 2025, and Nov. 8, 2026, and the suit names both Nvidia and Huang.
The complaint accuses them of misleading investors about Huang’s ties to Megaspeed, the Singapore-based data center outfit where Alice Huang was considered a top exec, and it points to three statements as proof: Nvidia spokesperson John Rizzo’s late-October claim that Huang’s interactions with Alice Huang were “not unusual or unexpected,” the company’s even earlier claim that it found “no evidence of diversion” of its chips, and Jensen Huang’s Oct. 30 comment to Bloomberg that Nvidia’s dealings with Megaspeed were “normal and not unusual.”
All three were false or misleading, the suit says, because Huang was having an affair with Alice Huang. Kistenmacher is asking for unspecified damages, interest and attorneys’ fees, and he wants a jury trial.
While much remains unknown, the legal theory here doesn’t depend on anything the board’s investigation may turn up about Huang’s private life. When The New York Times first reported on Huang’s ties to Alice Huang last month, Rizzo really did tell the Times that the relationship was “not unusual or unexpected.” Rizzo separately told another outlet, The Hill, that “Megaspeed has been no different than many other regional cloud customers. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year.”
Of course, the world now knows that was not true. Worse, the Times reports that U.S. intelligence had been monitoring Alice Huang for more than a year.
From a securities perspective, Bartlett said, the company’s earlier statement was “clearly a misleading statement.” And because Huang is CEO, Bartlett said, “his knowledge gets imputed to the company.” In other words, Nvidia is treated as having known what its chief executive knew.
The Kistenmacher complaint makes the same argument.
Bartlett predicted a “classic fraud on the market” claim, in which investors argue they paid prices that reflected false or incomplete public information, and lost money when the truth emerged. This early lawsuit relies on that theory, and Monday’s drop of $7.97 per share, or 4.27%, gives the attorneys involved a lot to work with. Damages in such cases are tied to the stock’s decline, and Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world, so you can imagine a settlement could prove exceedingly expensive.
That means a large payment from the company and its directors-and-officers insurers, but typically no personal consequences for the CEO or the board. It is also a civil matter, so Huang isn’t facing prison over it. The irony, as Bartlett noted, is that the suit is brought in the name of Nvidia’s shareholders, and shareholders ultimately pay for the settlement, directly or through insurance premiums.
Bartlett sorted Nvidia’s wider exposure into buckets. The first is the securities fraud claim, which is the clearest immediate problem for the company and potentially for Huang. The second is governance: what the board knew and when. It’s possible directors were kept in the dark, but the board also has oversight duties, and once the Times began reporting on the Megaspeed connection, the company should have had reporting lines to bring a critical risk like this to directors. If it didn’t, or if directors didn’t act, board-level liability is possible.
A third category, one that would change everything, would arise only if the board’s investigation finds Huang knew about the intelligence connection. That would be “a whole other ball game,” as Bartlett said. (The board said in a statement to the public Sunday that it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised.)
There’s also the question of government action. The SEC can seek an officer-and-director bar for intentional securities-fraud violations, which Bartlett said is technically on the table. But he doubts the current SEC under Chairman Paul Atkins would have the appetite, given President Trump’s support for Huang. A roughly two-year clock after discovery of the facts would leave room for a future administration to act, but the window would be tight, and Bartlett posited that’s pretty unlikely when asked about it.
It’s worth underscoring that neither law firm announcements nor this newly filed complaint is a sign of a strong case. Plaintiffs’ firms are quick to publish these notices when they see an opportunity. Which firm winds up leading the case is decided later by the court, and that decision usually depends on which investor has suffered the biggest loss. Kistenmacher said in his filing that he’s willing to serve as lead plaintiff, but the court will ultimately choose among the competing investors. No doubt they’ll materialize soon.

content:
特朗普称联邦调查局正在调查英伟达首席执行官黄与涉嫌间谍的恋情科技新闻|半岛电视台
特朗普表示，联邦调查局正在调查英伟达首席执行官黄与社交媒体上涉嫌间谍的恋情
2026 年 10 月 8 日，Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋在华盛顿特区和平研究所举行的一次活动中聆听美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的讲话 [文件：Julia Demaree Nikhinson/美联社照片]
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，联邦调查局正在调查英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名被指控为中国情报部门工作的女性的关系。
特朗普周一在白宫发表讲话时表示，在黄承认与一位名叫爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)的中国高管发生婚外关系后，执法部门已开始调查。
清单 1（共 4）特朗普在致电有关间谍丑闻后为 Nvidia 的黄仁勋辩护
清单 2（共 4 个）美国最高法院允许大弯国家公园修建边境墙
list 3 of 4随着弹劾案临近，特朗普、卢比奥为赫格塞斯辩护
名单 4 名美国国会议员提交弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯决议
“我们会调查此事。我知道联邦调查局正在从其他方面调查此事，”特朗普在新闻发布会上对记者说。 “我认为他的状态会很好。”
特朗普表示，黄早些时候告诉他，他“完全不知道”这名女子是一名所谓的情报人员。
“他说，‘我不知道她是间谍’，我真的相信他，”特朗普说。
当记者问及他何时第一次意识到对两国关系的担忧时，特朗普表示“不久前”。
美国总统表示：“一段时间以来，我一直听说过这件事，也读到过一些相关内容。”
主导人工智能高端芯片市场的英伟达没有立即回应半岛电视台的置评请求。
英伟达周日宣布，已对其首席执行官与新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 的关系展开调查，此前有媒体报道援引美国情报部门的说法，称她曾在中国国家安全部工作。
英伟达董事会表示，没有理由相信国家安全或公司机密受到损害，但由外部法律顾问监督的独立调查将检查“所有可用信息”。
黄在另一份声明中承认存在婚外关系，并向家人、同事和股东道歉，并承诺全力配合董事会的调查。
黄的承认是在《纽约时报》和《金融时报》上周报道称，未具名的美国官员撰写了一份备忘录，声称他已成为爱丽丝·黄进行情报收集活动的目标。
中国外交部周一否认了这些指控，发言人郭家坤表示，这些报道是“毫无根据的猜测，是对中国的抹黑”。
与黄仁勋没有关系的爱丽丝·黄尚未对这些说法公开发表评论。
总部位于加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉的 Nvidia 是全球人工智能竞赛中的关键参与者，控制着用于运行前沿模型的图形处理单元 (GPU) 约 80% 至 90% 的市场。
全球市值最高的公司之一英伟达 (Nvidia) 股价周一下跌 4.27%，收于 178.67 美元。

Trump says FBI probing Nvidia CEO Huang’s affair with alleged spy | Technology News | Al Jazeera
Share Trump says FBI probing Nvidia CEO Huang’s affair with alleged spy on social media
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang listens as US President Donald Trump speaks during an event at the Institute of Peace in Washington, DC, on October 8, 2026 [File: Julia Demaree Nikhinson/AP Photo]
United States President Donald Trump has said the FBI is probing Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a woman accused of working for Chinese intelligence services.
Speaking at the White House on Monday, Trump said law enforcement had begun inquiries following Huang’s admission that he engaged in an extramarital relationship with a Chinese executive named Alice Huang.

list 3 of 4Trump, Rubio defend Hegseth as impeachment bid nears
list 4 of 4US congressman files resolution to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
“We’ll look into it. I know the FBI is looking into it in terms of something else,” Trump told reporters at a news conference. “I think he will be in good shape.”
Trump said Huang told him earlier that he had “absolutely no idea” that the woman was an alleged intelligence agent.
“He said, ‘I had no idea that she was a spy,’ and I really believe him,” Trump said.
Asked by a reporter when he first became aware of concerns about the relationship, Trump said it was “not too long ago”.
“I have been hearing about it and I have been reading a little bit about it over a period of time,” the US president said.
Nvidia, which dominates the market for high-end chips used to power artificial intelligence, did not immediately respond to Al Jazeera’s request for comment.
Nvidia on Sunday announced that it had opened a probe into its CEO’s relationship with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed, following media reports that cited US intelligence claiming she worked for China’s Ministry of State Security.
Nvidia’s board of directors said it had no reason to believe that national security or company secrets were compromised, but that an independent inquiry overseen by outside counsel would examine “all available information”.
In a separate statement admitting to an extramarital relationship, Huang apologised to his family, colleagues and shareholders, and pledged to cooperate fully with the board’s inquiry.
Huang’s admission came after the New York Times and the Financial Times last week reported that unnamed US officials had authored a memo alleging that he had been targeted by Alice Huang for intelligence-gathering activities.
China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday rejected the allegations, with spokesperson Guo Jiakun saying the reports were “groundless speculation, and a smear against China”.
Alice Huang, who is not related to Jensen Huang, has not publicly commented on the claims.
Nvidia, based in Santa Clara, California, is a critical player in the global AI race, controlling an estimated 80 to 90 percent of the market for graphics processing units (GPUs) used to run frontier models.
Shares of Nvidia, one of the world’s most valuable companies, fell 4.27 percent on Monday to close at $178.67.

content:
美国高级特使表示，在韩的美国公司应该在“公平竞争环境”上竞争韩联社
Pinterest 链接至 Tumblr Reddit Facebook Messenger
首尔11月10日电（韩联社）——美国驻首尔高级特使周二表示，在韩国的美国公司应该在“公平的竞争环境”上竞争，此前一天，首尔反垄断监管机构宣布决定对滥用市场主导地位的电子商务巨头Coupang Corp.处以罚款。
米歇尔·斯蒂尔大使在韩美关系论坛主办的论坛上发表上述言论。华盛顿的议员联盟多次对首尔的监管和其他可能影响在这个亚洲国家运营的美国公司的措施提出质疑。
“正如我们两国总统去年所承诺的那样，在韩的美国公司应该在公平的竞争环境中竞争，”斯蒂尔说。 “这始于更好地了解彼此。”
Steel 没有提及在美国上市的 Coupang 公司的名字。
美国驻韩国大使米歇尔·斯蒂尔在韩美同盟主办的论坛上发表讲话2026年11月10日，议员联盟在首尔举行。（韩联社）
周一，韩国公平贸易委员会宣布决定对 Coupang 处以 3008 亿韩元（2.23 亿美元）的罚款，对配送应用程序 Baemin 的运营商 Woowa Brothers Corp. 处以 3311 亿韩元的罚款，指控它们滥用市场主导地位来限制竞争。
斯蒂尔在公开讲话中多次强调她致力于确保在韩国经营的美国公司不受歧视，包括在五月份参议院确认听证会上的讲话。
在论坛上，大使还指出韩国承诺将国防开支增加至国内生产总值（GDP）的3.5%。
她说：“未来几周，你们的预算决定也将使韩国更接近将国防开支提高到GDP的3.5%的承诺。”她指的是国民议会计划通过明年的政府预算法案。
此外，这位大使还评论了韩国承诺在美国投资 3500 亿美元，作为去年双边贸易和投资协议的一部分，她称该协议将为首尔-华盛顿联盟带来“一代人一次的升级”。
她说：“我们不仅是安全盟友，也是不可或缺的经济伙伴。” “我们不仅要一起走，还要一起成长。”
在同一论坛上，首尔外交部第二副部长金吉娜强调了与将于明年本月中期选举后成立的新一届美国国会合作的重要性。
“联盟的真正力量并不在于政治环境的变化，”金说。 “尽管发生了这些变化，关键在于共同努力保持共同的利益和承诺。”

SEOUL, Nov. 10 (Yonhap) -- The top U.S. envoy in Seoul said Tuesday that American companies in South Korea deserve to compete on a "level playing field," a day after Seoul's antitrust regulator announced a decision to fine e-commerce giant Coupang Corp. for abusing its market dominance.
Ambassador Michelle Steel made the remarks during a forum hosted by the Korea-U.S. Parliamentarians' Union as Washington has repeatedly taken issue with Seoul's regulatory and other steps that could affect U.S. companies operating in the Asian country.
"As our two presidents committed (to this last year), American companies in Korea deserve to compete on a level playing field," Steel said. "That starts (with) understanding each other better."
Steel did not mention Coupang, the U.S.-listed firm, by name.
U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel speaks during a forum hosted by the Korea-U.S. Parliamentarians' Union in Seoul on Nov. 10, 2026. (Yonhap)
On Monday, South Korea's Fair Trade Commission announced the decision to fine Coupang 300.8 billion won (US$223 million) and Woowa Brothers Corp., the operator of the delivery app Baemin, 331.1 billion won, accusing them of abusing their market-dominant positions to limit competition.
Steel has repeatedly stressed her commitment to ensuring that U.S. firms operating in South Korea are not discriminated against in her public remarks, including those during her Senate confirmation hearing in May.
At the forum, the ambassador also pointed out South Korea's pledge to increase its defense spending to 3.5 percent of its gross domestic product (GDP).
"In the coming weeks, your budget decisions will also bring Korea closer to its commitment to raise defense spending to 3.5 percent of GDP," she said, referring to the National Assembly's plan to pass next year's government budget bill.
In addition, the ambassador commented on South Korea's commitment to investing US$350 billion in the U.S. as part of last year's bilateral trade and investment agreement, which she cast as a deal that delivered a "once-in-a-generation upgrade" to the Seoul-Washington alliance.
"We are not only security allies but indispensable economic partners," she said. "We must not only go together but grow together."
During the same forum, Seoul's Second Vice Foreign Minister Kim Jina underscored the importance of cooperation with the new U.S. Congress that will be launched next year following this month's midterm elections.
"The true power of the alliance does not lie in the change of the political environment," Kim said. "It lies in working together to keep shared interests and commitments despite such changes."

title: 美国商务部就芯片展开的调查在英伟达介入后中止
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: ANA SWANSON, DEVLIN BARRETT2026年11月10日 英伟达周日表示，已对黄仁勋展开调查。此前，他承认曾与一家涉嫌向中国走私芯片的新加坡公司的高管有过亲密关系。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times 美国商务部的调查人员花费数月时间，深入调查一家涉嫌将英伟达人工智能芯片走私到中国的新加坡公司，但在去年年底，相关工作突然中止。 调查的焦点是数据中心公司Megaspeed。该公司由一名曾与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有过亲
content:
ANA SWANSON, DEVLIN BARRETT2026年11月10日
英伟达周日表示，已对黄仁勋展开调查。此前，他承认曾与一家涉嫌向中国走私芯片的新加坡公司的高管有过亲密关系。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times
美国商务部的调查人员花费数月时间，深入调查一家涉嫌将英伟达人工智能芯片走私到中国的新加坡公司，但在去年年底，相关工作突然中止。
调查的焦点是数据中心公司Megaspeed。该公司由一名曾与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有过亲密关系的高管领导，美国官员如今认为，这名高管是中国间谍。
但去年，这起案件突然被移交司法部。此前，负责此案的商务部调查人员收到英伟达总法律顾问的一封电子邮件，询问有关Megaspeed调查的信息。
商务部调查人员在办案过程中与涉案企业的代表沟通相关问题本不是什么稀奇事。但这封邮件的内容却非同寻常。英伟达总法律顾问蒂姆·泰特说，商务部高级官员杰夫·凯斯勒已允许英伟达就此事联系。
调查人员感到警觉的是，英伟达提到了他们的上级凯斯勒的名字，而凯斯勒是由特朗普总统提名担任该职位的。据现任和前任政府官员及其他了解此事的人士说，一些人认为凯斯勒与英伟达的接触违反了政府程序，并可能影响案件调查的公正性。
目前尚不清楚是什么促使泰特联系商务部。但最近曝光的黄仁勋承认与Megaspeed一名高管有染的消息使英伟达在影响美国对华芯片销售政策方面所扮演的角色受到更严格的审视。《纽约时报》上个月报道，美国政府已认定，该公司高管黄乐（音，其英文名为Alice Huang）是为中国政府工作的间谍。
周日，英伟达表示，在黄仁勋向公司董事会承认与黄乐有过亲密关系后，已对他展开调查。两人曾多次被拍到在一起，包括与其他科技企业高管共同出现在台湾的酒吧和餐厅。
这起事件引发了外界的质疑：直接向商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克汇报的凯斯勒究竟与英伟达讨论了什么？双方的谈话本身也可能受到进一步调查。
一些官员表示，凯斯勒或许并非有意如此，但他的做法使自己面临受到不当影响的指责，也可能危及商务部对Megaspeed的调查。
这些人说，案件很快被移交司法部，以避免政府对Megaspeed的调查受到任何潜在损害。据知情人士透露，司法部正在对Megaspeed进行刑事调查。
司法部发言人说，该机构不对正在进行的调查置评。商务部发言人说，该部一直大力执行有关规定，此案及其他执法行动都严格依照程序进行。
英伟达发言人约翰·里佐说，公司会与官员磋商，“回答他们的问题，提供我们从一线收集的信息，征求他们的指导和指示，并询问他们是否有需要进一步了解的问题。”
他补充说，公司致力于“协助政府和合作伙伴阻止潜在的走私活动，同时服务于合法客户这一重要市场，助力美国在全球竞争中取胜”。
2024年6月，黄仁勋与Megaspeed高管黄乐在台北的一场聚会上。NetThunder公司在领英上发布了这张照片。
Megaspeed的一名代表表示，公司正在对芯片转移流向的相关指控展开内部调查，并曾多次主动提出配合美国政府调查，但均未得到回应。
美国于2024年开始调查Megaspeed和黄乐，此前该公司开始向马来西亚进口价值数十亿美元的英伟达先进人工智能设备。Megaspeed一直在东南亚各地规划和建设数据中心，以服务中国客户，包括中国科技巨头阿里巴巴。尽管这种商业活动本身合法，但美国官员担心该公司购买的一些英伟达芯片被非法转运至中国。
美国通过出口管制限制向中国销售某些技术，禁止部分芯片出口到中国，并要求美国企业在销售其他一些芯片前取得许可证。英伟达一直反对这些管制措施，主张允许公司更自由地销售产品。
据知情人士透露，2025年8月，商务部工业与安全局负责调查此案的官员收到英伟达总法律顾问泰特的一封电子邮件。泰特在发给调查人员的信息中表示，凯斯勒已允许他就此案与调查人员联系。
一名商务部官员说，英伟达直接联系了这些员工，请求与其中一人会面。工作人员拒绝后，泰特回复这些员工，他不确定问题出在哪里，因为凯斯勒说过英伟达可以与工业与安全局员工沟通。
这名官员说，工作人员将往来邮件转发给凯斯勒。数小时后，凯斯勒回复说，他们应该继续严格按照规定程序办理此案。
这名官员表示，凯斯勒没有命令下属向英伟达披露信息，也没有干预调查人员决定接受哪些会面请求或披露哪些信息。
作为副部长，凯斯勒通常会与这类调查的更细节内容隔离，因为他可能被要求在该案中充当中立仲裁者。官员们说，如果商务部未来对Megaspeed采取法律行动，凯斯勒与英伟达的接触也可能被纳入诉讼证据开示程序，或成为传票要求披露的内容。
目前尚不清楚是否还有其他因素促使商务部决定暂停调查。作出这一决定的时间，也恰逢美国情报机构收集到后来用于认定黄乐为中国政府从事间谍活动的情报。2025年10月，特朗普曾听取简报，得知黄乐与黄仁勋存在亲密关系，并被怀疑是一名间谍，但总统决定不依据此情报采取任何行动。
司法部和商务部经常联合调查出口管制案件，但在涉及刑事犯罪和情报问题的案件中，司法部可以主导调查。司法部可以追究刑事责任，通常需要达到更高的举证标准；商务部则可以实施包括罚款在内的民事处罚。
但官员们表示，此案从商务部移交出去的方式不同寻常，令人担忧。
几名要求匿名讨论这一高度敏感问题的官员质疑，商务部为什么与仍有可能成为调查对象的英伟达讨论此案。
在泰特发来邮件后，商务部官员召开会议讨论此事，并迅速向合作执法机构做了通报。一名知情人士表示，司法部要求商务部暂停调查工作，商务部照办了。
这一结果令调查Megaspeed的执法人员感到沮丧，他们已经花费数月时间搜集证据、构建案件。这也可能使商务部错失了更早采取行动、阻止向Megaspeed运送相关产品的机会。
商务部内外的一些政府官员此前就对特朗普政府过于迁就英伟达感到担忧。英伟达是推动美国人工智能产业增长和股市上涨的重要力量。黄仁勋在出口管制政策上对特朗普和商务部长卢特尼克都具有重要影响力，而商务部负责管理美国技术出口。
特朗普政府（包括司法部在内）也一直认为，联邦政府应避免作出妨碍美国企业主导人工智能行业的监管或执法决定。英伟达的芯片是推动该行业发展的重要力量。
自特朗普重返白宫以来，凯斯勒及商务部其他领导人规定，任何涉及英伟达的调查，以及与该公司的其他接触，都必须事先获得他们批准。直接向卢特尼克汇报的凯斯勒还对该部发放的许可证保持严格控制，其中许多涉及英伟达技术，并对商务部与该公司的沟通实行严格管理。
虽然其他机构曾提议将Megaspeed列入实体清单，也就是由商务部管理的贸易黑名单，但商务部一直没有采取行动。该部已一年多没有将任何公司列入实体清单，这是18年来未新增实体的最长间隔。

Kenya: Ruto Warns Kenyans Against Gambling With the Country's Future By Electing Opposition
Nairobi — President William Ruto has urged Kenyans not to gamble with the country's future by electing opposition leaders, challenging his political rivals to demonstrate their development plans instead of relying on criticism and political rhetoric.
Ruto said Kenyans should not entrust the country's leadership to politicians who, in his assessment, lack clear plans for addressing the challenges facing the nation.
Speaking during an Interdenominational church service in Nyamira County, the President questioned whether his political competitors understood the country's development priorities, arguing that voters should assess leaders based on their agendas, plans and vision.
"Every leader must be measured by their plan, their agenda and their vision for our nation," Ruto said.
Follow us on WhatsApp | LinkedIn for the latest headlines
He warned Kenyans against what he described as political gambling, insisting that the country should not risk reversing the development programmes his administration had initiated.
"Do not allow anyone to gamble with the future of our country. Do not take chances with the affairs of our nation," he told congregants.
The President challenged opposition leaders to explain how they would address the high cost of living, unemployment, infrastructure gaps and challenges facing the education and agricultural sectors.
He said Kenyans were looking for practical solutions, including lower transport costs through improved roads, affordable education, reduced fertiliser prices, better returns for farmers and employment opportunities for young people.
"That is what Kenyans want," he said, adding that political leaders should explain how they intended to tackle these challenges rather than relying on political noise.
Ruto also defended his administration's development record, citing investments in roads, education, healthcare, electricity connectivity and agricultural reforms.
In the tea sector, he announced that the government had allocated Sh1.2 billion to support the modernisation of factories in the West of the Rift Valley, where farmers have historically received lower average prices and bonuses compared to their counterparts in the East of the Rift.
He said additional funding would be provided in the next budget to improve factory productivity and narrow the earnings gap between tea farmers in the two regions.
"The tea issue did not begin when I became president; it has existed for years. But I decided that as president, I will solve that problem to ensure equality," he said.
On education, Ruto said the government had employed 100,000 teachers and was working on a new university funding law that would prevent students from being sent home because their parents could not afford fees.

He said the proposed legislation would be completed before Parliament breaks in December, allowing implementation from January.
The President also cited the Social Health Authority (SHA), saying 1,381 people had registered under the scheme in Nyamira and arguing that the new healthcare system was expanding access beyond Kenyans with formal employment.
On infrastructure, he announced KSh11 billion for the construction of 180 kilometres of tarmac roads in Nyamira County, alongside plans for a new Sh1.7 billion Level 5 hospital and an international stadium funded with Sh1 billion.
He further cited ongoing plans for markets, a university and an industrial park as part of the government's development agenda for the region.
Ruto called on residents to support continuity of the development programmes, asking whether they wanted the government to proceed with its projects or allow politics characterised by division and tribalism to take centre stage.
"I ask you, people of Nyamira: do we continue with this development work, or do you want incitement, noise and tribalism brought here?" he posed.
The President maintained that Kenya needed leaders capable of presenting concrete proposals for the country's future, insisting that political competition should be based on ideas and the ability to deliver.

content:
Sudan's Suffering Is Plain for All to See Say Aid Teams, As Brutal War Continues - allAfrica.com
Sudan's Suffering Is Plain for All to See Say Aid Teams, As Brutal War Continues
The war in Sudan has created extreme levels of displacement, both internally and across Sudan’s borders.
Aid teams working to help millions of people uprooted by the ongoing war in Sudan appealed on Friday for more international assistance amid desperate funding shortages, empty warehouses and overwhelming needs.
A staggering 15.4 million people urgently require shelter across the country, where war that erupted in April 2023 between former allies turned rival military forces is deepening the suffering of civilians.
"Just yesterday, we had 16 trucks arriving in Darfur, but they were just the last that we had in our stocks. We are facing serious problems. Our supplies are running out," said Mohamed Refaat, Chief of mission in Sudan for the UN migration agency, IOM, speaking from Khartoum.
Aid access to vulnerable displaced and returning people is better than it was, meaning that "we can reach more people", the veteran humanitarian officer noted.
Keep up with the latest headlines on WhatsApp | LinkedIn
But "this means also that we can listen to the stories of their suffering...We cannot say that we don't know".
Shifting front lines also continue to force more families to flee their homes, leaving many without anywhere safe to sleep or even a blanket to stay warm, insisted Abubakarr Jalloh, UN refugee agency (UNHCR)'s Deputy Representative in Sudan, speaking via video from Khartoum.
"For a woman who has lost everything, a tent is more than just a shelter; it means the difference between sleeping in the open, surrounded by strangers and having a space of her own. It means dignity. It is privacy. And it is safety for that woman and family."
For people displaced by conflict, "a solar lamp is more than just a source of light, it is safety," Mr. Jalloh continued.
"It means a woman can reach a latrine at night without walking in darkness. A kitchen set is also more than a collection of household items. It means a mother can cook for children, without exposing herself to the unnecessary risk."
In a joint statement issued on Friday, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) and the International Organization for Migration (IOM) stressed that humanitarian agencies can only assist around one in 10 of those in need because of funding shortages today.
Three in four internally displaced people in Sudan are women and children, Mr. Jalloh said, adding that El Niño-related weather conditions have made people more vulnerable because of significantly below-average rainfall across Sudan this year.
This has affected harvests in Darfur, Kordofan and other areas already devastated by ongoing fighting. Although food prices would normally ease after the harvest season, prices remain "painfully high", the UNHCR official said.
"For a family that has lost everything, every Sudanese pound spent on food is money that cannot be spent on a blanket or on materials needed for safe shelter," Mr. Jalloh stressed.
