content: 【大纪元2026年11月08日讯】（大纪元记者程木兰、骆亚采访报导）中共全国人大常委会11月6日通过“反跨境腐败法”，同日生效。北京把海外追逃追赃纳入常设机制，由国家监察委员会统筹，并收紧外方在中国境内调查取证。专家警告，在中共主导查办的体制下，这套机制可被用来追查失势官员的海外资产，也为境外“劝返”和政治施压异议人士提供新名目。 北京把“猎狐”“天网”纳入常设机制 中共于10月26日至29日在北京召开二十届五中全会宣告“全面从严治党”，并有多位官员遭开除党籍。随后于十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议11月6日表决通过《反跨境腐败法》，公布之日起施行。 中国问题专家王赫接受大纪元采访时指出，防堵资金外流，尤其是防止国有资产藉利益输送流往境外，是北京扩大追查权的一个动机。 他分析，过去的“猎狐”“天网”主要靠专案推进。中共这次把分散的涉外规定和部门权责集中起来，由国家监察委员会牵头，让公安、财政、审计和反洗钱部门能在同一机制下共享线索。 资深评论员横河则注意到，新法通过当天即生效，有别于往常惯例。他推测这部法是为了惩罚某个人或某些人，“抓人时还没有足够的法律可用来惩罚，所以急需立新法”。 中国大陆前检察官沈良庆也把立法时点与中共二十届五中全会重申“从严治党”相连，视为这项党内政策的立法配套。他向大纪元表示，中共在缺少引渡协议的地方往往只能逐案协商，既有行动的成效受到限制。 中共新法上路前，当局依《监察法》请求外国协助引渡嫌疑人、追回涉案资产。新法上路后，涉案行为是否构成犯罪，仍按中共《刑法》判断。 据新华社今年2月底转述中纪委工作报告，中共官方2025年立案查处505件跨境腐败案件，并透过“天网”等行动追回963名外逃人员。 反腐法律成为权斗工具？ 王赫用“看人下菜”形容中共的选择性反腐，“不是看你做了什么，是看你是什么样的人。” 他认为，在中共领导反腐工作的架构下，“政治忠诚”和站队仍可能左右谁被立案、谁被保护。对当局有意保护的高官，他担忧海外资产线索可能以机密为由被搁置。对政治对手，北京则能动员更多部门追查资金、寻求境外协助。他预判，新法将“成为权力斗争的一个合法化的工具”。 中国大陆律师章廷（化名）把问题追溯到中共制定法律的方式。他接受大纪元采访时以“帮规”和“家法”形容这套法律，认为立法缺乏民众充分参与和真正授权，制定和执行法律的考量，往往是维持中共统治与保护特权阶层。 他认为，在中共体制下，若案件未牵涉权斗，新法对在任或退休高官及其家属的影响可能有限。 章廷指出，权力缺乏制衡所造成的腐败，很难靠再立一部法律解决。他把这类反腐形容为“清洗的手段，是权斗的延伸”。 沈良庆则把反腐与权斗交织、选择性执法的现象称为“制度性的老大难痼疾”。在他看来，新法对官员及其家属向境外转移涉案资产，或有一定约束，但公权力缺乏制衡的问题始终存在。 高官家属的海外资产能否被追及？ 王赫认为，财政、审计与反洗钱部门共享线索后，当局更容易追查中低层外逃官员及国企高管的资金流向。若资产所在国愿意合作，冻结涉案财产也较有可能。 至于高层官员和家属，他认为新法的约束力“非常有限”。即使财产登记在亲属名下，追缴仍涉及两个关口。中国境内须启动查办并厘清资产与违法所得的关联，境外的查账、冻结或返还则须由当地依法律程序处理。 王赫认为，北京可向关系较密切的国家寻求协助，例如中东或东南亚部分国家，请求冻结涉案资产。横河则强调，外国原本就不愿协助的案件，未必会因北京有了新法而改变立场。 欧洲人权法院2022年曾就波兰拟将一名因被控涉嫌跨国电信诈欺而引渡至中国的嫌疑人，裁定其有遭受不当待遇的实际风险，移交将违反《欧洲人权公约》。国际刑警组织（INTERPOL）也说明，各国是否依红色通报采取逮捕行动，仍依本国法律决定。 北京反制外国调查 跨国企业夹在中间 新法允许北京在认定外国不当行使域外管辖、损害中国利益等条件下采取反制措施，也要求外方在中国境内展开反腐执法调查，以及境内机构向境外提供相关证据或资料，须经中方同意。 沈良庆认为，中共一方面要求出海企业加强合规，另一方面也藉反制条款牵制外国政府调查中国企业及官员。王赫以美国《海外反腐败法》（FCPA）为例指出，若外方要求一家跨国公司提交在中国掌握的文件，公司可能同时面对外方取证要求和中方限制。他形容这是“中美之间司法对抗的一个升级”。 中国民主活动家王丹在播客节目《王丹学堂》也以内部审计为例，指出跨国企业总部若要查核海外交易，而中共监管机关同时以跨境腐败为由要求取得审计资料，当地团队将面临两套要求而难以适从。 反腐名义将被用于跨境施压？ 横河指出，过去有些境外“劝返”透过跟踪、威胁或向境内家属施压，迫使当事人回中国。他担忧，新法会让这类行动更容易被北京包装成反腐执法。 美国司法部2025年4月16日公布，曾参与“猎狐”行动的纽约前警员麦克马洪（Michael McMahon），因非法充当中国政府代理人及跨州跟踪等罪名，被判入狱18个月。 王丹也认为，新法替争议性的境外行动“穿上了一件法律的外衣”。他特别质疑，法律涵盖部分行为发生在境外、结果落在中国境内的同类腐败行为，可能给执法机关留下扩张解释的空间。他以政治捐款、慈善捐款和学术交流为例，追问当局将如何划定正常资金往来与涉案交易的界线。 他担心，当局可能从海外异议人士与境内亲友的资金往来着手，将人列为案件关系人，再借经济调查施压。在王丹看来，这种不确定性，本身就可能造成寒蝉效应。

title: LUCAS Drones To Be Built In Containerized Robotic Micro Factories Designed To Be Forward Deployed
zh_title: LUCAS 无人机将内置于集装箱式机器人微型工厂中，旨在进行前沿部署
summary: 加州一家名为 Machina 的机器人公司获得了 900 万美元的奖励，用于开发集装箱系统，以机器人方式批量生产接近需求点的低成本无人作战攻击系统 (LUCAS) 机身。正如 TWZ 经常指出的那样，LUCAS 无人机以及类似的单向攻击武器在美国作战行动和军事规划中发挥着越来越重要的作用。 Machina 的获奖是五角大楼推动使用集装箱式 3D 打印和其他更靠近前线的先进制造系统的最新例子，以缩短可能严重退化的供应链
content:
加州一家名为 Machina 的机器人公司获得了 900 万美元的奖励，用于开发集装箱系统，以机器人方式批量生产接近需求点的低成本无人作战攻击系统 (LUCAS) 机身。正如 TWZ 经常指出的那样，LUCAS 无人机以及类似的单向攻击武器在美国作战行动和军事规划中发挥着越来越重要的作用。 Machina 的获奖是五角大楼推动使用集装箱式 3D 打印和其他更靠近前线的先进制造系统的最新例子，以缩短在重大冲突中可能严重退化的供应链。无人机的分散生产还使各单位能够更加灵活，并可以随时根据自己的特定需求定制自己的生产。例如，一个单元可以生产最适合即将到来的任务的多种设计变体，而不必使用它们所运送的任何东西。 Machina 创始人兼首席执行官 Ed Mehr 周五下午对 TWZ 表示，国防部有机工业基础现代化挑战赛的这份为期 18 个月的合同要求 Machina 证明其可以利用其 RoboCraftsman 系统在部署地点制造 LUCAS 无人机。在许多其他地区大规模生产它们的决定将在稍后做出。在爱德华兹空军基地进行飞行测试期间，由 Machina 的 RoboCraftsman 系统创建的 LUCAS 无人机六英尺半比例测试模型。
(Machina) 使用 3D 打印和其他先进制造技术进行无人机和组件的集装箱化生产是一个新兴行业。Machina 系统是围绕这一概念构建的快速增长的功能之一，尽管许多功能都专注于小型无人机。梅尔说，最初，该计划要求 Machina 在美国大陆的两个地点建立所谓的“边缘工厂”。然而，最终目标是能够将它们部署到科威特等国家的转发地点。梅尔告诉我们，边缘工厂由该公司的集装箱式 RoboCraftsman 制造单元组成。这是一个 20 英尺 x 36 英尺的系统，完全安装后重 120,000 磅，本质上是两个机械臂，根据各种要求使用还原制造方法用金属形成机身。有效负载重量、范围和其他因素被输入 nTop 公司设计的软件系统中，然后机械臂根据所需的规格将金属切割成所需的形状因数。 Machina 使用金属而不是许多无人机所用的复合材料，因为“它不仅更便宜，而且用途更广泛，而且现在可以使用像我们这样的自动化工艺进行加工，而复合材料都是通过手工铺层完成的，”Mehr 解释道。
下面的 Machina 视频展示了 RoboCraftsman 系统如何在输入的引导下形成金属来制造机身。Mehr 表示，这避免了使用模具和轧辊等设备，从而大大加快了流程并允许大规模生产。 “基本上，代理人工智能代理可以探索并生成具有不同参数的完全不同版本的机身，”梅尔提出。 “因为现在它已经参数化了，你只需更改参数，就可以得到另一个机身，然后评估该机身是否适合他们想要的要求。”这样，RoboCraftsman 系统“只需在软件中即可轻松生成 20、30、40、50 种不同的设计，

【原文 English Original】
A California robotics company called Machina has been issued a $9 million award for a containerized system to robotically mass-produce Low-Cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System (LUCAS) airframes close to the point of need. As TWZ has frequently noted , LUCAS drones, and one-way attack weapons like them, are playing an increasing role in U.S. combat operations and military planning. The award to Machina is the latest example of the Pentagon’s push to use containerized 3D printing and other advanced fabricating systems closer to the front lines to shorten supply chains that could get severely degraded in a major conflict. Decentralizing production of drones also allows units to be more flexible and tailor their own production to their specific needs at any given moment. For instance, a unit can produce variations of multiple designs that are best suited to an upcoming mission instead of having to use whatever they are shipped. (Machina) This 18-month contract from the Defense Department’s Organic Industrial Base Modernization Challenge calls for Machina to prove it can build LUCAS drones at deployed locations with its RoboCraftsman system, Ed Mehr, founder and CEO of Machina, told TWZ Friday afternoon. A decision on producing them at scale in many other locales will come later. A LUCAS drone six-foot half-scale test model created by Machina’s RoboCraftsman system during a flight test at Edwards Air Force Base. (Machina) Creating containerized production of drones and components using 3D printing and other advanced manufacturing techniques at the forward edge is a burgeoning industry. The Machina system is one of a rapidly growing number of capabilities built around this concept, although many focus on smaller drones. Building Drones Near The Point Of Need Initially, the plan calls for Machina to set up so-called “Edge Factories” at two locations in the continental United States, said Mehr. However, the ultimate goal is to be able to deploy them to forward locations in countries like Kuwait. The Edge Factories consist of the company’s containerized RoboCraftsman manufacturing cells, Mehr told us. A 20-foot by 36-foot system that weighs 120,000 pounds fully installed, it is essentially two robotic arms that form the airframe out of metal using reductive manufacturing based on a variety of requirements. Payload weight, range and other factors are punched into a software system designed by the nTop company and the robotic arms then cut the metal into the desired form factor based on the required specifications. Machina uses metal instead of composites that many drones are made out of because “not only it is cheaper, it is more widely available and now can be processed with an automated process like ours versus composites, which are all done by hand layup ,” Mehr explained. The following Machina video shows how the RoboCraftsman system, guided by the inputs, forms the metal to craft the airframe. This avoids having to use equipment like dies and rolls, dramatically speeding the process and allowing production at scale, Mehr stated. “Basically, the agentic AI agents can explore and generate whole different versions of an airframe with different parameters,” Mehr proffered. “Because now it’s parameterized, you can just change the parameters and you get another airframe, and then evaluate if that airframe is good for the requirement they want.” This way, the RoboCraftsman system “can easily generate 20, 30, 40, 50 different designs just in software, and then put it through simulations to figure out which one actually meets the requirement for that,” the Machina CEO added. “The concept is that we’re going to bring this capability closer to the point of need, so that you can build a different requirement for let’s say PACOM versus U.S. CENTCOM versus in Ukraine,” Mehr said. “They can easily switch and build a drone that they need.” Low-cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System (LUCAS) drones in the U.S. Central Command region. (CENTCOM) (U.S. Central Command Public Affairs) Under this contract, each Edge Factory will consist of one or two RoboCraftsman cells and each cell can make a LUCAS airframe in two to five days, depending on the size, Mehr said. A scaled deployment of 10 or more cells would take place under a new contract, he added. The systems can make “anywhere from a one-off all the way to the thousands, sometimes tens of thousands,” Mehr said. It all depends on the number of RoboCraftsman systems that are ordered. At the moment, Mehr envisions that each 12-foot airframe will cost “somewhere around $15,000 to $40,000,” depending on the complexity. This range is a relatively common price point for Russian Shahed-136 variants and U.S. knockoffs under the LUCAS program. The company has already produced a six-foot, half-scale airframe that was recently tested at Edwards Air Force Base, said Mehr. However, that initial test proved problematic. “The first design had some challenges with crosswind mitigation,” Mehr told us. “Since then, we have moved the location of the engine slightly to enable better crosswind mitigation, and now we’re running again. And the beauty is for us to go from one design to the next is just like a couple of months, a maximum of three months. Like we can just then try it again.” A six-foot, half-scale LUCAS drone, made by a Machina RoboCraftsman system, being tested at Edwards Air Force Base, California. (Machina) Mehr said that Machina is not working with SpektreWorks, which designed and made the LUCAS drones previously supplied to the U.S. military and already used in combat. SpektreWorks declined to comment. The Edge Factory contract is one of several Machina has been awarded to use these systems to help build and repair military hardware. In July, Machina was issued a qualification contract by Lockheed Martin to produce fuel tanks for AGM-158 Joint Air-To-Surface Standoff Missiles (JASSM). That plan called for the creation of a 200,000-square-foot facility “designed to house up to 50 RoboCraftsman cells and support high-rate production of mission-critical metal structures for defense programs including JASSM,” according to a media release at the time . “By integrating forming, machining, welding, and assembly under one roof, Machina Factory 3 compresses production timelines from months to days.” “Lockheed Martin Ventures invested in Machina Labs for its powerful combination of speed, flexibility, and scalability, and our teams have worked closely to transition key capabilities to production,” said Chris Moran, vice president and general manager, Lockheed Martin Ventures. “Machina’s work advances capacity, reduces risk, and helps ensure we can deliver mission-critical capabilities at scale. We congratulate Machina on this milestone as a supplier, which further strengthens an innovative and resilient American Defense Industrial Base.” U.S. Air Force Staff Sgt. Seth Blackwood, 363rd Training Squadron Aircraft Armament instructor, directs the installation of an AGM-158 JASSM onto a B-52 during a Combat Capability Demonstration April 16, 2024, at Sheppard Air Force Base, Texas. (U.S. Air Force photo by Rachel Ross) Rachel Ross Earlier this year, a Machina RoboCraftsman platform helped repair a C-17 Globemaster III cargo jet that was damaged during a tornado, Mehr told us. The system “fabricated a first-of-its-kind replacement part for the damaged C-17 without the need for dedicated tooling,” the company noted . “Machina deployed a RoboCraftsman at the RSO [ Rapid Sustainment Office ], where production for a left nose panel began in March 2026 and was completed in May 2026. The aircraft returned to flight on July 30, 2026 at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio.” Damage to a C-17 Globemaster III cargo jet caused by a tornado that was eventually repaired with a Machina RoboCraftsman system. (Machina) We asked the Pentagon for information about why they selected Machina and their metrics for success, but we have not heard back yet. Pentagon Pushing For Deployable Manufacturing The U.S. military has been pushing for several years for the employment of mobile additive and other forms of advanced manufacturing “to produce unmanned aircraft components in remote or austere environments and reduce dependence on traditional supply chains,” the Air Force’s innovation arm, AFWERX, noted last month . The idea is to place these systems in a wide array of locations, produce the quantity needed and tailor the airframe for the mission. In one such case, the Air National Guard and Air Force Special Operations Command partnered with the San Diego-based Firestorm company in 2023 “to create an expeditionary assembly unit capable of mass-producing unmanned aerial systems,” according to the Pentagon . The result was called an Expeditionary Manufacturing Cell or xCell. “It’s basically an expeditionary 3D printer,” Master Sgt. Richard Stone, 194th Air Support Operations Group innovation officer, explained at the time. “The basis of the technology is … it’s about the size of a [shipping container] and it can print out, for this specific use case, drones.” “Inside this [shipping container], it’ll print out all the components,” said Stone “But then you have what’s called RPA, which is robotic process [automation.]” The xCell “prints the individual pieces and then uses RPA to assemble the major components of the drone,” the Pentagon added. A render of Expeditionary Manufacturing Cell or xCell which is capable of mass-producing unmanned aerial systems. Theoretically, xCell can be hidden in plain sight while running on local resources to 3D-print items on the battle field. (Courtesy photo from Firestorm) 194th Wing “The user can take these components and, almost like Legos, put them together,” said Stone. “So if you want a longer drone with a specific payload, you can take those components and put them together and the computer will tell you, ‘This is where the wings go and this is where the center of gravity should be.” The company went on to produce Tempest drones that were flying with 3rd Littoral Combat Team, 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment, during Exercise Balikatan 2026 at Cagayan North International Airport in the Philippines, AFWERX noted. A Firestorm Tempest Drone with 3rd Littoral Combat Team, 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, is staged for preflight checks during Exercise Balikatan 2026 at Cagayan North International Airport, Lal-Lo, Philippines, April 23, 2026. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Ernesto Lagunes) Cpl. Ernesto Lagunes Our own Jamie Hunter recently interviewed Craig Anders, senior vice president of growth at Aevex, about the company’s ForgeX containerized 3D drone printing system . The ForgeX system “represents being able to take the fight further forward, print drones on demand, print them out towards the front of the lines, cut down the logistics trail, and absolutely revolutionize the battlefield,” said Anders.  The goal is to be “able to kick these planes out the door on short timelines to go out and get the missions done, work within the local area to make sure that the mission can be accomplished by any means necessary,” he added. Anders said the ForgeX printers fabricate three types of drones, the Vandal , Onyx and Raker . He added that the system can produce up to 880 a year. Growing U.S. Reliance On LUCAS The U.S. military first announced it had begun fielding LUCAS, which was reverse-engineered from the Iranian-designed Shahed-136 , in December 2025. This came just months after TWZ laid out a detailed case for why the U.S. military should start acquiring Shahed-136 clones in large volumes. LUCAS made its official combat debut in the opening phases of major combat operations against Iran earlier this year. The pusher-propeller, combustion-engine-powered kamikaze drones were first launched from the ground, a U.S. official told us at the time. They can also be fired from ships. In March, CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper told us the LUCAS drones were “indispensable. ” The following video shows Cooper answering our question about the LUCAS drones. CENTCOM Commander Brad Cooper on LUCAS: LUCAS is indispensable. pic.twitter.com/VaLXmjawA6 — Clash Report (@clashreport) March 5, 2026 Now the Army is looking to expand the use of these weapons to the Pacific, Maj. Gen. Bernard Harrington, head of the 7th Infantry Division, told us during the Association of the U.S. Army (AUSA) conference last month. “So we see that playing a key role in order to be able to achieve that effect at mass, … [and] in an affordable manner, while also being able potentially to preserve something that’s more exquisite for something that requires an exquisite munition.” “So as we start modeling out what it looks like to be able to penetrate a portion of the anti-access/area denial network in support of the joint task force in the PACOM [U.S. Pacific Command] area of operations, we started looking at, well, how do I bend – how do I achieve mass at a cost curve?” the 7th Infantry and MDC-PAC commander explained. “What effect am I really trying to achieve on a system in order to provide that window of opportunity for that joint force commander?” A map showing Chinese military outposts in the Spratly Islands at the southern end of the South China Sea. This gives a good sense of the anti-access/area denial bubbles that China has already established and continues to expand upon. (DOD) “So maybe I don’t necessarily need to sink a ship, but if I take out certain systems on that vessel, well then it creates this temporal window opportunity,” he continued. “Then that joint force commander can surge in that carrier strike group or bomber task force.” While the exact details of the LUCAS program requirements have been hard to pin down, it’s likely that multiple drone types from multiple manufacturers could become part of the program as time goes on. Ed Mehr gave us an idea of what that could look like: “Shahed clearly inspired LUCAS, which stands for Low-Cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System. But we shouldn’t confuse the inspiration with the destination. The future isn’t about mass-producing replicas of one drone. Different theaters and missions demand different performance, and therefore different designs. That could mean a LUCAS-style drone or a wide variety of Group 2 and Group 3 unmanned aircraft. The real breakthrough is making that diversity affordable. We’re developing flexible manufacturing technologies that can produce many different designs cost-effectively using one of the cheapest and most proven aerospace materials: sheet metal. It’s what aircraft have been built from for generations. We’re bringing it into an era where manufacturing can adapt as quickly as the mission.” We won’t know how the Machina contract ultimately pans out until sometime in mid-2028. Regardless, given the importance of both the LUCAS drones and deployable, additive and advanced manufacturing are becoming, this is likely a first step in what could be a whole new logistics concept that could underpin a significant portion of the growing LUCAS program. Contact the author: howard@twz.com The post LUCAS Drones To Be Built In Containerized Robotic Micro Factories Designed To Be Forward Deployed appeared first on TWZ .

title: Explainer: Hong Kong’s national security crackdown – month 76
zh_title: 解释者：香港的国家安全镇压——第 76 个月
summary: 十月份，香港进行国家安全审判，一名政治评论员在法庭上为自己辩护，指控他泄露与国家安全警察会面的细节，一名被判煽动叛乱罪的退休人员收到了强制入院令。与此同时，还推出了更多举措来提高国家安全意识，包括为学生提供人工智能赋能的学习平台，并向全市幼儿园发放图画书。香港最大的慈善机构之一还任命了国家安全导师，向服务使用者传播这一信息
content:
十月份，香港进行国家安全审判，一名政治评论员在法庭上为自己辩护，指控他泄露与国家安全警察会面的细节，一名被判煽动叛乱罪的退休人员收到了强制入院令。与此同时，还推出了更多举措来提高国家安全意识，包括为学生提供人工智能赋能的学习平台，并向全市幼儿园发放图画书。香港最大的慈善机构之一还任命了国家安全导师，向服务使用者和更广泛的社区传播这一信息。受审的政治评论员 被控泄露国家安全调查细节的香港政治评论员黄国银于 10 月中旬向法庭表示，警方并未就案件的保密性向他提出充分警告。笔名黄安贤的黄先生于 10 月 9 日在区域法院出庭接受首日审讯。这位代表自己的72岁老人自去年12月被捕以来一直被还押。黄国银，又名黄安贤。照片：On8 频道，来自 Facebook。黄被指控泄露与国家安全调查有关的信息，这是根据《维护国家安全条例》构成的犯罪行为，该条例是香港本土制定的安全法，在当地被称为第 23 条。
这项指控与 2025 年 12 月发生的一起事件有关，当时黄被国家安全警察带走，当天他准备出席有关宏福苑致命火灾的新闻发布会。黄和其他人准备讨论的话题包括建筑翻修和建筑项目不道德的招标程序——这些问题在火灾后曝光。新闻发布会最终被取消。随后，黄在两个 YouTube 视频中讲述了他与警方的会面，并在几天后被捕。警方国安局警长李伯谦10月9日作证称，他在会议期间向黄某作出声明，表示会议内容和调查细节属于机密，不能公开披露。黄说，李只是告诉他不能透露会议的细节，但没有说他甚至不能提及会议的发生。 2024 年 8 月 6 日，香港历史博物馆国家安全展览馆开幕仪式。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。他还说，他当时告诉李，国家安全部门约他开会的消息已经被当地媒体广泛报道。 10月27日，黄在法庭上证实，他确实在视频中说过，他在旺角警署见过这些警员，并描述了他们的年龄和外貌。
但他表示，在发布视频之前，他已经深思熟虑，并且他判断警方没有进行调查。黄说，他相信这次会议的目的只是让警方阻止新闻发布会的进行。一名男子在未经宣布逮捕数月后被指控 香港国安警察于 10 月初对一名 52 岁男子提出指控，罪名是在网上发布“煽动性”帖子，并在该男子未经宣布逮捕近三个月后才披露此案。警方国家安全部门表示，该男子被指控“故意出版具有煽动意图的出版物”，违反了《国家安全法》。

【原文 English Original】
October saw national security trials go on in Hong Kong while a political commentator defended himself in court over the charge of revealing details of a meeting with national security police and a retiree convicted of sedition received a mandatory hospital order. Meanwhile, more initiatives have been rolled out to promote national security awareness, including an AI-empowered learning platform for students and picture books that were sent out to kindergartens across the city. One of Hong Kong’s biggest charities also appointed national security tutors to spread the message among service users and the wider community. Political commentator on trial Hong Kong political commentator Wong Kwok-ngon, who has been charged with revealing details of a national security investigation, told the court in mid-October that the police did not fully caution him about the case’s confidentiality. Wong, known by his pen name Wong On-yin, appeared at the District Court on October 9 for the first day of his trial. The 72-year-old, who is representing himself, has been remanded in custody since his arrest in December last year. Wong Kwok-ngon, also known by his pen name Wong On-yin. Photo: On8 Channel, via Facebook. Wong was charged with divulging information related to a national security investigation – a crime under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, the city’s homegrown security law known locally as Article 23. The charge relates to an incident in December 2025 when Wong was taken in by national security police on the same day he was set to appear at a press conference about the fatal Wang Fuk Court fire. Wong and others were set to discuss topics including building renovations and unscrupulous tendering procedures for construction projects – matters which came to light in the wake of the blaze. The press conference was eventually called off. Wong then talked about his meeting with the police in two YouTube videos, and was arrested days later. Li Pak-him, a sergeant with the police’s National Security Department, testified on October 9 that he had given a declaration to Wong during the meeting stating that its contents and investigation details were confidential and could not be publicly disclosed. Wong said Li only told him he could not reveal details of the meeting, but did not say that he could not even mention that a meeting had occurred. Opening ceremony of National Security Exhibition Gallery at the Hong Kong Museum of History on August 6, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. He also said he told Li at the time that news of the National Security Department summoning him for a meeting had already been widely reported by local media. On October 27, Wong confirmed in court that he did say in his video that he met the officers at Mong Kok Police Station, and that he described their ages and appearances. But he said he had put in considerable thought before publishing the videos, and that it was his judgment that police were not carrying out an investigation. Wong said he believed the meeting’s purpose was just for officers to stop the press conference from going ahead. Man charged months after unannounced arrest Hong Kong national security police charged a 52-year-old man in early October with allegedly making “seditious” online posts, revealing the case nearly three months after his unannounced arrest. The police National Security Department said the man was charged with “knowingly publishing publications that had a seditious intention,” in violation of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, locally known as Article 23. West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. “Investigation revealed that the arrested man was suspected of repeatedly publishing posts with seditious intentions on online social platforms, with content provoking hatred towards Beijing, the Hong Kong government and judiciary,” police said in a statement. The man appeared at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on October 7 to face the charge, which carries a maximum penalty of seven years in prison, police said. Hospital order for ‘seditious’ display A 61-year-old woman was sentenced in mid-October to three months at a psychiatric hospital for displaying “seditious” signs on a wall outside her flat in Tin Shui Wai. West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts convicted Yang Chau-ki of sedition on October 16. Yang told the court one day earlier that she did not intend to incite others, and she simply wanted to express her dissatisfaction over a security guard working in her building. The retiree was accused of displaying seditious materials between March and November 2024. These included a colonial-era Hong Kong flag, a sign bearing the 2019 protest slogan “Liberate Hong Kong, Revolution of Our Times,” and another sign that read: “Expel the Communist Party, expel mainland garbage security guards.” Barriers outside West Kowloon Magistrates’ Court, in Hong Kong, on September 19, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Yang suffers from schizophrenia and delusional disorder, according to a court-ordered psychiatric report, but she said she understood the charge and legal procedure and was deemed fit to enter a plea. Principal Magistrate Don So said on Friday that he accepted Yang’s discontent toward the security guard. But he added that the meaning of the words she displayed went beyond that, effectively encouraging others to persist with their demands until the current system is overthrown, Ming Pao reported . National security books for toddlers The Security Bureau held a launch ceremony for its Andy and Security Bear: Young Citizens Safeguarding National Security educational picture books on October 27. The three-volume set of titles includes new stories and national security-themed children’s songs. They will be distributed to 900 kindergartens and public libraries by the end of the year. The Security Bureau held a launch ceremony on October 28, 2026 for their “Andy and Security Bear: Young Citizens Safeguarding National Security” educational picture books. Photo: GovHK. According to a press release, Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the “engaging storyline enables children to discover and learn the meaning of following rules and thinking critically, so that they can understand the importance of safeguarding national security from an early age.” The Security Bear series was launched by the bureau in 2024. A theatre show toured schools shortly after , with the Security Bear mascot telling children that their homeland must “remain free from disruption, allowing everyone to live in peace.” Charity appoints ‘national security tutors’  In early October, Po Leung Kuk, one of Hong Kong’s oldest and largest charities, appointed 16 staff members to serve as “national security tutors” under a government scheme to promote national security awareness among its workforce, service users, and members of the public. Senior service managers May Cheung and Sherman Cheung said at the Kuk’s “national security education team” launch ceremony that they volunteered to join as tutors. Headquarters of Po Leung Kuk. Photo: Po Leung Kuk. May Cheung said the team will not “force-feed” concepts of national security, but will instead spread awareness through celebrations like the Mid-Autumn Festival. AI-powered national security platform In early October, Hong Kong police launched an artificial intelligence-powered national security education platform for pupils. The NSmarties AI Interactive Platform was officially launched on October 6 at a ceremony at Precious Blood Primary School in Ap Lei Chau, with about 700 pupils attending, police said in a social media post . Police Commissioner Joe Chow said during the ceremony that the campaign aimed to “plant the seeds of national security in students’ hearts,” according to the post. Hong Kong police launch an AI-powered national security education platform for the city’s pupils during a ceremony on October 6, 2026. Photo: HKPF, via Facebook. The platform, jointly developed by police and Hong Kong Qianfan Technology, allows students to generate personalised stories centred on China’s “holistic approach to national security” – a framework advocated by President Xi Jinping that covers areas ranging from politics and the economy to ecology and technology. UK slammed over Hong Kong report Hong Kong authorities criticised the UK on October 23 for making “untruthful remarks, slanders and smears” about the city’s affairs in its latest six-monthly report that described the “expanding scope and application” of national security laws in the financial hub. The Hong Kong government said that it “strongly condemns and firmly rejects” the UK’s report on the city, a British colony before it was handed back to Chinese rule in 1997. A UK flag. Photo: Reinaldo Sture/Unsplash. “The [Hong Kong] Government strongly urges the UK again to discern facts from fallacies, respect the international law and basic norms governing international relations, and immediately stop its long-arm jurisdiction and interference in Hong Kong matters, which are purely China’s internal affairs,” the spokesperson added.

title: Hybrid War Makes High North a Contest for NATO
zh_title: 混合战争使高北地区成为北约的竞争
summary: 本文是关于北极新战略格局的 CEPA 系列的一部分。 “高北，低紧张”正在成为一个令人安慰的口号，而不是一个可信的策略。俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争、北约的北扩以及俄中合作的不断发展削弱了北极例外论。俄罗斯与北约的常规战争并非不可避免，但莫斯科可能会继续利用破坏、网络攻击、电子干扰和挑衅来挑战主权并考验盟国的决心。联盟面临的挑战是保卫高北地区免受故意保留的侵略
content:
本文是关于北极新战略格局的 CEPA 系列的一部分。 “高北，低紧张”正在成为一个令人安慰的口号，而不是一个可信的策略。俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争、北约的北扩以及俄中合作的不断发展削弱了北极例外论。俄罗斯与北约的常规战争并非不可避免，但莫斯科可能会继续利用破坏、网络攻击、电子干扰和挑衅来挑战主权并考验盟国的决心。该联盟面临的挑战是保卫高北地区免受故意控制在战争门槛以下的侵略。莫斯科的北极战略的核心是保护其核威慑力量、控制北方航道以及限制北约进入俄罗斯敏感领土。科拉半岛毗邻挪威和芬兰，是主要北方舰队和海基核资产的所在地，是实现这些目标的核心。乌克兰战争削弱了俄罗斯的一些常规能力，而芬兰和瑞典的加入北约则增强了莫斯科的暴露感，这两者的结合可能会鼓励俄罗斯更加依赖非对称行动。莫斯科还渴望通过在其他地方施加压力来转移西方对乌克兰的注意力和资源。传统上被削弱的俄罗斯并不一定意味着北极更安全。
原因之一是，距离遥远、气候恶劣和基础设施稀疏，使得莫斯科对北极的破坏难以察觉，而且修复成本高昂。水下电缆尤其脆弱。 9月，北约船只阻止了俄罗斯在斯瓦尔巴群岛附近的一次秘密行动，该行动涉及俄罗斯专门的深海指挥部GUGI和关键的电缆基础设施。涉事船只与北约船只遭遇后，没有收到任何损坏报告，但这一事件表明了战略破坏的可能性。这种威胁还延伸到陆上：针对港口、燃料库、电力基础设施和物流中心的纵火和破坏可能会扰乱民用服务和北约的增援，而使用代理行为者将使归因进一步复杂化。 GPS 干扰、欺骗和网络攻击也具有类似的作用。俄罗斯还可以调整北约东翼使用的战术，包括无人机入侵盟军领空，以测试北极的监视、响应时间和政治决心。北约 2026 年弹性基准要求认识到这些相互关联的漏洞，协调一致的电子、网络和物理攻击可能会放大其后果。研究船、渔船和商业平台也可以为监视或破坏准备提供掩护，关键基础设施周围的可疑行为需要进行审查。

This article forms part of a CEPA series on the new strategic landscape in the Arctic. “High North, low tension” is becoming a comforting slogan rather than a credible strategy. Russia’s war on Ukraine, NATO’s northern enlargement, and growing Russia-China cooperation have eroded Arctic exceptionalism . A conventional Russia-NATO war is not inevitable, but Moscow is likely to continue using sabotage, cyberattacks, electronic interference, and provocations to challenge sovereignty and test allied resolve. The alliance’s challenge is to defend the High North against aggression deliberately kept below the threshold of war. Moscow’s Arctic strategy centers on protecting its nuclear deterrent, controlling the Northern Sea Route, and restricting NATO’s access to sensitive Russian territory. The Kola Peninsula, which abuts Norway and Finland and is home to key Northern Fleet and sea-based nuclear assets, is central to these objectives. The war in Ukraine has weakened some of Russia’s conventional capabilities, while Finland and Sweden’s NATO accession has heightened Moscow’s sense of exposure , a combination that may encourage greater reliance on asymmetric operations. Moscow is also eager to divert Western attention and resources away from Ukraine by generating pressure elsewhere. A conventionally weakened Russia does not necessarily mean a safer Arctic. One reason is that vast distances, harsh weather, and sparse infrastructure make Arctic disruption by Moscow difficult to detect and expensive to repair. Underwater cables are particularly vulnerable. In September, NATO ships prevented a covert Russian operation near Svalbard involving GUGI, Russia’s specialized deep-sea directorate, and critical cable infrastructure. No damage was reported after the ships involved were confronted by NATO vessels, but the incident illustrated the potential for strategic disruption. The threat also extends onshore: arson and sabotage against ports, fuel depots, power infrastructure, and logistics hubs could disrupt civilian services and NATO reinforcement, while the use of proxy actors would further complicate attribution. GPS jamming, spoofing, and cyberattacks offer similar leverage. Russia could also adapt tactics used on NATO’s eastern flank, including drone incursions into allied airspace, to test surveillance, response times, and political resolve in the Arctic. NATO’s 2026 Resilience Baseline Requirements recognize these interconnected vulnerabilities, and coordinated electronic, cyber, and physical attacks could magnify their consequences. Research ships, fishing vessels, and commercial platforms can also provide cover for surveillance or sabotage preparations, and suspicious behavior around critical infrastructure demands scrutiny. Analysts have warned that hostile states use commercial and scientific operations as cover for threat activities in the Arctic. Svalbard in particular combines physical vulnerabilities with political pressure, and the Kremlin is using historical narratives, information operations, maritime pressure, and legal ambiguity to challenge Norwegian authority. Elsewhere, Moscow can exploit disputes over resources, environmental protection, and indigenous rights. While these concerns are legitimate, the threat lies in their deceptive manipulation and use to divide allies. Greenland presents a related challenge. Its geography, missile-warning infrastructure, and minerals make it strategically valuable, and the new US–Denmark–Greenland agreement combines an expanded American military presence with recognition of Danish sovereignty and Greenlandic self-determination. China adds another dimension. Growing Sino-Russian military and maritime cooperation in the Arctic is well documented, though their interests differ. While Moscow prioritizes control, Beijing wants access. NATO must take their cooperation seriously. Retreating sea ice has increased accessibility, but also exposure, and more traffic and infrastructure brings greater risks of accidents and confrontation. Unlike many other theaters, Arctic hybrid incidents may occur close to strategic nuclear forces, for whom a disrupted cable or satellite facility could be misread as preparation for a wider attack. For the Baltic states, this is no distant problem. North Atlantic reinforcement routes, Russia’s northern forces, and the Baltic theater form a connected strategic landscape. Defending the Baltic region and securing the High North are increasingly the same task. A stronger military posture is necessary, but troops alone cannot counter sabotage or electronic interference. NATO must detect hostile activity, withstand disruption, and impose consequences. For this task, Arctic-capable uncrewed systems can expand surveillance and improve early warning. Infrastructure protection, backup networks, and rapid repair also require cooperation with private operators and allied exercises testing simultaneous physical and cyber disruption. The decisive requirement is political, and will need to come through faster intelligence sharing, joint assessments, and pre-agreed response options. Diplomatic, economic, law-enforcement, cyber, and military instruments must give Allies choices beyond passive endurance or escalation. Uncertainty cannot become a permanent excuse for inaction. Equipment and logistics need to suit Arctic conditions, and crisis communications must help manage the risks near nuclear assets. Together, these measures should deny Moscow the expectation that hybrid aggression is cheap and safe. The Baltic, Central and Eastern European experience makes clear that recognizing hybrid aggression is not the same as deterring it. NATO’s defining Arctic test will be its response to an incident too serious to ignore, yet deliberately kept below the threshold of war. If that threshold becomes a shield against consequences, Moscow will keep exploiting it. What, then, should NATO do next? Three areas deserve a closer look without delay: satellite services and ground stations; access to critical infrastructure; and the ports, airfields, and fuel facilities on which northern reinforcement relies. They could all create opportunities for coordinated disruption during a crisis. NATO should examine where Russian probing or Chinese commercial and scientific access could expose these vulnerabilities, and whether allies could sustain operations if several vital nodes failed at once. 这些数据突显出，中国政府越来越依赖海外需求来支持因消费低迷和房地产长期低迷而陷入困境的经济。
不过，尽管全球人工智能投资热潮预计将在 2027 年保持对中国技术产品的强劲需求，但它可能会加剧国内失衡并加剧与欧盟 (EU) 等合作伙伴的贸易摩擦。
2026年10月14日，无人机拍摄的画面显示一艘货船驶近中国江苏省连云港港的集装箱码头。图片来自路透社

今年前10个月，中国贸易顺差达到1.04万亿美元，连续第二年突破1万亿美元大关，比2025年提前一个月达到这一里程碑。
不断膨胀的顺差可能会加剧与欧盟的紧张关系，在与北京达成协议，在未来几年限制中国向欧盟出口混合动力汽车后，欧盟领导人呼吁对中国实施更多贸易限制。
由于这些措施尚未生效，预计工厂将提前发货，从而在短期内提振出口。
中国于11月9日正式宣布将原定于11月10日到期的与华盛顿的贸易休战协议延长两个月，但上周表示，扩大对美国农产品的购买将取决于双方商定的互惠关税削减安排的实施。

China's trade surplus surged past US$1 trillion in the first 10 months as a global race to build artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure buoyed sales of high-tech products and helped offset weak domestic demand, a dynamic likely to sharpen tensions with major trading partners.
The figures highlight Beijing's growing reliance on overseas demand to support an economy hobbled by subdued consumption and a protracted property slump.
But while the global AI investment boom is expected to keep demand for Chinese technology products strong into 2027, it risks deepening domestic imbalances and fuelling trade frictions with partners including the European Union (EU).
A drone view shows a cargo ship approaching a container terminal at Lianyungang port, Jiangsu Province, China, Oct. 14, 2026. Photo via Reuters
Exports rose sharply by 35.2% in October from the same month in 2025 in U.S. dollar terms, customs data showed on Nov. 10, only a touch slower than the 36.3% surge in September, but ahead of economists' forecast for an increase of 33.5%.
That helped lift China's trade surplus to US$1.04 trillion in the first 10 months, topping US$1 trillion for a second consecutive year and reaching the milestone a month earlier than in 2025.
The swelling surplus could fuel further tensions with the EU, where leaders have called for more trade curbs with China after reaching an agreement with Beijing to limit Chinese exports of hybrid vehicles to the bloc over the next few years.
Because the measures have yet to take effect, factories are expected to bring forward shipments, bolstering exports in the near term.
China on Nov. 9 officially announced the extension of a trade truce with Washington due to expire on Nov. 10 by two months, but said last week that expanding its purchases of American farm goods would hinge on the implementation of their agreed reciprocal tariff-reduction arrangement.
"The risk of additional tariffs and other trade barriers will remain elevated in 2027, particularly as Chinese manufacturers continue expanding their presence in overseas markets," said Joe Peissel, lead macroeconomist at Trivium China.
Imports grew 41.6%, beating the median forecast for a 32% increase in the Reuters poll and accelerating from the 31% growth in September.
The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit will take place next week in the southern Chinese tech and innovation hub Shenzhen, where Chinese President Xi Jinping and United States President Donald Trump are expected to meet for the third time so far in 2026.
One big worry for Beijing is that consumers remain reluctant to spend, constrained by a property market downturn that has battered household wealth and dented confidence in the economic outlook.
Sluggish demand at home has pushed Chinese carmakers to seek sales in overseas markets. China’s car exports maintained a solid pace of growth in October, while domestic vehicle sales recorded a 12th straight month of declines, separate data released by an industry association showed.
Greater reliance on exports, however, leaves China's economy increasingly exposed to any slowdown in global demand.
Much of the strength in exports in 2026 has been fuelled by a global push to expand AI infrastructure.
"The outlook for exports depends on how long the AI boom will last," Macquarie analysts wrote. They expect China's exports to accelerate further in the fourth quarter before starting to slow from the first quarter of 2027.

The top diplomats from Group of Seven nations have reiterated “strong opposition” to attempts to change the status quo by force, including in the Taiwan Strait, a veiled swipe at Beijing as China ramps up military exercises around the self-ruled island.
During a meeting Monday in Paris, the G7 top diplomats underscored the importance of a free and open Indo-Pacific and reaffirmed their “strong opposition to any unilateral attempts to change the status quo by force or coercion, including in the East China Sea, the South China Sea, and across the Taiwan Strait,” according to a readout of the meeting released by Japan’s Foreign Ministry.
Taiwan’s defense minister said Tuesday that China is carrying out “area denial” drills in the western Pacific involving its Liaoning aircraft carrier and other naval formations.

content:
一杯完美茶的五个要素 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
一杯完美茶的五个要素
一位香港企业家探讨了中国传统的五行概念（金、火、水、木、土）如何在泡茶仪式中体现，描述了一种平衡自然与人文的冥想练习。
一位名叫 Dixtionary 的香港企业家和全球公民将泡茶描述为一种安静的平衡练习，植根于中国哲学概念“五行”。
Dixtionary 在《The Standard》标题为“五种元素的炼金术”的文章中表示，经过多年对茶道的探索，他意识到一杯完美的茶不仅仅涉及味道和香气。 “这是五种元素和谐相处的物理表现，”他写道。
该过程从金属开始，以用于烧水的重型手工锤制金属茶壶为代表。无论是银、铜还是铸铁制成的锅，都能使水“软化”，使其质地更加丝滑。 《词典》称，金属具有玻璃或电热水壶无法复制的“安静的权威”来保持热量。
然后火提供能量将静止转化为运动。锅底的火焰唤醒了水，使其达到古代大师所谓的“蟹眼”气泡的精确状态。他指出，如果没有火，其他元素就会保持休眠状态。
水被描述为生命的媒介。必须纯净、柔和才能体现茶的特性。当它在金属锅中沸腾时，它会吸收金属的强度和火的能量，成为下一阶段的完美载体。
木代表茶叶，《词典》称之为“大地的干礼物，承载着太阳、土壤和雾气的记忆”。当叶子遇到热水时，木元素膨胀并释放其精华，将清水转化为茶。
最后将茶倒入紫砂紫砂壶中，代表大地。粘土是多孔的并且会“呼吸”，随着时间的推移吸收茶油并形成深沉的、陈旧的光泽。 《词典》说，大地孕育着茶，为茶的体验奠定了基础，并有意地保存了热量和风味。
“目睹这五个元素在一个小房间里聚集在一起，提醒我们应该如何生活，”他写道。 “我们在企业和家庭中寻求同样的平衡：力量而不僵化，精力充沛，有目标，以及与世界基础的深刻联系。在一壶简单的茶中，整个宇宙找到了平衡。”

The Five Elements of a Perfect Cup of Tea | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
The Five Elements of a Perfect Cup of Tea
A Hong Kong-based entrepreneur explores how the traditional Chinese concept of wuxing — metal, fire, water, wood, and earth — manifests in the ritual of tea preparation, describing a meditative practice that balances nature and human touch.
A Hong Kong-based entrepreneur and global citizen known as Dixtionary has described the preparation of tea as a quiet exercise in balance, rooted in the Chinese philosophical concept of wuxing, or the five elements.
Writing in The Standard under the headline “The alchemy of five elements,” Dixtionary said that after years of exploring tea rituals, he realised that a perfect cup involves more than just flavour and aroma. “It is a physical manifestation of the five elements working in harmony,” he wrote.
The process begins with metal, represented by a heavy, hand-hammered metal teapot used for boiling water. Whether made of silver, copper or cast iron, the pot “softens” the water, giving it a silkier texture. Dixtionary said metal holds heat with “a quiet authority” that glass or electric kettles cannot replicate.
Fire then provides the energy to transform stillness into movement. The flame beneath the pot awakens the water, bringing it to the precise state that old masters called “crab-eye” bubbles. Without fire, the other elements remain dormant, he noted.
Water is described as the medium of life. It must be pure and soft to express the character of the tea. As it boils in the metal pot, it absorbs the strength of the metal and the energy of the fire, becoming the perfect vehicle for the next stage.
Wood stands for the tea leaves, which Dixtionary called “dried gifts of the earth, holding the memory of the sun, the soil and the mist.” When the leaves meet hot water, the wood element expands and releases its essence, transforming clear water into tea.
Finally, the tea is poured into a zisha purple clay teapot, representing earth. The clay is porous and “breathes,” absorbing the oils of the tea over time and developing a deep, seasoned luster. Dixtionary said the earth cradles the tea, grounding the experience and preserving heat and flavour with intentionality.
“To witness these five elements come together in a single small room is a reminder of how we should live,” he wrote. “We seek the same balance in our businesses and our homes: strength without rigidity, energy with purpose, and a deep connection to the foundations of the world. In a simple pot of tea, the entire universe finds its equilibrium.”

content:
PPP敦促李否决特别检察官法案，指控其捏造起诉书韩联社
Pinterest 链接至 Tumblr Reddit Facebook Messenger
首尔11月10日电（韩联社）主要反对党人民力量党（PPP）周二呼吁总统李在明否决最近通过的一项法案，该法案涉及特别检察官调查针对李明博等人的捏造起诉书。
人民党在青瓦台外举行议员大会时提出了这一呼吁，抨击该法案是一项旨在取消对李明博所有起诉的措施。
人民党领导人张东赫表示：“特别检察官法案标志着李在明出狱项目的最后一步。” “这是一项越狱法案，旨在让本应入狱的李出狱。”
该法案要求任命一名独立检察官来调查前总统尹石烈领导下的检方捏造证据或诱导虚假证词的嫌疑，以对当时的反对派领导人李明博等人立案。
人民力量党 (PPP) 众议员张东赫（前）于 2026 年 11 月 10 日在首尔青瓦台外主持召开议员大会，敦促总统李在明否决最近通过的一项法案，该法案要求对针对总统和其他人的涉嫌捏造的起诉书进行调查。 （韩联社）
张补充说：“我们必须恢复所有审判，让李在镕接受司法部门的判决，然后他的罪行才能被抹去。”
党内代表、众议员郑正植也警告说：“李明博出狱计划只会导致他的执政提前结束。”
自去年六月李明博上任以来，根据宪法的一项条款，对现任总统的审判一直暂停，该条款规定，除叛乱或叛国罪外，现任总统免受刑事起诉。
总统在担任城南市市长和京畿道省长期间面临参与腐败发展计划、向朝鲜非法汇款以及滥用政府签账卡的指控。
人民党在上周全体会议上通过该法案后一直对该法案进行抗议，周五在国民议会外举行了集会，周六在首尔市中心景福宫附近举行了大规模户外集会。
该党计划在全国主要城市举行一系列户外集会，周六从东南部城市釜山开始。
据人民党称，青瓦台外的一系列单人抗议活动也于周一开始，并将持续到李明博否决该法案为止。
执政的民主党拒绝了人民党的指控，指出允许特别检察官取消起诉的条款已从该法案的最终版本中删除。

PPP urges Lee to veto special counsel bill on alleged fabricated indictments | Yonhap News Agency
Pinterest Linked in Tumblr Reddit Facebook Messenger
SEOUL, Nov. 10 (Yonhap) -- The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) on Tuesday called on President Lee Jae Myung to veto a recently passed bill on a special counsel investigation into alleged fabricated indictments targeting Lee and others.
The PPP made the appeal as they held a general meeting of its lawmakers outside the presidential office, slamming the bill as a measure aimed at canceling all indictments against Lee.
"The special counsel bill marks the final step in a project to free Lee Jae Myung from prison," PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok said. "It is a jailbreak bill designed to get Lee, who should be behind bars, out of jail."
The legislation calls for appointing an independent counsel to investigate suspicions the prosecution under former President Yoon Suk Yeol fabricated evidence or induced false testimonies to build cases against then opposition leader Lee and others.
Rep. Jang Dong-hyeok of the People Power Party (PPP) (front) leads a general meeting of its lawmakers outside Cheong Wa Dae in Seoul on Nov. 10, 2026, urging President Lee Jae Myung to veto a recently passed bill calling for a special counsel investigation into alleged fabricated indictments targeting the president and others. (Yonhap)
"We must resume all trials and make Lee face the judiciary's judgment before his crimes are wiped away," Jang added.
Rep. Jeong Jeom-sig, the party's floor leader, also warned, "The project to free Lee from prison will only lead to an early end of his administration."
Lee's trials have been suspended since he took office in June last year under an article of the Constitution that exempts a sitting president from criminal prosecution except in cases of insurrection or treason.
The president faces charges of involvement in corrupt development schemes, illegal remittances to North Korea and the misuse of a government charge card, stemming from his time as mayor of Seongnam and governor of Gyeonggi Province.
The PPP has been protesting against the bill after it was passed at a plenary session last week, with a rally held Friday outside the National Assembly and a large-scale outdoor rally staged near Gyeongbok Palace in central Seoul on Saturday.
The party plans to hold a series of outdoor rallies in major cities across the country, starting with the southeastern city of Busan on Saturday.
A relay of one-person protests outside Cheong Wa Dae also began Monday and will continue until Lee vetoes the bill, according to the PPP.
The ruling Democratic Party has rejected the PPP's accusation, noting that clauses allowing the special counsel to cancel indictments were removed from the final version of the bill.

2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
与英伟达首席执行官有联系的中国女商人黄爱丽因芯片关联而受到审查
前上海财务主管 Alice Huang 成为 Nvidia 云合作伙伴 Megaspeed International 的控股股东。美国当局调查她是否帮助中国公司获得受限制的英伟达芯片，媒体报道了情报指控，但中国否认了这一指控。 Nvidia 的 boa
根据路透社查阅的 30 多份公开财务记录、公司文件和公司材料，中国女商人黄乐 (Alice Huang，又名黄乐) 在成为新加坡云计算公司 Megaspeed International 的控股股东之前，曾在上海金融界开启了职业生涯。 Nvidia 将 Megaspeed 列为官方云合作伙伴。该公司于 2025 年 10 月引起公众关注，当时《纽约时报》报道称，该公司正在接受美国调查，调查其是否帮助中国客户获得受华盛顿出口管制的先进 Nvidia 芯片。
此后，黄因为与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的关系而成为人们关注的焦点。两者没有关系。 《纽约时报》上个月报道称，美国当局认定她是一名中国情报人员，她向北京传递信息，同时与英伟达首席执行官建立了密切关系。路透社无法独立核实这一情报指控，中国已否认这一指控。路透社无法确定黄的下落，因此寻求置评。
英伟达董事会已对其首席执行官成为外国情报机构目标的报道展开独立调查，但表示没有理由相信国家安全信息或公司商业机密已被泄露。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示，联邦调查局也在调查此事，但他没有提供更多细节。黄仁勋周日承认对妻子不忠，但没有直接评论爱丽丝黄，但表示他致力于支持美国国家安全。
据中国财经刊物《财新》报道，黄爱丽大约 42 岁，根据中国基金业记录和私募基金数据库 Simuwang 的索引资料显示，她之前从事银行和投资管理工作，该数据库还列出了她早期从事电视新闻工作的经历。在加入 Megaspeed 之前，她曾在中国投资公司上海河西投资管理公司担任高级职位。 2016年至2017年间，河西官方微信账户上的多个帖子显示她是该公司的副总经理、执行董事和投资决策委员会成员，并表示她此前曾在香港汇丰银行私人银行和中信证券工作。汇丰银行和中信银行没有立即回应置评请求。
根据审查公司记录的华盛顿研究组织 C4ADS 的数据，黄仁勋于 2023 年 3 月成为 Megaspeed 的控股股东。 Megaspeed 于 2015 年在新加坡成立，名称为 7Road International，提供云计算服务，并在其公司网站上将自己描述为 Nvidia 在亚太地区的业务合作伙伴。黄先生还于2023年3月至2023年11月期间担任Megaspeed印度尼西亚子公司的董事兼董事总经理，C4ADS

Alice Huang, Chinese businesswoman linked to Nvidia CEO, under scrutiny over chip links | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Alice Huang, Chinese businesswoman linked to Nvidia CEO, under scrutiny over chip links
Alice Huang, a former Shanghai finance executive, became controlling shareholder of Nvidia cloud partner Megaspeed International. US authorities investigated whether she helped Chinese firms obtain restricted Nvidia chips, and media reported intelligence allegations, which China denied. Nvidia’s boa
Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman also known as Huang Le, built a career in Shanghai finance before becoming the controlling shareholder of Singapore-based cloud-computing company Megaspeed International, according to more than 30 publicly available financial records, corporate filings and company materials reviewed by Reuters. Nvidia lists Megaspeed as an official cloud partner. The company drew public attention in October 2025, when the New York Times reported it was under US investigation over whether it helped Chinese customers obtain advanced Nvidia chips subject to Washington’s export controls.
Huang has since been thrust into the spotlight because of her links with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The two are not related. The New York Times reported last month that US authorities had concluded she was a Chinese intelligence asset who passed information to Beijing while developing a close relationship with the Nvidia CEO. Reuters could not independently verify the intelligence allegation, which China has denied. Reuters could not determine Huang’s whereabouts to seek comment.
Nvidia’s board has launched an independent investigation into reports that its CEO was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation, but said it had no reason to believe national security information or company trade secrets had been compromised. US President Donald Trump said on Monday that the FBI was also looking into the matter, but he did not provide further details. Without commenting directly on Alice Huang, Jensen Huang acknowledged on Sunday being unfaithful to his wife, but said he was committed to supporting US national security.
Alice Huang, reported by Chinese financial publication Caixin to be about 42 years old, previously worked in banking and investment management, according to Chinese fund-industry records and an indexed profile on private-fund database Simuwang, which also listed an earlier career in television journalism. Before her involvement with Megaspeed, she held senior positions at Shanghai Hexi Investment Management, a Chinese investment firm. Several posts on Hexi’s official WeChat account between 2016 and 2017 identified her as the firm’s deputy general manager, executive director and a member of its investment decision committee and said she had previously worked at HSBC’s private bank in Hong Kong and at CITIC Securities. HSBC and CITIC did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Huang became Megaspeed’s controlling shareholder in March 2023, according to Washington-based research group C4ADS, which reviewed corporate records. Incorporated in Singapore in 2015 as 7Road International, Megaspeed provides cloud-computing services and describes itself on its company website as an Nvidia business partner in the Asia-Pacific region. Huang also served as a director and managing director of Megaspeed’s Indonesian subsidiary from March to November 2023, C4ADS said. Megaspeed did not respond to a request for comment.
Shipping records from trade-data provider ImportGenius reviewed by Reuters show Megaspeed’s Indonesian subsidiary imported Nvidia hardware between 2024 and 2026, including H100 processors and related components, in shipments from suppliers including Gigabyte subsidiary Giga Computing. The H100 is among the advanced Nvidia processors restricted from export to China, although the shipments to Indonesia do not themselves establish any violation of US export controls. Megaspeed’s shares were transferred in late 2023 to Singapore-based SwiftData, which holds all 10 million of its ordinary shares, according to C4ADS. Reuters could not immediately contact SwiftData.

title: Hong Kong steps up enforcement against air-conditioner dripping with new tech and legal powers
zh_title: 香港加强打击空调滴水新技术和法律权力
summary: 香港加强打击空调滴水新技术和法律权力|中国劳工布告栏 星期二, 10 Nov 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港以新技术和法律权力加强对空调滴水的执法力度 香港署理环境行政长官向立法会委员会表示，食物环境卫生署已加强对空调滴水的行动。新战略包括有针对性的巡逻、人工智能增强的检测系统以及修订后的法律，以提高合规性和执行力。
content:
香港加强打击空调滴水新技术和法律权力|中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港加强打击空调滴水新技术和法律权力
香港署理环境行政长官向立法会委员会表示，食物环境卫生署已加强针对空调滴水的行动。新战略包括有针对性的巡逻、人工智能增强检测系统和修订后的法律，以提高合规性和执行力
署理环境生态局局长于2026年11月10日向立法会食物安全及环境卫生小组委员会通报政府根据《公众卫生及市政条例》加强打击冷气机滴水行为的最新情况，因为空调机滴水属于公共滋扰行为。
食物环境卫生署采取多管齐下的方式，在整个夏季选择超过300个优先地点进行每周巡查。到 8 月，大约一半的站点已出现改善或解决，从而根据风险评估确定了 110 多个额外热点进行后续跟踪。
自2024年起，该部门与当地创新合作伙伴合作开发红外夜视检测系统，无需进入私人单位即可精确定位滴水。第二代系统在 2026 年爱迪生奖工程和机器人 - 光学传感和空间智能类别中荣获铜奖。所有地区办事处现在都使用第三代版本，其中包含人工智能图像识别功能，以加快观察和证据收集速度。
2025年颁布的法律修正案进一步加强了执法力度。他们延长了官员进入房屋进行检查的时间，规定业主或居住者在收到拟进入通知后 14 天内无合理理由拒绝进入的行为属于犯罪行为，并提高了对不遵守滋扰通知的最高处罚。
截至2026年9月30日，该署年内已发出约8,100份滋扰通知，较2025年同期增加约16%。超过99%的收件人已遵守通知要求，显示公众合作程度很高。
该部门还与物业管理公司合作开展一项计划，物业管理公司的工作人员帮助识别滴水源并为居民提供建议。过去五年来，参与企业平均每年处理4000多起投诉。该署与物业管理业监管局紧密合作，向从业员简介并鼓励更多持牌公司参与该计划。

Hong Kong steps up enforcement against air-conditioner dripping with new tech and legal powers | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong steps up enforcement against air-conditioner dripping with new tech and legal powers
Hong Kong's acting environment chief told a LegCo committee that the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has intensified action against air-conditioner dripping. New strategies include targeted patrols, an AI-enhanced detection system and revised laws that have boosted compliance and enforceme
The acting Secretary for Environment and Ecology on 10 November 2026 updated the Legislative Council Subcommittee on Food Safety and Environmental Hygiene on the government's stepped-up campaign against dripping air-conditioners, a public nuisance under the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance.
The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has adopted a multi-pronged approach, selecting over 300 priority locations for weekly inspections throughout the summer. By August, about half of these sites had shown improvement or resolution, leading to the identification of more than 110 additional hotspots for follow-up based on risk assessment.
Since 2024, the department has collaborated with local innovation partners to develop an infrared night-vision detection system that can pinpoint drips without entering private units. The second-generation system won a bronze at the 2026 Edison Awards in the Engineering and Robotics – Optical Sensing and Spatial Intelligence category. All district offices now use a third-generation version that incorporates artificial-intelligence image recognition to speed up observation and evidence gathering.
Legal amendments enacted in 2025 have further strengthened enforcement. They extend the hours during which officers may enter premises for inspections, make it an offence for owners or occupants to refuse entry without reasonable excuse within 14 days of receiving a notice of intended entry, and increase the maximum penalty for non-compliance with nuisance notices.
As of 30 September 2026, the department had issued about 8,100 nuisance notices in the year, a rise of approximately 16 per cent compared with the same period in 2025. Over 99 per cent of recipients have complied with the notice requirements, indicating a high level of public cooperation.
The department also runs a scheme with property management companies, whose staff help identify drip sources and advise residents. Over the past five years, participating firms have handled an average of more than 4,000 complaints annually. The department works closely with the Property Management Industry Authority to brief practitioners and encourage more licensed companies to join the scheme.

香港周四纪念孙中山诞辰160周年|中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港周四纪念孙中山诞辰160周年
香港将于11月12日举行纪念孙中山先生诞辰160周年纪念仪式。行政长官李家超将与官员、立法会议员和学生一起主持活动。
香港特别行政区政府11月10日发布声明称，香港特别行政区政府将于11月12日星期四举行纪念仪式，纪念伟大民族英雄、爱国者、中国民主革命先驱孙中山先生诞辰160周年。
行政长官李家超将主持仪式并致辞。其他出席人士包括政府高级官员、中央人民政府驻港代表、行政会议和立法会议员、香港全国人大代表、香港政协委员、区议员、各界代表、制服团体、青年代表和学生。
仪式将包括来自国王学院和贝利利奥斯公立学校的警察乐队和合唱团的表演，高唱国歌，敬献花圈，以及所有参与者集体鞠躬致意。
场馆内不设公众观赏区。香港电台TV31将现场直播颁奖典礼。

Hong Kong to mark Sun Yat-sen 160th birth anniversary on Thursday
Hong Kong will hold a ceremony on 12 November to mark the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen. Chief Executive Lee Ka-chiu will lead the event with officials, legislators and students.
The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government will hold a commemorative ceremony on Thursday 12 November to mark the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen, a great national hero, patriot and pioneer of China's democratic revolution, according to a government statement on 10 November.
Chief Executive Lee Ka-chiu will preside over the ceremony and deliver a speech. Other attendees will include senior government officials, representatives from the Central People's Government in Hong Kong, members of the Executive Council and the Legislative Council, Hong Kong deputies to the National People's Congress, Hong Kong members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, district councillors, representatives from various sectors, uniformed groups, youth representatives and students.
The ceremony will feature performances by the police band and choirs from King's College and Belilios Public School singing the national anthem, a wreath-laying segment, and a collective bow of respect from all participants.
No public viewing area will be set up at the venue. Radio Television Hong Kong's TV31 will broadcast the ceremony live.

content:
铜锣湾11月14日至15日游行：特别交通及运输安排 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
铜锣湾11月14日至15日游行：特别交通及运输安排
香港当局宣布为 11 月 14 日至 15 日在铜锣湾举行的游行封闭道路并改变交通。道路将于11月14日下午5:30和11月15日下午2:15起封闭，巴士和小巴改道。
据11月10日政府新闻稿称，香港当局已宣布为11月14日至15日在铜锣湾举行的游行采取特别交通和运输安排。
新闻稿称，11月14日下午5点30分至晚上11点59分左右，多条道路将分阶段暂时封闭，并进行交通疏导。恩平路好运中心附近的的士站将于下午6时00分至晚上11时59分左右暂停服务。
11月15日下午2时15分至4时30分左右，以下道路将暂时封闭并改道： 东角路；利园街；介乎百德新街与告士打道之间的一段京士顿街(西行)；介乎京士顿街与利园街之间的一段百德新街。
警方可能会视乎人群及交通状况，进一步暂时封闭铜锣湾维多利亚公园附近的道路，包括唐街、加宁街、京士顿街（东行）、告士打道及摩理臣街天桥。封闭道路区内的停车场将暂停使用，受影响地区的违例停泊车辆将被拖走，恕不另行通知。
公共交通方面，城巴2、18、99、A11号线及过海路线102、106、307号线将改道，受影响地区的巴士站将暂停或迁移。港岛小巴25号线将改道，百德新街总站移至铜锣湾道圣保禄学校对面。唐街和百德新街的公共小巴站，以及百德新街的士和过海的士站，将于11月15日下午2时15分至下午4时30分左右暂停服务，或直至人群散去和道路重新开放。
当局敦促公众使用公共交通工具，以避免拥堵和延误。活动期间，交通部门和警方将监控交通情况。警方可能会根据人群和交通状况调整安排。市民应留意运输署网站、「香港行」流动应用程式或公共交通营办商以获取最新消息。

Causeway Bay parade on 14-15 November: special traffic and transport arrangements | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Causeway Bay parade on 14-15 November: special traffic and transport arrangements
Hong Kong authorities announced road closures and transport changes for a parade in Causeway Bay on 14 and 15 November. Roads will close from 5:30pm on 14 November and from 2:15pm on 15 November, with bus and minibus diversions.
Hong Kong authorities have announced special traffic and transport arrangements for a parade in Causeway Bay on 14 and 15 November, according to a government press release on 10 November.
On 14 November, from 5:30pm to about 11:59pm, several roads will be temporarily closed in stages with traffic diversions, the release said. A taxi stand near Lucky Plaza on Yun Ping Road will be suspended from 6:00pm to about 11:59pm.
On 15 November, from 2:15pm to about 4:30pm, the following roads will be temporarily closed with traffic diversions: Tung Kok Road; Lee Garden Street; a section of Kingston Street (westbound) between Paterson Street and Gloucester Road; and a section of Paterson Street between Kingston Street and Lee Garden Street.
Police may further temporarily close roads near Victoria Park in Causeway Bay, including Tong Street, Cleveland Street, Kingston Street (eastbound), Gloucester Road and the Morrison Street flyover, depending on crowd and traffic conditions, the release added. Car parks within the closed road areas will be suspended, and illegally parked vehicles in affected areas will be towed without prior notice.
For public transport, Citybus routes 2, 18, 99, A11 and cross-harbour routes 102, 106, 307 will be diverted, with bus stops in affected areas suspended or relocated. Island minibus route 25 will be diverted, with its Paterson Street terminus moved to opposite St Paul's School on Causeway Bay Road. Public minibus stops on Tong Street and Paterson Street, and taxi and cross-harbour taxi stands on Paterson Street, will be suspended from 2:15pm to about 4:30pm on 15 November, or until crowds disperse and roads reopen.
The authorities urged the public to use public transport to avoid congestion and delays. During the event, the Transport Department and police will monitor traffic. Police may adjust arrangements based on crowd and traffic conditions. The public should check the Transport Department website, the 'Hong Kong Walk' mobile app, or public transport operators for updates.

summary: 香港立法会议员抨击电梯门框遗漏，敦促第三方检查中国劳工布告栏 星期二, 10 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 香港立法会议员猛烈抨击电梯门框遗漏，敦促第三方检查 香港立法会议员和一名安全委员会成员批评一家电梯承包商在 720 部电梯中遗漏了防火门框。他们呼吁进行独立的第三方检查并改进数字记录保存，以防止再次发生。一家承包商在香港的 720 部电梯中省略了防火门框组件。埃勒
content:
香港立法会议员抨击电梯门框遗漏，敦促第三方检查中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港立法会议员抨击电梯门框遗漏，敦促第三方检查
一名香港立法会议员和一名安全委员会成员批评一名升降机承包商在 720 部升降机中省略了防火门框。他们呼吁进行独立的第三方检查并改进数字记录保存，以防止再次发生。
一家承包商在香港的 720 部电梯中省略了防火门框组件。机电工程署（机电工程署）预计补救工作可在两至三个月内完成。
机电工程署升降机及自动梯安全咨询委员会委员姚洁宁向香港电台千禧节目表示，720部升降机的数字令人震惊。在调查正在进行期间，她拒绝猜测动机，但指出业内一些人士表示承包商可能试图削减成本。姚表示，委员会对机电工程署在问题曝光后的积极回应感到满意。
姚指出，根据现行为新电梯或重大改造后发放许可证的“三重检查机制”，第二次检查是由注册电梯工程师进行的，该工程师可以受雇于承包商或独立第三方。姚表示，虽然这一系统过去曾发挥过作用，但此次事件证明引入强制性独立第三方检查以增强公共安全是合理的。她承认，此举会增加时间和成本，这可能会让小业主感到担忧。
姚还支持机电工程署的建议，将数字工作日志的使用（目前用于维护）扩大到新装置和更换工程。她希望该系统能在年底前更新并投入使用，以防止类似事件发生。
香港民建联议员郭芙蓉在同一节目中表示，承包商负主要责任，但事件也暴露了监管框架的缺陷。她形容，尽管有三重检查机制，但门框却被省略了，这是“不可思议的”。郭呼吁改进信息核实和现场检查，包括更频繁、更彻底的抽查、加强注册工程师的独立性和问责性，以及吊销执照等更严厉的处罚。

Hong Kong lawmaker slams lift door frame omissions, urges third-party checks | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong lawmaker slams lift door frame omissions, urges third-party checks
A Hong Kong lawmaker and a safety committee member criticise a lift contractor for omitting fire-resistant door frames in 720 lifts. They call for independent third-party inspections and improved digital record-keeping to prevent recurrence.
A contractor has omitted fire-resistant door frame components from 720 lifts in Hong Kong. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD) expects remedial work to be completed within two to three months.
Yao Jiening, a member of the EMSD Lift and Escalator Safety Advisory Committee, told RTHK's Millennium programme that the figure of 720 lifts was alarming. She declined to speculate on a motive while an investigation is underway, but noted that some in the industry suggest the contractor may have sought to cut costs. Yao said the committee was satisfied with the EMSD's proactive response after the issue came to light.
Under the current 'triple-check mechanism' for issuing permits for new lifts or after major alterations, Yao noted that the second check is performed by a registered lift engineer, who may be employed by the contractor or be an independent third party. While this system has worked in the past, Yao said the incident justified introducing mandatory independent third-party inspections to enhance public safety. She acknowledged that such a move would increase time and cost, which could worry small property owners.
Yao also supported the EMSD's proposal to expand the use of digital work logs—currently for maintenance—to new installations and replacement works. She hoped the system would be updated and in use by the end of the year to prevent similar incidents.
Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong lawmaker Kwok Fu-rong, speaking on the same programme, said the contractor bore primary responsibility but that the incident also revealed shortcomings in the regulatory framework. She described it as 'inconceivable' that door frames were omitted despite the triple-check mechanism. Kwok called for improvements in information verification and on-site inspections, including more frequent and thorough spot checks, stronger independence and accountability of registered engineers, and tougher penalties including license revocation.

圖為民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋（中）出席台北府城隍威靈公聖誕暨建廟145週年城隍文化時接受聯訪回應文化幣等議題。（中央社檔案照片）
（中央社記者劉建邦台北10日電）民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋競選辦公室今天表示，沈伯洋提出文化幣加碼政策延伸至30歲，每人每年可獲1200點，盼藝文走進台北青年日常，並延續文化部推動文化幣的政策。
沈伯洋競選辦公室提供新聞資料表示，沈伯洋透過社群平台Threads影片提出文化幣加碼政策，盼延續文化部推動文化幣的政策精神。
沈伯洋競辦指出，沈伯洋主張未來若有機會擔任台北市長，將由北市府規劃加碼，把文化幣支持年齡向上延伸至30歲，讓23歲至30歲的台北市青年族群，每人每年也能獲得1200點文化幣，提升藝文活動的可近性，讓文化更自然地融入日常生活。
沈伯洋競辦發言人蔡一愷說，文化部目前推動文化幣政策，提供13歲至22歲青年每人每年1200點，鼓勵年輕世代接觸藝文。沈伯洋盼未來進北市府服務時可進一步規劃由地方加碼，支持文化幣延伸至30歲，讓更多青年族群有機會走進書店、劇場及電影院，拓展文化體驗，豐富城市的藝文生活。
蔡一愷表示，文化參與不應受年齡限制，從閱讀、電影到表演藝術，每種文化體驗都可能成為生活的美好風景。沈伯洋盼透過文化幣加碼，讓青年族群更輕鬆地親近藝文，也讓不同世代都能在日常生活中，找到屬於自身的文化體驗。
蔡一愷說，沈伯洋先前提出親子同行卡政策，規劃提供設籍台北市0至18歲兒童及青少年每人每月600點，鼓勵親子共同參與文化、運動及閱讀活動，此次提出文化幣加碼支持延伸至青年階段，從親子共同參與到青年自主探索，讓不同年齡層都能有更多接觸文化的機會。
蔡一愷表示，透過青年族群藝文參與也能支持獨立書店、文化場館、創作者及在地藝文產業。沈伯洋盼台北成為文化更加普及、創作持續蓬勃、不同世代都能自在親近藝文的城市。（編輯：蕭博文）1151110

Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

content: 作者： 徒步的骑手   2026年11月9日   徒步的騎手播客 #244 黄仁勋间谍门 Preview   Listen now   #244 黄仁勋间谍门 黄仁勋触碰了美国哪根高压线？知情不报还是故意视而不见？商业利益与国家安全撞车，谁说了算？｜英伟达48亿美元芯片去了哪里？ 10月29日，《纽约时报》刊发重磅报道，说美国政府正在调查一个名叫黄乐的中国女人，她跟英伟达老板黄仁勋关系密切。黄乐曾经在英伟达的大客户Megaspeed公司担任高管。美国情报机构怀疑，她是中国间谍，涉嫌帮助中国规避美国的AI芯片出口禁令，非法获得英伟达先进芯片。 短短两年中，Megaspeed从英伟达购买了超过48亿美元的芯片。美国情报部门在调查黄乐和Megaspeed公司的时候，发现她跟黄仁勋的关系远远超出一般商业往来。根据《纽约时报》的后续报导，美国情报官员认为，黄乐被中国国家安全部招募，任务就是接近黄仁勋，获取有关英伟达和美国AI芯片政策的情报。 对《纽约时报》的报导，黄仁勋和英伟达先是否认。但美国国会开始采取行动。11月4日，众议院三个委员会的主席联名致函黄仁勋，要求他11月18日到国会接受闭门简报质询。 是哪三个委员会呢？第一，外交事务委员会；第二，美中战略竞争特别委员会；第三，常设情报特别委员会。这里简单提一句，三个委员会的现任主席全部是共和党人。他们要求黄仁勋说明他跟黄乐的关系，英伟达是如何防止外国情报机构渗透的，是不是泄漏过敏感信息。 众议院三个委员会的主席发出质询函以后，黄仁勋和英伟达改了口。11月8日，黄仁勋承认了《纽约时报》报导的绯闻部分。同一天，英伟达董事会宣布，由独立董事组成调查委员会，而且将聘请外部律师，调查黄仁勋是否受到外国情报活动的影响。 美国情报部门和国会要调查的真正问题，不是黄仁勋中了美人计，而是美国的国家安全。具体来说，有这么几点：一是，黄仁勋知不知道黄乐的身份？二是，黄仁勋有没有向她泄漏敏感信息，甚至泄漏机密？第三，他们之间的关系有没有影响英伟达的商业决策？第四，她有没有通过黄仁勋来影响美国政府的芯片出口政策？ 现在，根据美国情报部门的判断，黄仁勋是中国情报活动的目标，但是，除了黄乐，是不是还有其他中国情报人员，也在攻这个目标？他们是不是跟黄乐一样，成功攻下了这个目标？这些问题要看调查结果，现在下结论为时尚早。 不过，我对黄仁勋陷入这场风波，并不觉得特别意外。 几年前，黄仁勋公开叫板拜登政府的芯片出口禁令。当时，我隐隐约约有一种预感，这家伙在玩火。具体说，他在激化一场商业利益与国家安全的冲突。 这场冲突在当时， 就已经受到美国政府职能部门和国会的审视， 而且这种审视肯定会越来越严格。 这几年，英伟达如日中天，它的芯片是AI竞争的命门。中国的土皇帝上台以后，跟美国正面对抗，把美国当成假想敌，美国政府禁止英伟达向中国出口最先进的芯片。禁令一出，中国的各路人马八仙过海，通过第三国、空壳公司、层层转手，想方设法弄英伟达芯片。这些事，媒体一直有报道，美国司法部也起诉过好几起走私案。说黄仁勋对此一无所知，很难让人相信。 美国对中国的芯片管制，是从2022年10月开始的。拜登政府禁止向中国出口最先进的AI芯片。英伟达怎么应对呢？它把芯片性能降一格，刚好卡在管制线下面，造出专供中国市场的A800和H800。2023年10月，美国商务部收紧了标准，这两款也被禁了。英伟达再降一格，又造出H20。2023年12月，当时的商务部长雷蒙多，公开向英伟达喊话：你要是围着管制线兜圈子，设计出来一个，我第二天就禁一个。 英伟达跟美国政府玩这种猫捉老鼠的游戏，玩了好几年。不但如此，黄仁勋还公开向美国政府施压，要求放开对中国的芯片出口。川普上台后，他成功游说川普，放松了对中国的芯片出口管制。2025年4月，他在北京见中国官员，说英伟达会坚定不移服务中国市场。同年5月，他在台北的Computex展会上说：“All in all, the export control was a failure”——“总而言之，出口管制失败了。” 有他在那里上下其手，美国的芯片出口管制当然不会成功。 这里就有个问题。一个掌握美国关键技术的企业家，公开反对美国政府的技术出口限制；同时，他的重要客户涉嫌把芯片非法输送到中国，用各种手段规避出口管制。企业家的商业利益跟国家安全发生冲突的时候，究竟谁说了算？...

summary: 美国战争部长皮特·海格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)将前往菲律宾，出席本星期晚些时候在菲律宾宿务举行的东盟防长扩大会议(ADMM-Plus)。美国战争部说，海格塞斯将重申，在太平洋地区，美国致力于以实力求和平战略。 根据战争部星期天(10月25日)发布的新闻稿，海格塞斯在会议期间将举行双边和多边会谈，以“加强威慑、推进关键联盟和伙伴关系，并扩大在该地区的责任分担”。 美国在2026年防务战略在谈到美国在亚太的政策时，明确地将盟友间强调“责任分担”列为核心支柱之一。 战争部的
content:
美国战争部长皮特·海格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)将前往菲律宾，出席本星期晚些时候在菲律宾宿务举行的东盟防长扩大会议(ADMM-Plus)。美国战争部说，海格塞斯将重申，在太平洋地区，美国致力于以实力求和平战略。
根据战争部星期天(10月25日)发布的新闻稿，海格塞斯在会议期间将举行双边和多边会谈，以“加强威慑、推进关键联盟和伙伴关系，并扩大在该地区的责任分担”。
美国在2026年防务战略在谈到美国在亚太的政策时，明确地将盟友间强调“责任分担”列为核心支柱之一。
战争部的新闻稿没有具体说明海格塞斯将与何人会晤，但菲律宾和日本媒体报道说，菲律宾国防部长吉尔伯托·特奥多罗(Gilberto Teodoro Jr.)和日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎(Shinjirō Koizumi)预计都将与海格塞斯举行双边会晤。
菲律宾通讯社星期一援引特奥多罗的话说，他与海格塞斯一定会在东盟防长扩大会议期间举行双边会晤。“我肯定会与海格塞斯举行双边会晤和小组会议，而且我几乎会与所有相关方举行双边会晤。”
特奥多罗表示，他将与海格塞斯讨论“加强防务关系”等议题，目标是“(探讨)我们是否需要增加现有工作，是否需要加快、放缓或其他方面的进展”。
第13届东盟防长扩大会议(ADMM-Plus)和第20届东盟防长会议(ADMM)将于10月28日至29日在菲律宾宿务省拉普拉普市举行。东盟防长会议(ADMM)成立于2006年，是东盟最高级别的防务磋商与合作机制，而东盟防长扩大会议(ADMM-Plus)则于2010年启动，旨在扩大东盟成员国与美国、澳大利亚、印度、日本、新西兰、韩国、俄罗斯和中国等八国之间的区域防务对话与合作。
值得一提的是，星期一，在中国外交部的例行记者会上，在被问到中方是否会派高级别官员或代表团出席本周三在马尼拉举行的东盟防长扩大会时，中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆没有直接回答，却表示，“东盟防长扩大会理应为地区国家加强对话、增进互信、推动合作发挥积极作用。我们反对任何势力公器私用，绑架东盟，搅局生事。”
郭嘉昆没有说明谁可能会“公器私用、搅局生事”。菲律宾是2026年东盟的轮值主席国，特奥多罗上星期五公开表示，如果中国采取武力拖走非法“坐滩”在第二托马斯礁(中国称仁爱礁，菲律宾称阿云津礁)的“马德雷山”号军舰，或对该军舰采取武力行动，将构成针对菲律宾的“战争行为”。
特奥多罗还表示，在东盟防长会议期间，各国国防部长还将讨论区域安全、人道主义援助和灾害应对等问题。
特奥多罗在星期一还提到，菲律宾有可能与志同道合的国家扩大其访问部队地位协定(SOVFA)，以加强国际维和合作，提升军事互操作性，并在联合国的主持下推进集体安全努力。
“这也让我看到了加强关系的可能性，或许可以与那些与我们基本价值观一致的国家签署访问部队地位协定。”他说道。迄今为止，菲律宾已与五个国家签署了访问部队地位协定，分别是法国、加拿大、澳大利亚、日本和新西兰。
另一方面，日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎星期五表示，他正在安排下星期与美国战争部长海格塞斯会面，因为他正在考虑是否出席在菲律宾举行的东盟防长扩大会议。
《今日日本》报道援引消息人士的话说，如果小泉进次郎与海格塞斯会面，两人预计将讨论如何应对近期一名驻冲绳县美军士兵因涉嫌抢劫和谋杀被捕一事。日本媒体报道，日本冲绳县那霸地方检察厅星期天已经以抢劫杀人罪起诉驻日美国海军陆战队士兵德文·雅各布·巴拉德(Devin Jacob Ballard)。

title: Hong Kong health officials say 75 Covid jab sites sufficient for demand

summary: 香港卫生官员称 75 个新冠疫苗接种点足以满足需求中国劳工公告2026年11月10日星期二·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港卫生官员表示，75个Covid-19疫苗接种点足以满足需求 香港卫生署表示，75个Covid-19疫苗接种点足以满足目前的需求，超过90%的人已接种了初始剂量。官员们指出，由于优先群体近期感染数据不完整，加强剂量计算变得复杂。香港卫生署表示，已有 75 名 Covid-19 感染者
content:
香港卫生官员称 75 个新冠疫苗接种点足以满足需求中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港卫生官员称 75 个新冠疫苗接种点足以满足需求
香港卫生署表示，75 个 Covid-19 疫苗接种点足以满足目前的需求，超过 90% 的人已接种了初始疫苗。官员们指出，由于优先群体近期感染数据不完整，加强剂量计算变得复杂。
香港卫生署表示，全市75个Covid-19疫苗接种点足以满足目前的接种需求。一位发言人指出，接受初始剂量 Covid-19 疫苗的总体接种率已超过 90%。
发言人解释，计算加强剂量摄取率与其他疫苗不同，需要考虑相关人群近期是否感染新冠病毒，以及感染日期。根据目前的疫苗接种计划，完成初始剂量的优先群体成员可以在最后一剂疫苗或感染 Covid-19 后至少 180 天获得免费的加强剂量，无论他们之前接种过多少剂。
由于尚未获得这些优先群体近期感染的完整数据，该部门表示无法计算该群体加强剂量的疫苗接种率。该发言人补充说，目前使用的 mRNA Covid-19 疫苗涉及复杂的冷链处理和物流程序。
卫生署表示，为减少疫苗浪费，现有75个疫苗接种点网络，包括公立医院专科门诊、家庭医学诊所、私家诊所及母婴健康院，足以应付现时的需求。
