Hong Kong health officials say 75 Covid jab sites sufficient for demand | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong health officials say 75 Covid jab sites sufficient for demand
Hong Kong's Department of Health says 75 Covid-19 vaccination points are enough to meet current demand, with over 90 per cent of people having received initial doses. Officials note booster uptake calculations are complicated by incomplete data on recent infections among priority groups.
Hong Kong's Department of Health has said that 75 Covid-19 vaccination points across the city are sufficient to meet current inoculation demand. A spokesman noted that the overall rate for people receiving initial doses of the Covid-19 vaccine has exceeded 90 per cent.
The spokesman explained that calculating the booster dose uptake rate differs from other vaccines, as it requires consideration of whether people in relevant groups have recently been infected with the coronavirus and the date of any such infection. Under the current vaccination programme, priority group members who have completed their initial doses can receive a free booster dose at least 180 days after their last vaccine dose or a Covid-19 infection, regardless of how many doses they have had previously.
Because complete data on recent infections among these priority groups is not yet available, the department said it is unable to calculate the group's vaccination rate for booster doses. The spokesman added that the mRNA Covid-19 vaccines currently in use involve complex cold-chain handling and logistics procedures.
In order to minimise vaccine wastage, the department said the existing network of 75 vaccination points — which includes public hospital specialist outpatient clinics, family medicine clinics, private clinics, and maternal and child health centres — is adequate to meet current demand.

summary: 自禁令以来，香港对 7,300 个建筑工地开出 84 项吸烟罚款中国劳工布告栏 星期二, 10 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 自禁令以来，香港在 7,300 个建筑工地发出了 84 项吸烟罚款 香港劳工局长表示，7 月至 10 月期间，政府在 7,300 个建筑工地检查时发出了 84 项吸烟定额罚款通知。大多数检查都是未经通知的，其中 28 项罚款来自有照片或视频证据的公众投诉。香港劳工及福利局局长孙玉光表示，政府已发出 84 项修复方案
content:
自禁令以来，香港对 7,300 个建筑工地开出 84 项吸烟罚款中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
自禁令以来，香港在 7,300 个建筑工地共开出 84 项吸烟罚款
香港劳工局长表示，从7月到10月，政府在7,300个建筑工地检查中发出了84张吸烟定额罚款通知书。大多数检查都是未经通知的，其中 28 项罚款来自有照片或视频证据的公众投诉。
香港劳工及福利局局长孙玉光表示，自7月17日全港建筑地盘禁烟令实施以来，政府已向承包商发出84张违规吸烟定额罚款通知书和5张传票，涉及4起案件。这些数字涵盖截至 10 月底的时期，在此期间，劳工部检查了 7,300 个地点。
孙在11月10日的一次活动中表示，7,300次检查中有一些是因公众投诉而引发的，但大多数是劳工部进行的突击抽查。在84份定额罚款通知中，​​有28份是基于公众投诉，大部分都附有照片或录像。
孙还指出，今年早些时候，政府更新了《移动式高空作业平台安全使用指南》，表示希望其实施能够防止相关事故的发生。此外，《竹棚架安全工作守则》及《金属棚架安全工作守则》的修订版已于七月底在宪报刊登。
脚手架规范的主要修订内容包括底板的强度和耐火要求、防护板的耐火标准以及倾斜脚手架的设计和安装规范，为承包商提供了明确、可执行的实践指导。

Hong Kong issues 84 smoking fines at 7,300 construction sites since ban | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong issues 84 smoking fines at 7,300 construction sites since ban
Hong Kong's labour chief said the government issued 84 fixed-penalty notices for smoking at 7,300 construction-site inspections from July to October. Most checks were unannounced, and 28 fines came from public complaints with photo or video evidence.
Hong Kong's Secretary for Labour and Welfare, Sun Yuk-kwong, said the government has issued 84 fixed-penalty notices for smoking violations and five summonses against contractors involving four cases since a territory-wide smoking ban at construction sites took effect on 17 July. The figures cover the period up to the end of October, during which the Labour Department inspected 7,300 sites.
Speaking at an event on 10 November, Sun said some of the 7,300 inspections were triggered by public complaints, but the majority were unannounced spot checks by the Labour Department. Of the 84 fixed-penalty notices, 28 were based on public complaints, most of which were accompanied by photographs or video footage.
Sun also noted that earlier this year the government updated the Guidelines for the Safe Use of Mobile Elevated Work Platforms, expressing hope that its implementation would prevent related accidents. In addition, amendments to the Code of Practice for Bamboo Scaffolding Safety and the Code of Practice for Metal Scaffolding Safety were published in the Gazette at the end of July.
The main revisions to the scaffolding codes cover strength and fire-resistance requirements for base boards, fire-resistance standards for protective sheeting, and design and installation specifications for sloping scaffolding, providing contractors with clear, enforceable practical guidance.

zh_title: 香港立法会环境委员会参观港灯智能运营中心
summary: 香港立法会环境委员会参观港灯智能运营中心 |中国劳工布告栏 星期二, 10 11 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 香港立法会环境委员会参观港灯智能运营中心 立法会环境委员会参观港灯智能运营及应急中心，了解人工智能和科技以提高电网复原力。成员们听取了有关脱碳工作的简报，包括到 2029 年建立新的天然气机组，将燃气发电量提高到 80% 左右。立法会环境事务委员会
content:
香港立法会环境委员会参观港灯智能运营中心 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港立法会环境委员会参观港灯智能运营中心
立法会环境事务委员会参观港灯智能运作及紧急应变中心，了解人工智能及科技如何提升电网复原力。成员们听取了有关脱碳工作的简报，包括到 2029 年建立新的天然气机组，将燃气发电量提高到 80% 左右。
立法会环境事务委员会于11月10日参观香港电灯公司（港灯）位于北角的智慧运营及应急中心，了解提升电力供应弹性的最新技术和措施。
立法会首先听取港灯代表介绍该中心的运作情况，该中心已于今年六月开始运作。该中心集中了不同部门的监控平台，并使用人工智能（AI）远程监控系统（称为“港灯智能电网连接”）实时跟踪约50个变电站的运行情况。成员们被告知，该系统使工程团队能够预测洪水风险并快速应对紧急情况。立法会议员与港灯代表讨论如何进一步提高整体供电可靠性、更准确地定位故障电缆以及加快电力恢复。
事务委员会其后听取港灯减碳工作的简介。他们被告知，新的燃气发电机组 L13 将于 2029 年开始运营，将天然气在发电中的比例从约 70% 提高到约 80%，进一步减少碳排放。立法会议员亦了解港灯所实施的环保措施，例如在南丫发电厂种植本地树种以吸引鸟类，以及利用新技术减少对附近水体和海洋生物的影响，保护生物多样性。
参观结束前，立法会议员参观了港灯客户中心提供的电力账户检查、技术咨询等服务。委员及非委员共14人参加了此次访问。

Hong Kong LegCo environment panel visits HK Electric smart operations centre | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong LegCo environment panel visits HK Electric smart operations centre
LegCo's environment panel visited HK Electric's smart operations and emergency response centre, learning about AI and tech to improve grid resilience. Members were briefed on decarbonisation efforts, including a new gas unit by 2029 to raise gas-fired generation to about 80 per cent.
The Legislative Council (LegCo) Panel on Environmental Affairs on 10 November visited Hongkong Electric Company (HK Electric) smart operations and emergency response centre in North Point to learn about the latest technology and measures to enhance power supply resilience.
Legislators first heard a briefing from HK Electric representatives on the operations of the centre, which started operating in June this year. The centre centralises monitoring platforms from different departments and uses an artificial intelligence (AI) remote monitoring system, described as 'HK Electric Smart Grid Connect', to track in real time the operation of about 50 substations. Members were told that the system allows engineering teams to predict flooding risks and respond quickly to emergencies. The legislators discussed with HK Electric representatives ways to further improve overall supply reliability, more accurately locate faulty cables, and speed up power restoration.
The panel then received a briefing on HK Electric's decarbonisation work. They were told that a new gas-fired generating unit, L13, would begin operation in 2029, raising the share of natural gas in generation from about 70 per cent to about 80 per cent, further cutting carbon emissions. Legislators also learned about environmental measures HK Electric has implemented, such as planting native tree species at Lamma Power Station to attract birds, and using new technology to reduce impacts on nearby water bodies and marine life, protecting biodiversity.
Before the visit ended, legislators saw services offered at the HK Electric customer centre, including electrical account inspection and technical consultation. A total of 14 committee and non-committee members attended the visit.

title: Hong Kong official urges student athletes to shine at World Schools Games
zh_title: 香港官员敦促学生运动员在世界学校运动会上大放异彩
summary: 香港官员敦促学生运动员在世界学校运动会上大放异彩中国劳工公告 2026 年 11 月 10 日星期二·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港官员敦促学生运动员在世界中小学生运动会上大放异彩 香港文化及体育部长在第 21 届世界小学生运动会的授旗仪式上致辞，鼓励 38 名学生运动员于 12 月 3 日至 8 日在里约热内卢积累经验并展现韧性。香港文化体育及旅游局局长在第21届世界学校运动会授旗仪式上致辞
content:
香港官员敦促学生运动员在世界学校运动会上大放异彩中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港官员敦促学生运动员在世界学校运动会上大放异彩
香港文化及体育部长于12月3日至8日在里约热内卢举行的第21届世界中学生运动会授旗仪式上致辞，鼓励38名学生运动员积累经验并展现韧性。
香港文化体育及旅游局局长于2026年11月10日在第21届世界中小学生运动会中国香港学校代表队授旗仪式上致辞。局长表示，这是他继参加过亚运会、全运会和青奥会后，首次出席学校体育授旗仪式。他将学生运动员描述为该市的下一代体育人才管道。
世界学校运动会是两年一度的学生运动员赛事，将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日至 8 日在巴西里约热内卢举行。中国香港代表团将由 38 名学生选手组成，参加田径和沙滩排球比赛。秘书鼓励运动员们获得宝贵的比赛经验，并在面对更大或更强大的对手时表现出韧性。
局长列举了香港运动员从学校级别晋升到亚运会和奥运会的例子。他指出，游泳运动员马子凌在名古屋亚运会上表现出色，此前曾参加过世界中学生运动会并获得奖牌。他还提到17岁的击剑运动员何成谦在世界青年运动会上获得金牌，打破了此前由秦燕燕保持的银牌纪录。
局长感谢香港学界体育联会举办校际比赛，并与政府合作。自2013/14学年起，联合会与政府合作开展学生运动员赞助计划，为贫困学生提供装备和训练。从2024/25学年起，城市体育赞助计划资助中小学城市体育培训班。
秘书还对校长、老师、教练和家长的支持表示感谢。他说，社会不再要求年轻人在体育和学术之间做出选择，并指出运动员可以在从事体育事业的同时继续学习和职业培训。他祝愿代表团取得成功，并勉励运动员享受比赛，以决心、行为和体育精神讲述香港故事。

Hong Kong official urges student athletes to shine at World Schools Games | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong official urges student athletes to shine at World Schools Games
Hong Kong's culture and sports minister addressed a flag-presentation ceremony for the 21st World Schools Games, encouraging 38 student athletes to gain experience and show resilience in Rio de Janeiro from 3-8 December.
Hong Kong's Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism addressed the flag-presentation ceremony for the 21st World Schools Games China Hong Kong Schools Delegation on 10 November 2026. The secretary said it was the first time he had attended a schools sports flag ceremony, having previously attended those for the Asian Games, National Games and Youth Olympic Games. He described the student athletes as the next generation of the city's sports talent pipeline.
The World Schools Games, a biennial event for student athletes, will be held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil from 3 to 8 December 2026. The China Hong Kong delegation will comprise 38 student competitors taking part in athletics and beach volleyball. The secretary encouraged the athletes to gain valuable competition experience and show resilience against opponents who may be larger or stronger.
The secretary cited examples of Hong Kong athletes who had progressed from the schools level to the Asian Games and Olympic Games. He noted that swimmer Ma Ziling, who performed well at the Asian Games in Nagoya, had previously competed in the World Schools Games and won medals. He also mentioned fencer Ho Shing-him, who at age 17 won a gold medal at the World Youth Games, breaking the previous record of a silver medal by Chun Yin-yin.
The secretary thanked the Hong Kong Schools Sports Federation for organising inter-school competitions and for partnering with the government. Since the 2013/14 academic year, the federation has worked with the government on a student athlete sponsorship scheme to support underprivileged students with equipment and training. From the 2024/25 academic year, a city sports sponsorship scheme has funded urban sports training classes in primary and secondary schools.
The secretary also expressed gratitude to principals, teachers, coaches and parents for their support. He said society no longer required young people to choose between sports and academics, noting that athletes could continue their studies and vocational training alongside their sporting careers. He wished the delegation success and urged the athletes to enjoy the competition and tell the Hong Kong story through their determination, conduct and sportsmanship.

summary: 台湾尚未选出新驻马绍尔群岛特使：外交部 - 焦点台湾 台湾尚未选出新驻马绍尔群岛特使：外交部 要启动文字转语音服务，请先同意以下隐私政策。中新社台北11月9日电 台湾外交部周一表示，在前任驻马绍尔群岛大使因国庆变装秀引发争议而离职后，台湾仍在遴选新任驻马绍尔群岛大使。徐蔚民上月底在排练完演出后被勒令辞去大使职务。
content:
外交部：台湾尚未选出新驻马绍尔群岛特使 - 聚焦台湾
外交部：台湾尚未选出新驻马绍尔群岛特使
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月9日电 台湾外交部周一表示，在前任驻马绍尔群岛大使因国庆变装秀引发争议而离职后，台湾仍在遴选新任驻马绍尔群岛大使。
徐蔚民为10月10日国庆庆典排练演出被外交部认定为“不当”，上月底被勒令辞去大使职务。
周一被问及是否已选出新大使时，外交部告诉中央社，“考虑到台湾驻外外交使节肩负的重大责任”，遴选过程仍在进行中。
外交部补充说：“外交部将综合考虑国家总体外交政策、运作要求、专业能力和个人诚信，尽快挑选合适的人选任命。”
与此同时，中华民国驻马绍尔群岛大使馆由副馆长刘汉清公使领导，运作正常。
外交部发表此番言论之前，当地媒体周一早些时候报道称，内阁最近批准了外交部将徐召回台北的建议，并从 11 月 5 日起将他调往外交部外交国际事务研究所。
在一段马绍尔群岛国庆变装表演活动排练视频曝光后，徐面临两党的批评，视频显示，作为表演的一部分，他坐在小木床上，由八名马绍尔男子作为担架抬着。
外交部长林佳龙在10月28日的立法院听证会上表示，外交部已召回徐，以解释情况，并确保今后不再发生类似事件。
林补充说，徐事件不会影响台湾与马绍尔群岛之间的外交关系。
许是近几个月来第二位因争议而被召回台北的台湾外交官。
台湾驻日内瓦代表处负责人李冠德上月底被免职，原因是他的同事投诉职场欺凌行为，调查小组后来证实了这一点。
此外，李在七月下旬还被指控滥用公共资源谋取个人目的。外交部告诉中央社，这些指控仍在调查中。
李被召回台湾后，一直在台北外交部总部工作。
外交部非政府组织国际司副司长康嘉棋已被任命为继任者。

Taiwan yet to select new envoy to Marshall Islands: MOFA - Focus Taiwan
Taiwan yet to select new envoy to Marshall Islands: MOFA
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 9 (CNA) Taiwan is still in the process of selecting a new ambassador to the Marshall Islands, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Monday, following the departure of the previous envoy amid a controversy over a proposed drag show on National Day.
Herbert Hsu (徐蔚民) was ordered to leave his ambassadorial post late last month after his rehearsal of the show for the Oct. 10 Taiwan National Day celebrations was deemed "inappropriate" by MOFA.
Asked on Monday whether a new ambassador had been chosen, MOFA told CNA that the selection process was still ongoing, "given the significant responsibilities entrusted to Taiwan's diplomatic envoys abroad."
"The ministry will take into account the nation's overall foreign policy, operational requirements, professional competence, and personal integrity before picking a suitable candidate for appointment as soon as possible," MOFA added.
In the meantime, the Republic of China (Taiwan) Embassy in the Marshall Islands is being headed by its second-in-command, Minister Hank Liu (劉漢清), and its operations are continuing normally, MOFA said.
MOFA's comments came after local media reported earlier Monday that the Cabinet had recently approved the ministry's recommendation to recall Hsu to Taipei, and that he had been reassigned to MOFA's Institute of Diplomacy and International Affairs, with effect from Nov. 5.
Hsu faced bipartisan criticism after a video of a rehearsal for a National Day drag show event in the Marshall Islands emerged, showing him sitting on small wooden bed being carried as a litter by eight Marshallese men, as part of the performance.
During a legislative hearing on Oct. 28, Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) said the ministry had recalled Hsu to explain the circumstances and to ensure that there would be no similar incidents in the future.
The Hsu incident would not affect diplomatic ties between Taiwan and the Marshall Islands, Lin added.
Hsu was the second Taiwanese diplomat to be recalled to Taipei in recent months due to controversy.
Greg Lee (李冠德), who headed Taiwan's representative office in Geneva, was removed from his post in the Swiss city late last month, following complaints by his colleagues of workplace bullying, which an investigative team later confirmed.
In addition, Lee was also accused in late July of misusing public resources for personal purposes. MOFA told CNA that those accusations were still under investigation.
Since his recall to Taiwan, Lee has been working at MOFA's headquarters in Taipei.
Kang Chia-chi (康嘉棋), deputy head of MOFA's Department of NGO International Affairs, has been named his successor.

There will be no shenanigans, no political lifelines and no coalitions just for the sake of it, says Duduzane Zuma as he lays out the MK party’s approach to government and explains why its leadership reshuffles do not worry him.
Duduzane Zuma, son of former president Jacob Zuma. (Photo: Gallo Images / Netwerk24 / Felix Dlangamandla)
Duduzane Zuma, the son of former president Jacob Zuma, has spent much of his life around politics, but was not directly involved until two years ago.
Now, he finds himself at the centre of some of the biggest political decisions the uMkhonto Wesizwe (MK) party will have to make as it prepares to negotiate its way into government in several municipalities.
As the party’s first deputy president, Zuma has been tasked with leading coalition negotiations that could see the MK party take control of several municipalities, including eThekwini, where it has become the largest party, but failed to secure an outright majority.
It is a big responsibility for Zuma, who admits that although he grew up around politics, he has not always been directly involved. His growing prominence also comes as the party faces questions about its leadership stability, its ability to govern and whether he could one day take over from his father.
Speaking to Daily Maverick, Zuma reflected on his political journey, the lessons learnt from the 2024 elections, his ambitions for eThekwini and the frequent leadership reshuffles within the MK party, which he dismissed as teething problems. He also spoke about his father’s leadership and whether he saw himself following in his footsteps.
The MK party’s Duduzane Zuma at the Results Operations Centre (ROC) at Gallagher Convention Centre in Midrand on 4 November 2026. (Photo: Gallo Images / Sydney Seshibedi)
Question: You have not always been involved in politics, despite growing up in a political family. What has the journey been like so far?
Answer: I haven’t been on the frontline like many people, but we understand the game. We grew up around it. We know who is who and what is what, but this time around, an opportunity has been presented, not just for MK, but for the country.
What I always say is that everyone in society needs to take their place, take a stand. Being an activist doesn’t necessarily mean you sit in some municipal office or some government department. It’s about making change in the community.
Everything that happens in this country is politically driven: where we shop, what we eat, where we go, how we socialise. So, at some point, you have to take a stand.
Q: In the 2024 national and provincial elections, the MK party performed well, but ultimately found itself outside government, almost caught off guard when the coalition talks started. Did the party take any lessons from that, and how will you approach coalition negotiations differently this time?
A: You are absolutely correct. I think last time there was a plan in place, except this time they have been strengthened. I will be there and so there will be no shenanigans. We want to work with people who are honest, who are not going to take us for a ride, simple as that.
Our attitude has been to engage with organisations that have the same standpoint as us, similar values, morals and policies.
Former president Jacob Zuma supports his son Duduzane at the Randburg Magistrate’s Court, where he faced charges of culpable homicide on January 24, 2019. Duduzane Zuma, 34, was found not guilty of two charges of culpable homicide and a count of negligent driving linked to an incident in February 2014‚ when his Porsche collided with a minibus taxi near Sandton‚ killing two taxi passengers. (Photo: Gallo Images / Sowetan / Alon Skuy)
Q: The MK party has emerged as the biggest party in eThekwini, but governing the city will require coalition agreements. What are your plans for the metro?
A: Reindustrialisation, more than anything, and that will deal with every other issue. The water crisis, electricity – it’s about having the correct systems in place that will run optimally. It’s about getting people who will deliver.
We don’t want people sitting down when we’re supposed to be active. You can feel when a lot of departments are on cruise control. The whip will be cracked.
There’s a lot of money that is being wasted, not just wasteful expenditure, but because of people who are lacking.
We want the budget to grow so that we can enforce and get things done from a service delivery perspective. So, reindustrialisation is going to be a drive. It’s going to dictate what is built, how it is built and where it is built.
Water, electricity, roads – we are going full force on them, using not just the government budget, but partnering with private entities, local and international, to make sure that we get the city back to first class.
Q: There is a possibility that the ANC, IFP and DA could once again work together to keep the MK party out of government in municipalities such as eThekwini. Are you prepared for that possibility?
A: They’ve done it before. They’re probably going to try it again, but we are here. Lots of lessons learnt, but things will be different.
Q: There have been concerns about instability in the party, given the constant reshuffling of leaders, most recently the secretary-general, Sibonelo Nomvalo. How do you respond to concerns that this could affect the party’s ability to govern?
A: If you look at the leader of the party, he’s got a history of reshuffles. I think he still holds the record for the majority of them as a head of state, so he’s brought that culture into the organisation, and he is very clear on that.
We are not going to be held to ransom by anyone over a position. What you are expected to do, you should do as per your role and responsibility, and if you’re not doing that, then you shouldn’t be there.
So I think people need to understand that even though the MK is a two-year-old party, it is still institutionalising. It came out six months before the 2024 elections, and it did amazing things. It’s been growing organically. I mean, the structures are still there.
These things happen. These are teething problems. We will find the right people. It’s not being arrogant or heavy-handed. We want the right people to do the job.
Q: The MK party has often been accused of being a tribalistic party, mostly because much of its support comes from KZN. What do you make of that?
A: That is not true. The MK party should be the right party for everyone. We are all about non-racialism, non-sexism and non-tribalism, and non-xenophobic.
Q: There are talks that you are being prepared to eventually succeed your father as leader of the MK party. Is that something you would consider, and do you see yourself following in his footsteps?
A: Given an opportunity, hell yeah.
But I think those are some massive shoes that I don’t think many people can fill, myself included. What he does, he’s been doing, and no one does it better than him. I do me at all times. If I can become half the man that he has been as a politician, statesman and father, I would have made it.
KZN coalition dilemma: Will election losers find their way back to power?
Q: How keen is the MK party to govern, given what happened in 2024?
A: We won’t enter into coalitions just for the sake of it. We are not here to rescue people who have messed up. We don’t want a situation where we are resurrecting parties that people have rejected. DM

title: Hong Kong doctors urge more Covid vaccine sites as booster rate languishes at 1.27 per cent
zh_title: 由于加强率低至1.27%，香港医生敦促建立更多新冠疫苗接种点
summary: 由于加强疫苗接种率低至1.27%，香港医生敦促建立更多新冠疫苗接种点中国劳工布告栏 2026 年 11 月 10 日星期二·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港医生敦促建立更多新冠疫苗接种点，因为加强接种率低至 1.27% 香港的新冠加强接种率仅为 1.27%。西医协会敦促增加疫苗接种点和流感式的补贴计划。孔繁毅教授预计下一波疫情将在9至12个月内出现，并指出最近高峰期出现的重症或死亡病例超过170例。香港西医协会
content:
由于加强疫苗接种率低至1.27%，香港医生敦促建立更多新冠疫苗接种点中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
由于加强率低至1.27%，香港医生敦促建立更多新冠疫苗接种点
香港的Covid助推剂使用率仅为1.27%。西医协会敦促增加疫苗接种点和流感式的补贴计划。孔繁毅教授预计下一波疫情将在9至12个月内出现，并指出最近高峰期出现的重症或死亡病例超过170例。
香港西医协会警告说，Covid-19疫苗加强剂的使用率仍然极低，只有1.27%的人口接受了加强剂量。该组织呼吁政府将新冠疫苗接种纳入常规，效仿流感疫苗接种补贴计划，并增加疫苗接种点的数量，以提高覆盖率并增强社区免疫力。
最近对 300 名私人医生进行的一项在线调查显示，近 40% 的人表示，他们不会主动提醒患者接种新冠疫苗，主要是因为他们的诊所没有库存疫苗。协会会长卢伟良博士指出，在其他司法管辖区，65岁及以上人士的疫苗接种率在台湾为20%，在韩国为40%，在英国为65%。
卢博士表示，香港目前只有76个新冠疫苗接种点。他建议政府允许同一地点同时提供流感和新冠疫苗注射，这样患者就可以在一次就诊时接受两种注射，从而提高接种率和保护率。
新冠公共卫生关注小组成员、香港大学临床医学系讲座教授关文仪教授表示，最新的新冠疫情高峰刚刚过去，至少有170例重症或死亡病例。他预测下一波浪潮将在 9 到 12 个月内出现。他强调，公众不应低估新冠病毒，并指出加强剂可显着降低老年人和慢性病患者等高危人群患重病或死亡的风险。

Hong Kong doctors urge more Covid vaccine sites as booster rate languishes at 1.27 per cent | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong doctors urge more Covid vaccine sites as booster rate languishes at 1.27 per cent
Hong Kong's Covid booster uptake is only 1.27 per cent. The Western Medicine Doctors' Association urges more vaccination points and a flu-style subsidy scheme. Professor孔繁毅 predicts the next wave in 9-12 months, citing over 170 severe or fatal cases in the recent peak.
Hong Kong's Western Medicine Doctors' Association has warned that the uptake of Covid-19 vaccine boosters remains extremely low, with only 1.27 per cent of the population having received a booster dose. The group has called on the government to make Covid vaccinations routine, mirroring the influenza vaccination subsidy scheme, and to increase the number of vaccination points to boost coverage and strengthen community immunity.
In a recent online survey of 300 private doctors, nearly 40 per cent said they would not proactively remind patients to get a Covid jab, mainly because their clinics do not stock the vaccine. Association president Dr Lo Wai-leung noted that in other jurisdictions, vaccination rates among those aged 65 and over stand at 20 per cent in Taiwan, 40 per cent in South Korea and 65 per cent in the United Kingdom.
Dr Lo said Hong Kong currently has only 76 Covid vaccination points. He suggested that the government allow the same sites to offer both flu and Covid jabs simultaneously, so that patients could receive both shots in one visit, thereby improving uptake and protection.
Professor Kwan Man-yee, a member of the Covid Public Health Concern Group and chair professor in the Department of Clinical Medicine at the University of Hong Kong, said the latest Covid peak has just passed, with at least 170 severe or fatal cases recorded. He predicted the next wave would emerge in nine to 12 months. He stressed that the public should not underestimate Covid, noting that boosters significantly reduce the risk of severe illness or death among high-risk groups such as the elderly and those with chronic conditions.

title: Trump’s close ties to Nvidia’s Huang scrutinized after foreign intelligence concerns
zh_title: 因外国情报担忧，特朗普与英伟达黄仁勋的密切关系受到审查
summary: 美国华盛顿——11 月 9 日星期一，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的密切关系再次受到审查，此前该公司表示，其董事会正在调查这位科技高管是否成为外国情报活动的目标。黄仁勋是特朗普在硅谷最亲密的盟友之一，两人之间的关系至少可以追溯到 2025 年。过去两年，他多次表示支持政府的议程，并在英伟达寻求向中国市场出售先进芯片时成为华盛顿的常客。进步
content:
美国华盛顿——11 月 9 日星期一，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的密切关系再次受到审查，此前该公司表示，其董事会正在调查这位科技高管是否成为外国情报活动的目标。黄仁勋是特朗普在硅谷最亲密的盟友之一，两人之间的关系至少可以追溯到 2025 年。过去两年，他多次表示支持政府的议程，并在英伟达寻求向中国市场出售先进芯片时成为华盛顿的常客。先进芯片是美国人工智能繁荣的支柱，政府官员此前曾试图通过出口管制来限制中国获得这些芯片，以扼杀其人工智能能力。 《纽约时报》报道称黄与中国女商人黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 关系密切，美国情报官员认为黄爱丽向中国政府传递了信息，随后英伟达董事会启动了调查。英伟达股价周一收盘下跌超过 4%。必读 Nvidia 首席执行官黄因涉嫌中国间谍的信息披露而提起诉讼 “我正在推动调查黄仁勋和 Nvidia，以确定我们的国家安全是否受到损害，”特拉华州民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯 (Chris Coons) 在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示。
“我们需要了解人工智能亿万富翁和特朗普政府之间的关系，谁在做出这些决定，谁真正掌握着方向盘。”众议院外交事务委员会的民主党人致信美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，呼吁商务部停止向中国出口先进人工智能芯片。美国众议员加布·阿莫、格雷戈里·米克斯和悉尼·卡姆拉格-多夫在 12 月 1 日之前寻求答案，询问商务部高级官员是否了解美国情报机构将新加坡 ⁠Megaspeed 前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 与中国获取 Nvidia 芯片的努力联系起来。他们还在信中询问高层官员是否就 Alice Huang 和 Megaspeed 问题与国务卿马可·卢比奥进行了沟通。 “如果商务部没有收到简报，我们需要知道原因。如果有简报，我们需要知道它如何回应。如果商务部在存在可信的国家安全担忧的情况下故意允许这些出口，那么美国人民应该得到解释，”信中补充道。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与美国总统有直接联系。路透社记者在2025年12月看到黄的全名出现在特朗普的手机上。5月份，黄与特朗普一起乘坐空军一号飞往中国，这是近十年来美国总统首次访问中国。 9月，黄在白宫出席了中国国家主席习近平举行的备受瞩目的国宴。
据媒体报道，该公司承诺为特朗普计划中的白宫舞厅提供 2500 万美元。 据《纽约时报》报道，特朗普已获悉黄与该女子的关系以及她向中国政府提供信息的情报，但他选择不根据这些信息采取行动。白宫新闻办公室周一拒绝就特朗普与黄的关系发表进一步评论。特朗普周一表示，联邦调查局正在调查英伟达首席执行官与被指控为北京间谍的中国女商人的恋情。特朗普表示，他已与首席执行官交谈，后者告诉他，他不知道该女子是间谍。特朗普表示他相信首席执行官。中国

【原文 English Original】
WASHINGTON, USA – US President Donald Trump’s close relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang came under renewed scrutiny on Monday, November 9, after the company said its board was investigating whether the tech executive has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. Huang is one of Trump’s closest allies in Silicon Valley, and the relationship between the two dates to at least 2025. Over the past two years, he has repeatedly voiced support for the administration’s agenda and become a regular presence in Washington as Nvidia sought to sell advanced chips to the Chinese market. Advanced chips are the backbone of the US AI boom and government officials have previously tried to restrict China’s access to them through export controls to stifle its AI capabilities. Nvidia’s board launched its probe after a New York Times report said Huang had a close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who US intelligence officials believe passed information to the Chinese government. Nvidia shares closed down more than 4% on Monday. Must Read Nvidia, CEO Huang sued over disclosures related to suspected Chinese spy “I’m pushing to investigate Jensen Huang and Nvidia to determine whether our national security was compromised,” said Senator Chris Coons, a Delaware Democrat, in a post on X. “We need answers about the relationship between AI billionaires and the Trump administration, who’s making these decisions, and who’s really got their hand on the wheel.” Democrats on the House of Representatives Foreign Affairs Committee wrote to US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, calling on the Commerce Department to halt exports of advanced AI chips to China. US Representatives Gabe Amo, Gregory Meeks and Sydney Kamlager-Dove sought answers by December 1 on whether top officials at the Commerce Department were aware of US intelligence linking Alice Huang, a former executive of Singapore-based ⁠Megaspeed who is not related to the Nvidia CEO, to Chinese efforts to obtain Nvidia chips. They also asked in their letter whether the top officials communicated with Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding Alice Huang and Megaspeed. “If Commerce was not briefed, we need to know why. If it was briefed, we need to know how it responded. And if the Department knowingly permitted these exports despite credible national-security concerns, the American people deserve an explanation,” the letter added. Jensen Huang, the Nvidia CEO, has a direct line to the US president. A Reuters reporter saw Huang’s full name pop up on Trump’s phone in December 2025. Huang flew with Trump to China on Air Force One in May, the first visit by a US president to China in nearly a decade. Huang attended a high-profile state dinner in September for Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House. The company committed $25 million for Trump’s planned White House ballroom, according to media reports. The New York Times reported that Trump had been briefed on Huang’s relationship with the woman and on intelligence that she was giving information to the Chinese government, and that he chose not to act on the information. The White House press office on Monday declined to comment further on Trump’s relationship with Huang. Trump said on Monday the FBI was looking into the Nvidia CEO’s affair with the Chinese businesswoman alleged to be a spy for Beijing. Trump said he had spoken to the CEO, who told him that he had no idea that the woman was a spy. Trump said he believed the CEO. China’s foreign ministry said the spy accusations were “groundless.” Reuters could not determine Alice Huang’s location to seek comment from her on Monday. Huang’s relationship with Trump has coincided with several favorable policy developments for the company. In April 2025, the administration backed off plans to restrict exports of certain Nvidia AI chips to China after Huang attended a dinner at Trump’s Mar-a-Lago club in Florida. In December 2025, Trump said the US would allow Nvidia to export its H200 processors, its second-best AI chips, to China and collect a 25% fee on such sales. Trump has lavished Huang with praise, awarding him the nation’s highest honor for scientific achievement in October. The same day Trump gave Huang the award, the president disclosed buying up to $1.6 million and selling up to $1 million in Nvidia stock during the summer. White House spokesperson Davis Ingle told Reuters at the time that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president’s portfolio. – Rappler.com

content:
香港招聘会提供逾2,700个优质职位空缺 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港招聘会提供逾2,700个优质职位空缺
香港举行的为期两天的招聘会提供了来自 60 多家组织的 2,700 多个优质职位空缺，其中 83% 是全职职位。大多数职位的月薪为 12,000 港元至 25,000 港元，并且要求的教育程度不超过中七。
香港政府于 11 月 10 日宣布，为期两天的香港招聘会提供了来自 60 多个组织的 2,700 多个优质职位空缺。约83%的职位为全职，大部分月薪介乎12,000港元至25,000港元。
超过1,800个职位空缺来自餐饮、零售和物流运输行业。据劳工部称，约 94% 的职位需要中七或以下学历，约 52% 的职位不需要相关工作经验。
提供的职位类型包括助理屋宇装备工程师、分公司经理、电气技术主任、注册护士、仓库主管、后勤助理、医疗助理、助理康复服务工、助理物业主任、会计文员、客户服务助理、包裹分拣员、海关业务主任、航空货运服务主任、销售助理、质量控制主任、交通协管员、个人紧急联络服务专家、保安主任、厨师和司机。
每天都有大约 30 个设有招聘柜台的组织参加该活动。求职者可以现场提交申请，并可能立即进行面试。劳工处还设有一个柜台，提供有关其就业服务的信息。
展览会将于11:00至17:30在旺角奶路臣街38号麦花臣大球场举行，邻近旺角港铁站E2出口。免费入场，最后入场时间为每天 17:00。所有职位空缺详情可浏览劳工处互动就业服务网站www.jobs.gov.hk。

Hong Kong job fair offers over 2,700 quality vacancies | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong job fair offers over 2,700 quality vacancies
A two-day job fair in Hong Kong is offering over 2,700 quality vacancies from more than 60 organisations, with 83 per cent being full-time roles. Most positions pay HK$12,000 to HK$25,000 monthly and require no more than Form 7 education.
A two-day job fair in Hong Kong is providing more than 2,700 quality vacancies from over 60 organisations, the city's government announced on 10 November. About 83 per cent of the positions are full-time, with most monthly salaries ranging from HK$12,000 to HK$25,000.
More than 1,800 vacancies come from the catering, retail and logistics-transport sectors. Around 94 per cent of all positions require education at Form 7 level or below, and about 52 per cent do not require relevant work experience, according to the Labour Department.
Job types on offer include assistant building services engineer, branch manager, electrical technical officer, enrolled nurse, warehouse supervisor, logistics assistant, medical assistant, assistant rehabilitation service worker, assistant property officer, accounting clerk, customer service assistant, parcel sorter, customs operations officer, air cargo service officer, sales assistant, quality control officer, traffic warden, personal emergency link service specialist, security officer, chef and driver.
Each day of the event features around 30 organisations with recruitment counters. Job seekers can submit applications on site and may be interviewed immediately. The Labour Department also has a counter providing information on its employment services.
The fair is being held from 11:00 to 17:30 at the MacPherson Stadium, 38 Nelson Street, Mong Kok, near Exit E2 of Mong Kok MTR station. Admission is free, with last entry at 17:00 daily. Details of all vacancies are available on the Labour Department's Interactive Employment Service website at www.jobs.gov.hk.

content:
粤港澳海关深化知识产权执法合作 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
粤港澳海关深化知识产权执法合作
粤港澳海关同意加强大湾区知识产权执法。 7月进行的为期12天的联合行动，检获约38,000件怀疑冒牌货品，价值1,500万港元。三方将加强针对性行动、情报共享和研究
粤港澳海关于2026年11月10日举行会议后同意深化大湾区知识产权执法合作。三地双方回顾了近期的联合行动，并制定了打击跨境走私假货的策略。
在2026年7月20日至31日为期12天的联合行动中，三地海关加强了对美洲、欧洲、中东、非洲和东南亚过境货物的检查。香港海关利用风险评估，针对物流中心和仓库，检获约38,000件怀疑冒牌物品，包括手表、手机及配件，估计市值约1,500万港元。
三地海关就未来大湾区合作的三大领域达成共识。一是针对特定口岸和高风险货物开展更有针对性的联合行动。二是完善多层次情报共享渠道，建立双向反馈机制，提升跨境执法效能。第三，加强与权利人的沟通，建立包括执法机构、行业机构和知识产权权利人在内的协作框架。三方表示，旨在为大湾区打造“知识产权保护伞”，帮助国内品牌拓展海外市场。
中国海关总署广东分署代表团还参观了位于香港屯门的快递运营中心。是次访问旨在展示香港海关如何监控快件、与业界紧密合作并分享信息，以提高风险识别和执法效率，同时促进合法贸易。
2019年以来，三地海关按照粤港澳大湾区发展蓝图，把知识产权保护作为重点工作。双方开展了情报交流、联合行动、考察访问等活动。粤港澳海关知识产权执法合作会议是总结成果、分享执法经验、规划未来策略的平台。

Guangdong, Hong Kong, Macau customs deepen IP enforcement cooperation | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Guangdong, Hong Kong, Macau customs deepen IP enforcement cooperation
Customs from Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macau agreed to strengthen intellectual property enforcement in the Greater Bay Area. A 12-day joint operation in July seized about 38,000 suspected counterfeit goods worth HK$15 million. The three sides will enhance targeted actions, intelligence sharing and ri
Customs authorities from Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macau have agreed to deepen intellectual property (IP) enforcement cooperation in the Greater Bay Area, following a meeting on 10 November 2026. The three sides reviewed recent joint operations and set out a strategy to combat cross-border trafficking of counterfeit goods.
During a 12-day joint operation from 20 to 31 July 2026, the three customs services intensified checks on cargo in transit to the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia. Hong Kong Customs, using risk assessment, targeted logistics centres and warehouses and seized about 38,000 suspected counterfeit items, including watches, mobile phones and accessories, with an estimated street value of about HK$15 million.
The three customs authorities reached a consensus on three main areas for future cooperation in the Greater Bay Area. First, they will develop more targeted joint operations focusing on specific border checkpoints and high-risk goods. Second, they will improve multi-level intelligence-sharing channels and establish a two-way feedback mechanism to boost the effectiveness of cross-border enforcement. Third, they will strengthen communication with rights holders, building a collaborative framework that includes enforcement agencies, industry bodies and IP owners. The three sides said they aim to create an "IP protection umbrella" for the Greater Bay Area to help domestic brands expand overseas.
A delegation from the Guangdong branch of China's General Administration of Customs also visited a courier operations centre in Tuen Mun, Hong Kong. The visit aimed to demonstrate how Hong Kong Customs monitors express shipments, works closely with the industry and shares information to improve risk identification and enforcement efficiency while facilitating legitimate trade.
The three customs authorities have prioritised IP protection since 2019, in line with the Greater Bay Area development blueprint. They have conducted intelligence exchanges, joint operations and study visits. The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Customs IP Enforcement Cooperation Meeting serves as a platform to review results, share enforcement experience and plan future strategies.

华盛顿，11 月 9 日（韩联社）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示，英伟达公司首席执行官 (CEO) 黄仁勋告诉他，他不了解涉嫌中国间谍活动的情况，其中涉及一名涉嫌间谍争议的女商人。
特朗普在白宫举行的新闻发布会上表示，他直接问黄是否知道该女子是间谍。
“他说，‘我不知道她是间谍’，我真的相信他，”特朗普说。
黄卷入了一场涉及一名涉嫌担任北京情报人员的中国女商人的争议。中国否认了间谍指控。
特朗普在白宫对记者说：“我今天问（黄），因为我今天确实和他谈过，只是想看看他是否感觉还好。”
特朗普表示，他已经关注这些指控，联邦调查局（FBI）正在调查此事。
“我们会调查此事。我知道联邦调查局正在从其他方面调查此事，我认为他会状况良好，”特朗普说。
总统还为黄的品格进行了辩护，称他是一位值得尊敬的商人。 “我非常了解詹森。我只是认为他是一个非常值得尊敬的人。”
英伟达董事会已单独对黄仁勋是否成为外国情报机构的目标展开独立调查。该委员会表示，没有理由相信公司机密或国家安全已受到损害。

WASHINGTON, Nov. 9 (Yonhap) -- U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday that Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Jensen Huang told him he had no knowledge of alleged Chinese spy activities involving a businesswoman at the center of a suspected spying controversy.
In a briefing held at the White House, Trump said he directly asked Huang whether he knew the woman was a spy.
"He said, 'I had no idea that she was a spy,' and I really believe him," Trump said.
Huang was embroiled in a controversy over allegations involving a Chinese businesswoman suspected of working as an intelligence agent for Beijing. China has denied the espionage allegations.
"I asked (Huang) today because I did speak to him today just to see if he is feeling all right," Trump told reporters at the White House.
Trump said he has followed the allegations and that the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) was looking into the matter.
"We will look into it. I know the FBI is looking into it in terms of something else, and I think that he will be in good shape," Trump said.
The president also defended Huang's character, describing him as an honorable businessman. "I just know Jensen very well. I just think he is a very honorable man."
Nvidia's board has separately launched an independent investigation into whether Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. The board said it had no reason to believe company secrets or national security had been compromised.

Fundraiser by Nurnisa Kurban : Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education

Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Nurnisa Kurban is organizing this fundraiser to benefit Uyghur Academic Foundation.
Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education
The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years. It is estimated that up to three million Uyghurs have been interned, imprisoned, and enslaved in detention centers, prisons, and forced labor facilities throughout China since 2017.
In 2021, the Uyghur Tribunal found that China was committing genocide and other crimes against humanity against Uyghurs. In 2022, the United Nations also concluded that China was committing human rights violations against Uyghurs amounting to crimes against humanity. Countries including the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Lithuania, Belgium, and France have all declared a genocide in East Turkestan. Despite these declarations of genocide and related reports by various human rights organizations, atrocities against Uyghurs continue today with very limited international recognition and accountability.
During this time of ongoing genocide and cultural erasure in their Indigenous homeland, Uyghurs of the diaspora are working to preserve their culture and identity as a matter of survival. Uyghur education has been eradicated by the Chinese State, Uyghur texts are forbidden and in danger of being eliminated, and the Uyghur language itself is prohibited.
Uyghur scholars, linguists, and other specialists in the diaspora worldwide serve on the Uyghur Language and Education Committee of the Uyghur Academy to preserve the work of Uyghur intellectuals who have been persecuted and forcibly disappeared. This work has been ongoing since 2009 and is continuing to expand.
The Committee has created standards-aligned K-5 textbooks, which include classic and contemperory Uyghur literature, poetry, historical texts, and biographies for Uyghur children to learn about their own culture and identity in their native language. The Committee is seeking funding to expand and revise the existing K-5 textbooks, create teacher’s edition textbooks for educators, and design supplemental resources. They also hope to develop Middle and High School textbooks and related supplemental resources. To effectively implement these educational materials, they would also like to provide training for teachers.
Please consider supporting this urgent work of the Uyghur Academic Foundation as a matter of cultural survival for future generations of the Uyghur people.

zh_title: 东涌西站柱子未填满 港铁承诺与政府合作
summary: 在当地媒体报道新东涌西站多达 30 根混凝土柱被发现未填充后，香港铁路运营商港铁公司宣布将配合政府调查建筑故障。新东涌西站的建筑效果图。照片：港铁公司。港铁公司在周一发布的回应中表示，已注意到承包商在新东涌西站月台层建造的“某些支柱”存在问题。运输公司表示有问题
content:
在当地媒体报道新东涌西站多达 30 根混凝土柱被发现未填充后，香港铁路运营商港铁公司宣布将配合政府调查建筑故障。新东涌西站的建筑效果图。照片：港铁公司。港铁公司在周一发布的回应中表示，已注意到承包商在新东涌西站月台层建造的“某些支柱”存在问题。运输公司表示，已向主承包商发出违规通知，并正在追究有关操作错误、处理程序和责任的问题。东涌西站于2023年动工，预计2029年启用。港铁公司以中文回应称，“目前正等待承建商提交综合报告及拟定整改计划”，并表示将全力配合政府部门调查，及时提交报告，详细说明问题根源、补救计划和后续行动。屋宇署回应《香港新闻报》表示，10月27日在定期检查和质量审核时首次发现问题，发现两根有缺陷的柱子，并责令注册结构工程师和承包商进行全面检查。
该署表示，截至上周五，注册结构工程师已在建筑工地发现约30根有缺陷的混凝土柱。该署还命令注册结构工程师在11月中旬之前提交事故报告。 HK01周六独家报道称，东涌西站大堂内约30根混凝土柱涉嫌浇筑不当，导致混凝土与天花板之间留下约20至30厘米的间隙。报告称：“据了解，整个大厅层有 60 根柱子，其中大约一半存在类似缺陷，影响了一半的大厅建筑面积。”港铁于 2026 年 6 月庆祝东涌西站隧道贯通工程竣工。图片：港铁。港铁公司周六回应当地媒体时首次证实，在定期检查时发现东涌西站月台层有问题的立柱。该公司表示正在检查站台和大厅层的所有混凝土柱，但没有确认大厅层是否存在任何缺陷。屋宇署表示，目前正在兴建的东涌西站为三层车站，包括地面层、大堂层及月台层。
该部门表示，它是采用自上而下的方法建造的，这意味着楼板是在结构柱和结构墙之前浇筑的。目前，大厅和站台层的楼板已经完成，而站台层的垂直结构元件，包括柱和结构墙，正在建造中。该部门表示：“由于支撑楼板的临时脚手架尚未拆除，有缺陷的柱子不会对车站的结构完整性构成威胁。”

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s railway operator, the MTR Corporation, has announced that it will cooperate with a government probe into a construction fault, after local media reported that up to 30 concrete pillars at the new Tung Chung West Station were found to be underfilled. An architectural rendering of the new Tung Chung West Station. Photo: MTR Corporation. The MTR Corporation said in a response issued on Monday that it had noticed issues with “certain pillars,” which were being constructed by contractors on the platform level of the new Tung Chung West Station. The transport corporation said it had issued a non-compliance notice to the main contractor, and was pursuing the matter regarding operational errors, handling procedures, and liabilities. Construction on Tung Chung West Station began in 2023, with the station scheduled to open in 2029. “At present, the corporation is awaiting the contractor’s submission of a comprehensive report along with a proposed rectification plan,” the MTR Corporation said in a Chinese-language response, adding that it would fully cooperate with government departments in their investigation and submit timely reports detailing root causes, remedial plans, and follow-up actions. In response to HKFP, the Buildings Department said it first noticed the issue on October 27 during a regular inspection and quality audit, finding two defective columns and ordering the registered structural engineer and contractor to conduct a comprehensive check. As of last Friday, the registered structural engineer had found around 30 defective concrete pillars at the construction site, the department said. The department also ordered the registered structural engineer to submit an incident report by mid-November. The responses came after HK01 reported in an exclusive on Saturday that around 30 concrete pillars in the concourse of Tung Chung West Station were suspected of being improperly poured, leaving a gap of roughly 20 to 30 centimetres between the concrete and the ceiling. “It is understood that there are 60 pillars across the entire concourse level, and about half of them show similar defects, affecting half of the concourse floor area,” the report reads. MTR celebrated the completion of tunnel breakthrough works for Tung Chung West Station in June 2026. Photo: MTR. In response to local media, the MTR Corporation confirmed on Saturday for the first time that it had found problematic columns on the platform level of Tung Chung West Station during a regular inspection. It said it was checking all concrete pillars on the platform and concourse levels, but did not confirm whether there were any defects on the concourse level. ‘No danger to the station’s structural integrity’ The Buildings Department said that Tung Chung West Station, which is now under construction, is a three-storey station comprising the ground level, the concourse level, and the platform level. It is being constructed using the top-down method—meaning the floor slabs are cast prior to the structural columns and structural walls, the department said. Currently, the floor slabs for both the concourse and platform levels have been completed, while vertical structural elements on the platform level, including columns and structural walls, are under construction. “As the temporary falsework supporting the floor slab has not yet been removed, the defective columns pose no danger to the station’s structural integrity,” the department said.

summary: 比尔队的防守扭转了维京人队的胜利 - 日本时报 比尔队的防守扭转了维京人队的胜利 比尔四分卫乔什·艾伦周一在明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯的美国银行体育场对阵维京人队的第二节中传球。 |图片/来自路透社 X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接 布法罗比尔队周一扭转了明尼苏达维京人队的局面，在明尼阿波利斯客场以 23-6 的比分战胜了明尼苏达维京人队。比尔队强大的进攻和球队的低分对决
content:
比尔的防守扭转了维京人队的胜利 - 日本时报
比尔的防守扭转了维京人队的胜利
周一，比尔队四分卫乔什·艾伦在明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯的美国银行体育场对阵维京人队的第二节中传球。 |图片来源：路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
布法罗比尔队周一逆转明尼苏达维京人队，在客场凭借顽强的防守表现以 23-6 战胜明尼阿波利斯队。
比尔队强大的进攻和NFL中最吝啬的防守之间的低分对决最终以布法罗队在美国银行体育场的一场艰苦的胜利而告终。
布法罗的防守在这场胜利中起到了决定性作用，在明尼苏达四分卫卡森·温茨的悲惨夜晚，维京人队仅投进了两个进球。
替补受伤的凯勒·穆雷首发的老将温茨自始至终都表现得很挣扎，两次被拦截，一次掉球，只完成了八次。
比尔队进攻深入，跑卫詹姆斯·库克 (James Cook) 31 次冲球推进 107 码，最终取得胜利。
比尔队四分卫乔什·艾伦 (Josh Allen) 21 次传球达阵，推进 234 码，取得 1 次达阵。
艾伦对 ESPN 表示：“这就是一场精彩的表演。” “我们知道这需要四个季度的时间。
“我们刚刚对阵的是一支很棒的球队。他们是非常出色的教练，并且防守是联盟中最好的，这是有原因的。
“我们一直在苦苦挣扎，第四节有点让他们疲惫不堪。我们的防守表现得非常出色。”
布法罗队凭借这场胜利将战绩提高到 7 胜 1 负，巩固了对亚冠东区的控制力，领先于排名第二的新英格兰爱国者队 (5 胜 4 负)。维京人队在国联北区以 6-2 落败。
在上半场的消耗战中，布法罗踢球手泰勒·巴斯在第一节以 39 码射门首开纪录，随后维京人队的对手威尔·雷查德在第二节以 43 码射门扳平比分。
布法罗队在第二节最后一分钟取得了本场比赛的第一个达阵，艾伦在八场比赛中领先80码，然后用25码达阵传球给凯莱基·拉图，将比分改写为10-3。
拉图用力扣球庆祝了他职业生涯的第一次达阵，当包括艾伦在内的众多队友过来祝贺他时，他咧嘴笑了。这位 24 岁的球员是印第安纳波利斯小马队冲传手莱亚图·拉图 (Laiatu Latu) 的弟弟。
雷查德在上半场最后几秒的投篮将差距缩小到四分，但明尼苏达队此后未能将比分扩大。
相反，比尔队稳步扩大领先优势，巴斯在第三节中段投进一记 25 码射门，将比分改写为 13-6。
库克随后在第四节打出了决定性的一击，他从 5 码处冲出，完成了 15 场比赛、84 码的冲球，比赛还剩 8 分 32 秒。
随后巴斯打出一记 52 码射门，布法罗队以 23-6 领先，维京人队的命运在最后一攻以失误而告终。
马克斯·布罗斯默在第四节末取代温茨担任四分卫，7投6中推进58码。

Bills defense turns tables on Vikings in victory - The Japan Times
Bills defense turns tables on Vikings in victory
Bills quarterback Josh Allen throws a pass during the second quarter against the Vikings at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota, on Monday. | Imagn Images / via Reuters
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
The Buffalo Bills turned the tables on the Minnesota Vikings on Monday, producing a steely defensive performance on the road to grab a 23-6 victory in Minneapolis.
A low-scoring showdown between the Bills’ potent offense and the stingiest defense in the NFL ended with a hard-fought Buffalo victory at the U.S. Bank Stadium.
Buffalo’s defense proved decisive in the win, restricting the Vikings to just two field goals on a miserable night for Minnesota quarterback Carson Wentz.
Veteran back-up Wentz, starting in place of the injured Kyler Murray, struggled throughout, tossing two interceptions, coughing up a fumble and recording just eight completions.
The Bills offense dug deep to grind out victory, with running back James Cook rushing for 107 yards from 31 carries.
Bills quarterback Josh Allen threw 234 yards with one touchdown from 21 completions.
“It’s exactly what it was — a great performance,” Allen told ESPN. “We knew that it was going to take all four quarters.
“That’s a great team that we just played. They’re extremely well coach and that defense is the best in the league for a reason.
“We kept grinding, kind of wore them down in the fourth quarter. Our defense played fantastic.”
Buffalo improved to 7-1 with the win to tighten its grip on the AFC East, ahead of the second-placed New England Patriots (5-4). The Vikings fell to 6-2 in the NFC North.
An attritional first half saw Buffalo kicker Tyler Bass open the scoring with a 39-yard field goal in the first quarter before Vikings counterpart Will Reichard level with a 43-yard effort in the second quarter.
Buffalo grabbed the first touchdown of the game in the final minute of the second quarter, with Allen leading an eight-play 80-yard drive before finding Keleki Latu with a 25-yard touchdown pass to make it 10-3.
Latu celebrated his first career touchdown by forcefully spiking the ball, and he grinned as a slew of teammates including Allen came over to congratulate him. The 24-year-old is the younger ​brother ​of Indianapolis Colts pass rusher Laiatu Latu.
Reichard narrowed the deficit to four points with a field goal in the final seconds of the first half, but Minnesota failed to add to its tally thereafter.
Instead the Bills steadily built on their lead, with Bass scoring a 25-yard field goal to make it 13-6 midway through the third quarter.
Cook then struck the decisive blow in the fourth quarter, barreling over from five yards to cap a 15-play, 84-yard drive that took 8 minutes and 32 seconds off the clock.
Bass followed that with a 52-yard field goal to put Buffalo 23-6 up and the Vikings’ fate was sealed after a final drive ended with a turnover on downs.
Max Brosmer replaced Wentz at quarterback late in the fourth quarter ⁠and finished 6 of 7 for 58 yards.

content:
宝可梦、稀有邮票吸引游客参观台北世界集邮展 - 焦点台湾
宝可梦珍稀邮票吸引游客参观台北世界邮票展
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
周二，中华邮政董事长王国材（左四）和其他官员在台北举行的新闻发布会上合影留念。中央通讯社照片2026年11月9日
中新社台北11月10日电 组织者周一表示，即将在台北举行的2026年菲律宾世界邮票锦标赛展览中，一张被称为“倒置珍妮”的罕见印刷错误美国邮票将成为亮点之一，而神奇宝贝主题邮票和商品在网上预售中大部分已售罄。
“倒置的珍妮”是 1918 年发行的著名的 24 美分美国邮票。它的图案是一架绰号“珍妮”的柯蒂斯 JN-4 双翼飞机，由于印刷错误，它被倒置在红框内。
据台湾国营邮政机构中华邮政股份有限公司称，全世界仅存约 100 枚印刷错误的邮票。
根据拍卖记录，其中一枚在 2023 年 11 月的罗伯特·A·西格尔 (Robert A. Siegel) 拍卖会上以 200 万美元的价格售出，创下了单张美国邮票的拍卖纪录。
PHILATAIPEI 2026展览将于11月20日至25日在台北世贸中心举行，免费入场。
中华邮政在周一的新闻发布会上表示，此次展览以“创新无穷永续”为主题，将设有多个展区，包括珍稀邮票和故宫博物院专区、台湾与全球专题专区、邮票艺术DIY专区以及中华邮政130周年纪念专区。
中华邮政表示，此次活动将汇集来自69个国家和地区的邮政服务、邮票经销商和集邮爱好者，2,054个框架展示来自台湾和海外的稀有邮票收藏。
中华邮政董事长王国材表示，台湾上次举办世界集邮展览是在2016年，并补充说，他希望今年的活动有助于提升台湾的国际形象。
据中华邮政介绍，此次展出的其他历史邮票还包括1949年上海印制的《雁行基本邮票》、1911年的《阿根廷农民和旭日邮票》以及1888年的《龙马邮票》。
该公司表示，为期六天的展览还将举办日常活动，包括表演、签名会、讲座和神奇宝贝见面会活动。
周一，台北会场的货架上陈列着邮票和与神奇宝贝的联名商品。中央通讯社照片2026年11月9日
为了这次展览，中华邮政与神奇宝贝系列合作发行邮票和联名商品。
该公司周一表示，分配给在线预售的神奇宝贝主题邮票和商品占总数的60%，包括18万张邮票，大部分在两个小时内售罄。
王表示，由于合同限制，神奇宝贝商品不会补货。
据中华邮报报道，另有20%的神奇宝贝主题邮票和商品将于展览开幕当天上午1​​1点在台北世贸中心8号入口发售。另外20%的主题邮票将在中华邮政指定分店发售。
该公司表示，每位游客只会收到一张排队票，且购买数量受每人限制。

Pokémon, rare stamps to draw visitors to Taipei world stamp exhibit
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Chunghwa Post Chairman Wang Kwo-tsai (fourth left) and other officials pose for a photo at a press event in Taipei on Tuesday. CNA photo Nov. 9, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 10 (CNA) A rare misprinted U.S. postage stamp known as the "Inverted Jenny" will be among the highlights of the upcoming PHILATAIPEI 2026 World Stamp Championship Exhibition in Taipei, while Pokémon-themed stamps and merchandise have mostly sold out in online presales, organizers said Monday.
The "Inverted Jenny" is a famous 24-cent U.S. postage stamp issued in 1918. It features a Curtiss JN-4 biplane, nicknamed the "Jenny," printed upside down within a red frame because of a printing error.
Only about 100 examples of the misprinted stamp were reportedly still in existence worldwide, according to Chunghwa Post Co., Ltd., Taiwan's state-run postal service.
One example sold for US$2 million at a Robert A. Siegel auction in November 2023, setting a record for a single U.S. stamp sold at auction, according to auction records.
The PHILATAIPEI 2026 exhibition will run from Nov. 20 to 25 at the Taipei World Trade Center, with free admission.
At a press conference on Monday, Chunghwa Post said the exhibition, themed "Innovation ∞ Sustainability," will feature several sections, including one dedicated to rare stamps and the National Palace Museum, a Taiwan and global thematic section, a stamp art DIY section, and a section marking Chunghwa Post's 130th anniversary.
The event will bring together postal services, stamp dealers and philatelists from 69 countries and territories, with 2,054 frames displaying rare stamp collections from Taiwan and abroad, Chunghwa Post said.
Chunghwa Post Chairman Wang Kwo-tsai (王國材) said Taiwan last hosted a world stamp exhibition in 2016, adding that he hoped this year's event would help raise Taiwan's international profile.
Other historical stamps on display will include the Shanghai-printed Flying Geese Basic Stamps from 1949, Argentina's Farmer and Rising Sun Stamp from 1911 and the Dragon-Horse Postage Stamps from 1888, according to Chunghwa Post.
The six-day exhibition will also feature daily activities, including performances, autograph sessions, lectures and Pokémon meet-and-greet events, the company said.
Stamps and co-branded merchandise with Pokémon are displayed on the shelves at the venue in Taipei on Monday. CNA photo Nov. 9, 2026
For the exhibition, Chunghwa Post has teamed up with the Pokémon franchise to release stamps and co-branded merchandise.
The company said Monday that the Pokémon-themed stamps and merchandise allocated to online presales, accounting for 60 percent of the total and including 180,000 stamps, sold out mostly within two hours.
Wang said the Pokémon merchandise would not be restocked because of contractual restrictions.
Another 20 percent of the Pokémon-themed stamps and merchandise will go on sale at 11 a.m. on the exhibition's opening day at Entrance 8 of the Taipei World Trade Center, according to Chunghwa Post. A further 20 percent of the themed stamps will be sold at designated Chunghwa Post branches.
Each visitor will receive only one queue ticket, and purchases will be subject to per-person limits, the company said.

男子因走私132,400支未税香烟进入香港而被判入狱中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
男子走私132,400支未税香烟进入香港被判入狱
一名52岁的中国大陆男子在香港国际机场被海关人员从他的行李中查获约132,400支未税香烟后被判入狱。该批香烟价值约595,000港元，未完税约437,000港元。
2026 年 11 月 10 日 18:02 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 10 日 18:19 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港海关称，一名 52 岁的中国内地男子因进口免税香烟进入香港而于 11 月 10 日被判入狱。
11月9日，该男子从曼谷经台湾抵港，海关人员在香港国际机场截获。搜查其私人行李后，发现约132,400支未缴税香烟，市值约595,000港元。未缴税款的香烟总计约港币437,000元。该男子当场被捕。
香港海关对判决表示欢迎，称刑期具有强大的威慑作用，反映了罪行的严重性。
根据《应课税品条例》，香烟被列为应课税品。任何进口、处理、拥有、出售或购买免税香烟的人均属犯罪。一经定罪，违法者最高可面临罚款 200 万港元及最高 7 年监禁。

Man jailed for smuggling 132,400 untaxed cigarettes into Hong Kong | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Man jailed for smuggling 132,400 untaxed cigarettes into Hong Kong
A 52-year-old mainland Chinese man was jailed after customs officers seized about 132,400 untaxed cigarettes from his luggage at Hong Kong International Airport. The cigarettes were worth about HK$595,000 with unpaid duty of about HK$437,000.
10 Nov 2026 at 18:02 HKT · updated 10 Nov, 18:19 · 1 min read
A 52-year-old mainland Chinese man was sentenced to prison on 10 November after being convicted of importing untaxed cigarettes into Hong Kong, the city's Customs and Excise Department said.
Customs officers intercepted the man on 9 November at Hong Kong International Airport after he arrived from Bangkok via Taiwan. A search of his personal luggage uncovered about 132,400 untaxed cigarettes, with a market value of about HK$595,000. The unpaid duty on the cigarettes totalled about HK$437,000. The man was arrested at the scene.
The Customs and Excise Department welcomed the sentence, saying the jail term served as a strong deterrent and reflected the seriousness of the offence.
Under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, cigarettes are classified as dutiable goods. Anyone who imports, handles, possesses, sells or purchases untaxed cigarettes commits an offence. Upon conviction, offenders face a maximum fine of HK$2 million and up to seven years in prison.
Customs urged the public to report suspected cigarette smuggling activities via its 24-hour hotline at 182 8080, by email at [email protected], or through an online form at eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002.

content:
这张由Planet Labs PBC于2026年10月4日提供的卫星图像显示，在沙特阿拉伯利雅得东部，“东西输油管道”(East-West Pipeline)的胡赖斯(Khurais)泵站附近出现了一股黑烟。
沙特阿拉伯说，沙特一条关键输油管道，即东西输油管道，星期一(11月9日)遭到袭击；两个月前，这条管道因无人机袭击被迫关闭。能源部一名官员说，此次袭击引发火灾，但很快被扑灭；事件未造成人员伤亡，也未对运营造成干扰。
也门受伊朗支持的胡塞武装近几个星期升级了对沙特石油设施及与沙特相关船只的袭击；这个组织声称，这些袭击是报复沙特实施的封锁以及8月份对萨那机场的攻击。
胡塞恐怖组织军事发言人叶海亚·萨里(Yahya Saree)星期一指责沙特阿拉伯在“过去24小时内”对也门发动了103次空袭，目标包括马里布(Marib)省、萨达(Saada)省、荷台达(Al-Hudaydah)省、塔伊兹(Taiz)省、拉赫杰(Lahj)省和焦夫(Al-Jawf)省内的平民设施。
他声称这些袭击造成了平民伤亡，但他并未报告星期一对沙特阿拉伯有任何新的袭击。
“东西输油管道”将石油从其位于海湾地区的东部油田输送至红海港口延布(Yanbu)。沙特阿拉伯一直依赖这条管道，以避开霍尔木兹海峡可能出现的干扰及针对航运的袭击，将石油出口至全球市场。
9月10日发生的一次攻击导致这条管道受损。虽然没有组织宣称对此负责，但外界将矛头指向了也门胡塞武装和伊拉克民兵组织，他们都得到伊朗的支持。
运营于9月22日恢复；到10月6日，沙特阿拉伯能源大臣阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·萨勒曼(Abdulaziz bin Salman)亲王报告，经由东西输油管道输送的石油量已达到每日580万桶。
与此同时，七国集团部长们正就如何缓解中东冲突、保障关键贸易路线展开讨论。
在巴黎星期一举行的七国集团外长会议上，确保国际航线畅通及海上航运安全成为会议的中心议题。
美国国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)说，确保航行自由是他与德国外交部长约翰·瓦德普尔(Johann Wadephul)讨论的议题之一。
德国外交部星期一在一份声明中说，“此处的中心问题是霍尔木兹海峡，这是全球能源贸易最重要的航运路线之一。”
“在此背景下，红海的安全局势以及这个地区武装团体的活动同样发挥着核心作用。”
德国外交部还警告，冲突升级可能会对全球能源供应造成严重后果。

title: Launch Preview: Starship, Vulcan, and Electron launches scheduled for busy week

summary: 来自四个国家的七枚火箭将于本周发射。星际飞船将尝试其迄今为止最重要的任务，而猎鹰 9 号将为美国太空军发射一对机密有效载荷。联合发射联盟计划让 Vulcan 执行其返回飞行任务，而 Electron 则将完成具有里程碑意义的第 100 次任务。在国际上，中国和韩国将分别发射未知的有效载荷和演示任务。猎鹰 9 号 | USSF-627（“R-5”）本周首次发射将由猎鹰 9 号火箭提供机密有效载荷
content:
来自四个国家的七枚火箭将于本周发射。星际飞船将尝试其迄今为止最重要的任务，而猎鹰 9 号将为美国太空军发射一对机密有效载荷。联合发射联盟计划让 Vulcan 执行其返回飞行任务，而 Electron 则将完成具有里程碑意义的第 100 次任务。在国际上，中国和韩国将分别发射未知的有效载荷和演示任务。猎鹰 9 号 | USSF-627（“R-5”）本周首次发射将由猎鹰 9 号火箭为美国太空军 (USSF) 提供机密有效载荷。该任务被指定为 USSF-627，最初计划于 11 月 8 日星期日发射。猎鹰 9 号现定于太平洋标准时间 11 月 9 日星期一晚上 7:07（世界标准时间 10 月 10 日 03:07）从范登堡太空部队基地 (VSFB) 的 4 号东部太空发射综合体 (SLC-4E) 起飞，距太平洋标准时间晚上 11:03 (07:03) 的窗口期已过去四分钟。 UTC 时间 11 月 10 日）。由于有效载荷的机密性质，卫星的确切数量尚不清楚。一些迹象表明，基于猎鹰 9 号第二级的降落区，星盾将进行发射。 Starshield是为美国政府打造的Starlink版本，其主要客户是USSF、国家侦察办公室和太空发展局。范登堡太空部队基地 4E 号航天发射场发射台上的猎鹰 9 号火箭。
（图片来源：SpaceX） Falcon 9 是一款两级、70 m 高、部分可重复使用的火箭，第一级使用九个 Merlin 1D 海平面发动机，第二级使用单个真空优化的 Merlin 1D。Falcon 9 的第一级着陆在自主无人机船上或着陆点，其整流罩在飞行后回收并重复使用。两个阶段都使用液体煤油和液氧作为推进剂。助推器 B1103 将在其第七次飞行中支持这项任务。此前，该助推器已支持 NROL-179、第一批传输层 A 和 E 以及三个星链任务的发射。猎鹰 9 号将搭乘 SpaceX 的无人机“当然我仍然爱你”着陆。米尔 |演示飞行 11 月 10 日星期二，韩国计划发射韩国军方小型卫星运载火箭和平号的第二次飞行。继 2023 年 12 月进行了不包括第二级的试飞之后，此次发射将是全尺寸火箭的首次轨道飞行。启动窗口于 05:00 UTC 开始，并延长至 09:00 UTC。和平号是一款四级固体燃料运载火箭，第四级采用液体燃料，可实现精确入轨。 2023 年 12 月飞行的版本能够运载 700 公斤至近地轨道，该版本疑似能够运载 1,000 公斤左右。长征2D |有效载荷未知 11 月 11 日星期三，长征 2D (CZ-2D) 火箭计划从酒泉卫星发射中心发射升空。
目前，发射计划于 11:40 UTC 进行，距离 11:32 UTC 开启并持续到 12:05 UTC 的窗口还有 8 分钟的时间。CZ-2D 将向轨道发射未知有效载荷。 CZ-2D 是一款两级、41 米高的运载火箭，能够向近地轨道 (LEO) 发射 3,500 公斤的重量。 CZ-2D的第一级和第二级均由四氧化二氮和不对称二甲肼提供动力，这两种推进剂都是自燃推进剂。周三的发射将是长征二号丁的第 107 次发射，也是 2026 年的第六次发射。快舟 11 |有效载荷未知本周第二个也是最后一个预定的中国任务

【原文 English Original】
Seven rockets from four countries are set to launch this week. Starship is set to attempt its most consequential mission yet, while Falcon 9 is set to launch a pair of classified payloads for the United States Space Force. The United Launch Alliance is scheduled to fly Vulcan on its return-to-flight mission, and Electron is set to reach a milestone 100th mission. Internationally, China and South Korea are set to launch an unknown payload and a demonstration mission, respectively. Falcon 9 | USSF-627 (“R-5”) The first launch of the week will feature Falcon 9 delivering a classified payload for the United States Space Force (USSF). The mission, designated USSF-627, was initially scheduled to launch on Sunday, Nov. 8. Falcon 9 is now set to take off from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) on Monday, Nov. 9, at 7:07 PM PST (03:07 UTC on Nov. 10), four minutes into a window that extends until 11:03 PM PST (07:03 UTC on Nov. 10). Due to the classified nature of the payload, the exact quantity of satellites is unknown. Some indicators suggest a Starshield launch, based on drop zones for Falcon 9’s second stage. Starshield is a version of Starlink built for the United States government, with its primary customers being the USSF, National Reconnaissance Office, and the Space Development Agency. A Falcon 9 on the launch pad at Space Launch Complex-4E on Vandenberg Space Force Base. (Credit: SpaceX) Falcon 9 is a two-stage, 70 m-tall, partially reusable rocket that uses nine Merlin 1D sea-level engines on its first stage and a single vacuum-optimized Merlin 1D on its second stage. Falcon 9’s first stage lands either aboard an autonomous droneship or at a landing site, with its fairings being recovered and reused after flight. Both stages utilize liquid kerosene and liquid oxygen as propellants. Booster B1103 will be supporting this mission on its seventh flight. Previously, this booster has supported the launches of NROL-179, Tranche 1 Transport Layers A and E, and three Starlink missions. Falcon 9 will land downrange aboard SpaceX’s droneship Of Course I Still Love You . Mir | Demo Flight On Tuesday, Nov. 10, South Korea is set to launch the second flight of Mir, the South Korean military’s small satellite launch vehicle. This launch is set to be the first orbital flight of the full-scale rocket, following a test flight in December 2023 that did not include the second stage. The launch window opens at 05:00 UTC and extends until 09:00 UTC. Mir is a four-stage, solid-fuel launch vehicle with a liquid-fueled fourth stage for precise orbital insertion. The version that flew in December 2023 was capable of 700 kg to LEO, with this version suspected to be capable of around 1,000 kg. Chang Zheng 2D | Unknown Payload On Wednesday, Nov. 11, a Chang Zheng 2D (CZ-2D) rocket is scheduled to launch out of the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The launch is currently scheduled for 11:40 UTC, eight minutes into a window that opens at 11:32 UTC and extends until 12:05 UTC. CZ-2D will deliver an unknown payload into orbit. CZ-2D is a two-stage, 41 m-tall launch vehicle capable of delivering 3,500 kg to low-Earth orbit (LEO). CZ-2D’s first and second stages are both powered by dinitrogen tetroxide and unsymmetrical dimethyl hydrazine, both hypergolic propellants. Wednesday’s launch will be the 107th overall for CZ-2D, and sixth in 2026. Kuaizhou 11 | Unknown Payload The second and final scheduled Chinese mission of the week will see a Kuaizhou 11 rocket launch on Thursday, Nov. 12. Liftoff is set for 19:50 UTC from Site 95A at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, during a 45-minute launch window. Kuaizhou 11 is a four-stage Chinese rocket manufactured by the China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation. Standing 25.3 m tall, the rocket can loft 1,500 kg to LEO with a liftoff thrust of 1,250 kN. This mission will be the eighth overall Kuaizhou 11 mission and the fourth of 2026. Vulcan VC6L | Amazon Leo (LV-01) United Launch Alliance’s (ULA) Vulcan rocket is set to launch on Friday, Nov. 13, from Space Launch Complex 41 (SLC-41) at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. The 30-minute launch window opens at 12:54 PM EST (17:54 UTC). This will be the first flight of Vulcan in over nine months, following the ejection of one of Vulcan’s GEM-63XL solid rocket boosters at T+69 seconds on the USSF-87 mission. Flying aboard Vulcan will be a stack of 40 Amazon Leo satellites for Amazon’s Leo satellite internet constellation, a rival to SpaceX’s Starlink. A ULA Vulcan (USSF-87) sits next to a SpaceX Crew Dragon (Crew-12). (Credit: Tyler Gray for NSF) Vulcan is a two-stage launch vehicle with a range of launch configurations. Vulcan’s first stage is powered by two BE-4 engines built by Blue Origin, running on liquid methane and liquid oxygen propellants. Its second stage, Centaur V, is powered by twin RL10C engines running on liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen. Centaur V can be configured as Centaur LEO, High Energy, or Endurance. Vulcan can also be configured with solid rocket boosters to augment liftoff thrust, with options ranging from zero to two, four, or six boosters. The payload is encapsulated by either a short (15.5 m) or a long (21.3 m) fairing. Vulcan will debut the Vulcan VC6L variant, designated by six solid boosters and the long fairing option. Vulcan will debut the LEO-optimized Centaur V, which is 1.94 m smaller than the existing Centaur V High Energy, which has flown on all previous Vulcan launches. Additionally, this flight is a certification flight of this Vulcan configuration for the United States Space Force. Amazon Leo (LV-01) will be the first of 38 scheduled for Vulcan and the fifth overall mission for Vulcan. Starship | Flight 15 / Starlink Group 31-2 Pending regulatory approval, Starship is set to fly its next, and most significant, mission no earlier than Friday, Nov. 13, at 4:45 PM CST (22:45 UTC). The launch window extends until 6:00 PM CST (00:00 UTC on Nov. 14). Flight 15 will feature two notable events: the first booster-catch attempt since Flight 8, following stage separation, and the first attempt to catch the ship, roughly 22 hours after liftoff. Starship is a two-stage, super-heavy-lift launch vehicle capable of lofting an estimated 100 tonnes. The first stage, named Super Heavy, features 33 Raptor 3 engines, running off of liquid methane and liquid oxygen propellants. The second stage, named Starship, features six Raptor 3 engines, three sea-level and three vacuum-optimized, also running off of liquid methane and liquid oxygen. Flying on Flight 15 will be Ship 42 and Booster 22, both on their first flights. Flight 15 is expected to deliver 26 Starlink v3 satellites to LEO. Like Flight 14, three of these satellites will feature imaging capabilities for imaging the heat shield of Starship in orbit. Flight 15 will be the 15th full-stack launch of Starship and the fourth for the system’s V3 configuration. Falcon 9 | USSF-317 (“R-6”) Falcon 9 is set to fly again on Friday, Nov. 13, from VSFB with another USSF mission. The designation for this flight is USSF-317. The launch window opens at 8:09 PM PST (04:09 UTC on Nov. 14), and lasts for four hours. This mission will fly another unknown quantity of presumed Starshield satellites to LEO. Booster B1100 will support this mission, marking its 11th flight. This booster has previously supported NROL-105, USSF-385, and eight Starlink missions. B1100 will land downrange aboard SpaceX’s droneship Of Course I Still Love You . Electron during its 95th launch “Happily Ever Faster.” Credit: Rocket Lab) Electron | The Mountain God Rises The last scheduled launch of the week will see Rocket Lab’s Electron launch from the Mahia Peninsula in New Zealand on Saturday, Nov. 14, at 05:30 UTC. This flight of Electron, named “The Mountain God Rises,” will deliver another iQPS satellite into LEO for iQPS’s synthetic aperture radar constellation (SAR). SAR is used to image the surface of the Earth and can penetrate through cloud layers. Electron is a two-stage small-lift vehicle capable of delivering up to 300 kg to LEO and 200 kg to Sun-synchronous orbit. The vehicle is fueled by liquid kerosene and liquid oxygen, which powers nine Rutherford engines on the first stage and a single vacuum-optimized Rutherford on the second stage. This mission will serve as Electron’s 100th overall mission — a notable milestone for the small rocket that first flew in 2017. In addition, this mission will serve as the 269th orbital launch attempt worldwide in 2026. ( Lead Image: Falcon 9 launches from Florida. Credit: Julia Bergeron for NSF) The post Launch Preview: Starship, Vulcan, and Electron launches scheduled for busy week appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com .

title: Who is Alice Huang, the Chinese tech executive accused of spying on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang?
zh_title: 被指控监视英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的中国科技高管 Alice Huang 是谁？
summary: 据媒体报道，科技高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 被指控在与美国人工智能芯片巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 负责人黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的恋情中为中国从事间谍活动。 2025 年 5 月 22 日，数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的中国高管 Alice Huang（右）出席 Nvidia 首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋（左）在台北一家餐厅举办的晚宴。照片：法新社。关于这名女子的公开信息很少，她也被称为黄乐，据报道她曾是新加坡一家名为 Mega 的数据中心公司的高层人物。
content:
据媒体报道，科技高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 被指控在与美国人工智能芯片巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 负责人黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的恋情中为中国从事间谍活动。 2025 年 5 月 22 日，数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的中国高管 Alice Huang（右）出席 Nvidia 首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋（左）在台北一家餐厅举办的晚宴。照片：法新社。关于这名女子的公开信息很少，她也被称为黄乐，据报道她曾是新加坡一家名为 Megaspeed International 的数据中心公司的高层人物。以下是我们对她和公司的了解：Alice Huang 是谁？据《纽约时报》报道，爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）是一名中国公民，被北京招募来收集有关英伟达老板的情报，该报最先报道了黄仁勋是间谍阴谋的目标。尽管姓氏相同，爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 与这位 63 岁的台湾出生的世界上最有价值公司的负责人没有任何关系。 《泰晤士报》援引知情人士的话称，Alice Huang 英语说得很好，并且在全球人工智能芯片行业的最高层拥有良好的人脉。随着美国和中国竞相开发具有潜在军事应用的先进人工智能系统，该行业高度敏感。在线搜索在中国基金数据库中显示了黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 的简短简介以及她的照片。
它列出了以前的工作经历，包括在汇丰银行、以及中国媒体中央电视台和湖南卫视的记者。法新社无法核实该简介的内容或撰写者，但已试图联系所引用的公司。这对是如何连接的？上周媒体报道称，他们关系密切，黄仁勋周日对英伟达员工表示，他对“对我妻子的不忠”感到“深感抱歉”。 LinkedIn 上发布的一张 2024 年行业聚会的照片似乎显示，身穿皮夹克的 Nvidia 老板坐在一位戴着闪亮珠宝的长发女士旁边，据信是 Alice Huang。 Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 5 月 19 日在台湾台北举行的 Computex 2025 上发表主题演讲。照片：Nvidia。第二年，他们俩在台湾顶级科技博览会台北国际电脑展期间，出席了黄仁勋在台北一家中餐厅举办的晚宴。记者站在餐厅外，透过玻璃门窗拍摄黄仁勋和一名身穿粉色连衣裙、名叫爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的女子与其他与会者混在一起的情况。媒体直播显示，有一次，黄仁勋用手臂搂住黄爱丽，而她亲吻了他的右脸颊。人们还看到爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）跟随这位英伟达首席执行官在外面与记者交谈后重新进入餐厅，用手指抚摸他的后背。随后，他们乘坐同一辆车离开餐厅。什么是兆速？
据《纽约时报》和《华尔街日报》报道，美国官员去年得出结论，爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）将黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）作为间谍。 据称，当时爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）是数据中心公司 Megaspeed International 的高管，该公司向其他公司出租计算能力来训练和运行人工智能。照片：Megaspeed 国际。 Megaspeed的网站称其是“英伟达算力云业务在亚太地区的核心业务合作伙伴”。该公司在 LinkedIn 上表示，其在新加坡、马来西亚和印度尼西亚设有办事处，每个办公室约有 2 至 10 名员工。

【原文 English Original】
Tech executive Alice Huang is the woman accused of spying for China during an affair with Jensen Huang, head of US artificial intelligence chip titan Nvidia, according to media reports. Alice Huang (R), a Chinese executive linked to the data centre company called Megaspeed, attending a dinner hosted by Nvidia’s chief executive and co-founder Jensen Huang (L in black back facing camera) at a restaurant in Taipei on May 22, 2025. Photo: AFP. Public details are sparse about the woman, also known as Huang Le, who had reportedly been a top figure at a Singapore-based data centre company called Megaspeed International. Here is what we know about her and the company: Who is Alice Huang? Alice Huang is a Chinese citizen recruited by Beijing to collect intelligence on the Nvidia boss, according to the New York Times, which first reported that Jensen Huang was the alleged target of a spy plot. Despite their shared surname, Alice Huang is no relation to the 63-year-old Taiwanese-born head of the world’s most valuable company. The Times, citing people briefed on the surveillance, said that Alice Huang speaks good English and is well connected at the highest level of the global AI chip industry. The sector is highly sensitive as the United States and China race to develop advanced AI systems with potential military applications. An online search brought up a short profile for Alice Huang, with her photo, on a Chinese fund database. It listed previous jobs including at HSBC bank, and as a reporter for Chinese media outlets CCTV and Hunan TV. AFP was unable to verify the contents of the profile, or who had written it, but has attempted to contact the companies cited. How are the pair connected? Media reports last week said they had a close relationship, and Jensen Huang told Nvidia employees on Sunday he was “deeply sorry” for being “unfaithful to my wife”. One photo from an industry party in 2024, posted on LinkedIn, appears to show the leather jacket-clad Nvidia boss sitting next to a long-haired woman in glitzy jewellery believed to be Alice Huang. Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang gives a keynote speech at Computex 2025 in Taipei, Taiwan, on May 19, 2025. Photo: Nvidia. The following year, they both attended a dinner hosted by Jensen Huang at a Chinese restaurant in Taipei during Computex, the island’s top tech expo. Journalists stood outside the restaurant filming through glass windows and doors as Jensen Huang and a woman identified as Alice Huang, who was wearing a pink dress, mingled with other attendees. At one point, Jensen Huang can be seen putting his arm around Alice Huang as she kisses him on the right cheek, press livestreams show. Alice Huang is also seen following the Nvidia chief as he re-enters the restaurant after talking to journalists outside, running her fingers down his lower back. They later leave the restaurant in the same car. What is Megaspeed? US officials concluded last year that Alice Huang was targeting Jensen Huang as a spy, according to the New York Times and the Wall Street Journal. At the time, Alice Huang was said to be a top executive at data centre firm Megaspeed International, which rents out computing power to other companies to train and run AI. Photo: Megaspeed International. Megaspeed’s website says it is “a core business partner of Nvidia’s computing power cloud business in the Asia-Pacific region”. On LinkedIn, it says it has offices in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia, with around two to 10 employees and 25 “associated members”. When AFP called the number listed on Megaspeed’s website, the person who answered said they were unfamiliar with the company and that the number was a residential line. The firm was previously called 7Road International, according to the Singapore government’s website, suggesting links to Chinese gaming company 7Road. Has Megaspeed helped China evade US restrictions on chips? Washington restricts the export to China of Nvidia’s most cutting-edge silicon chips, citing national security concerns but also seen as a measure to stay ahead in AI. The New York Times said the US government had been probing Megaspeed since 2024 over its potential steering of Nvidia chips to China. Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. Photo: Nvidia. The company has also reportedly been under investigation by Singapore authorities, who the Times says questioned Alice Huang in 2025. AFP has contacted Singapore’s police and the home affairs ministry for comment. Last year Bloomberg News also reported on the Singaporean probe into Megaspeed over the alleged smuggling of Nvidia chips to China. In December 2025, Megaspeed said Bloomberg’s reporting “contains misleading information and incorrect insinuations, including suggestions that we may have been involved in illegal chip transfers”.

title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
summary: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO's ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal | TechCrunch Image Credits:Costfoto/NurPhoto / Getty Images A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months bef
content:
A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO's ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal | TechCrunch
Image Credits:Costfoto/NurPhoto / Getty Images
A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
2:46 PM PST · November 9, 2026
Six months before the Nvidia spy scandal emerged, the New York-based short seller firm Culper Research had already raised questions about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s unusually close relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that buys Nvidia chips. She is now suspected to be a Chinese spy.
The Nvidia CEO admitted to an extramarital affair over the weekend, and the company has now opened a formal investigation into his relationship with Alice Huang (who shares his last name but is not related). U.S. intelligence officials believe she was recruited by the Chinese government to collect intelligence on Jensen Huang and influence his position regarding U.S. export controls on advanced AI chips.
Culper’s May 13 report is resurfacing because it picked up on the connection between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang while investigating Megaspeed’s ties to Nvidia.
NEW: We are short Nvidia $NVDA. We believe Nvidia has a significant China problem. Please see our full report and disclosures now available on our website, link in bio. pic.twitter.com/oTaJyL7S2R
— Culper (@CulperResearch) May 13, 2026
In particular, the report called the relationship between the two executives “uncomfortably close,” noting that the Nvidia CEO was spotted partying and socializing with Alice Huang on multiple occasions. The report even claimed that some Nvidia employees wondered whether they had a “special relationship.”
Culper Research also theorized the China business that Nvidia lost to export controls had been rerouted through Southeast Asia, and that Megaspeed, a major chip buyer in the region, was secretly financed by Chinese tech giant Alibaba through shell companies. It pointed to financial records that showed Megaspeed’s total liabilities and equity had grown from $33 million at the end of 2023 to around $3 billion by the end of 2024, much of it in the form of refundable deposits from an unidentified source.
Financial Times reported Monday that documents show Alibaba lent money to Megaspeed through subsidiaries.
Culper is a short seller, so it stood to financially benefit from making these allegations, and those about possible illegal chip diversion have not been independently verified. Its report is available on the web and was posted to X back in May.
