Taiwan extends expanded access to publicly funded flu drugs to Nov. 30
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
CDC spokesperson Lin Ming-cheng (center). CNA photo Nov. 10, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 10 (CNA) Taiwan's Centers for Disease Control (CDC) said Tuesday it would continue allowing more people to receive publicly funded flu antiviral drugs from Nov. 15 to Nov. 30, citing continued epidemic levels despite a decline in flu infections.
Under the measure, people in designated groups at higher risk of influenza who develop flu-like symptoms can receive publicly funded antiviral drugs, according to a CDC news release issued in October.
Eligible groups include infection-control personnel at medical institutions, residents and staff of long-term care facilities, childcare workers and nannies, and students from preschool through senior high school.
The measure also covers people living with or caring for individuals at high risk of severe influenza, livestock and poultry farm workers, zoo personnel, and veterinary quarantine personnel.
The CDC had extended the broader eligibility rules twice before.
CDC spokesperson Lin Ming-cheng (林明誠) said at a regular news conference that flu activity had declined for seven consecutive weeks and had been below the level used to define a flu epidemic for two consecutive weeks as of last week.
However, the CDC had decided not to declare an end to the flu epidemic because of the continued high number of severe cases and concerns that such an announcement could send a misleading message to the public, he said.
According to CDC data, 91,879 people sought medical attention for influenza-like illnesses at outpatient clinics and emergency rooms last week, down 6.4 percent from the previous week.
Despite the decline, 103 new severe cases and 38 deaths were reported last week, bringing the cumulative totals for the current flu season to 645 severe cases and 124 deaths since Oct. 1, the CDC said.
Of the severe cases, 69.9 percent involved people aged 65 or older, while 85.1 percent involved patients with underlying chronic conditions.
In addition, 97.1 percent of severe cases involved people who had not received a flu vaccination for this season, according to the CDC.
Lin urged people eligible for publicly funded flu vaccines to get vaccinated as soon as possible and take precautions to reduce their risk of infection.
As of Nov. 4, more than 5.5 million people had received flu vaccinations since the publicly funded vaccination program began on Oct. 1, the CDC said.
Meanwhile, COVID-19 activity in Taiwan fell below the epidemic threshold in mid-October, and infections have continued to decline, according to the CDC.
A total of 1.61 million people received COVID-19 vaccinations between Oct. 1 and Nov. 4, the agency said.

阿里巴巴计划芯片部门平头哥在香港首次公开募股中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
阿里巴巴计划芯片部门平头哥在香港首次公开募股
阿里巴巴计划将其芯片子公司平头哥在香港联交所上市。该公司于9月份提交了一份保密申请，现已被接受。阿里巴巴表示，此举将澄清价值并改善资本市场准入，使两家实体受益。
阿里巴巴集团宣布，计划分拆芯片业务平头哥，在香港联交所主板独立上市。
根据一份声明，平头阁于9月11日向交易所提交了一份保密的上市申请，该申请已得到确认，允许分拆计划继续进行。
阿里巴巴表示，拟议的分拆对于集团和平头阁都将带来商业利益。该公司表示，此举应能让投资者更好地评估阿里巴巴保留的集团业务的价值，同时继续其多元化的业务模式。这也将更好地体现和提升平头阁的自身价值，提高其独立形象，有助于商业谈判，并促进其独立进入股权和债务资本市场。
平头哥是一家中国全栈数据中心芯片供应商，其芯片支持系统级计​​算解决方案。建议分拆后，平头阁预计仍将是阿里巴巴的子公司。

Alibaba plans Hong Kong IPO for chip unit Pingtouge | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Alibaba plans Hong Kong IPO for chip unit Pingtouge
Alibaba plans to list its chip subsidiary Pingtouge on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The company submitted a confidential application in September, which has been accepted. Alibaba says the move will benefit both entities by clarifying value and improving access to capital markets.
Alibaba Group plans to spin off its chip business, Pingtouge, for an independent listing on the main board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, the company announced.
According to a statement, Pingtouge submitted a confidential listing application to the exchange on 11 September, which has been acknowledged, allowing the proposed spin-off to proceed.
Alibaba said the proposed spin-off would be commercially beneficial for both the group and Pingtouge. It said the move should allow investors to better assess the value of Alibaba’s retained group businesses while continuing its diversified business model. It would also better reflect and enhance Pingtouge’s own value, improve its independent profile, help in business negotiations, and facilitate independent access to equity and debt capital markets.
Pingtouge is a Chinese full-stack data-centre chip supplier whose chips enable system-level computing solutions. After the proposed spin-off, Pingtouge is expected to remain a subsidiary of Alibaba.

content:
Sudan Fuel Shortages Damage Crops in El Gezira As Food Prices Soar, Bakeries Strike in North Kordofan - allAfrica.com
Sudan Fuel Shortages Damage Crops in El Gezira As Food Prices Soar, Bakeries Strike in North Kordofan
The war in Sudan has created extreme levels of displacement, both internally and across Sudan’s borders.
Fuel shortages and soaring production costs are damaging agricultural crops in Sudan's El Gezira state, while rising food and transport prices are placing further pressure on household budgets. Reports of a general strike by bakeries in El Obeid, the capital of North Kordofan, has disrupted bread supplies amid a dispute over production costs and bread prices.
A farmer in the El Gezira agricultural scheme, identified as Mohammed, told Radio Dabanga that large areas of the maize crop had been damaged because of a shortage of petrol needed to operate irrigation pumps.
He said the price of a four-gallon container of petrol had reached SDG600,000, forcing him to search for fuel outside the state to save the remainder of his crop. He warned that declining agricultural production could further deepen food insecurity and hunger.
Keep up with the latest headlines on WhatsApp | LinkedIn
Food prices have also risen sharply across markets in El Gezira, including those in El Maseed, El Ma'aliq and El Kamlin.
Ahmed Mohammed El Khair, a resident of the state, told Radio Dabanga that the prices of essential commodities, particularly maize, lentils, sesame and wheat, had witnessed sharp increases.
He said a sack of maize now costs between SDG800,000 and SDG820,000, while a sack of wheat has reached around SDG780,000. Lentils sell for SDG850,000 per sack, while Kabkabiya (type of legume) costs between SDG300,000 and SDG450,000.
A sack of sesame has reached SDG860,000, while Egyptian beans cost between SDG1.1 million and SDG1.2 million, depending on the size and quality of the beans.
El Khair said the price increases had severely affected residents' purchasing power and reduced market activity, as most people had low or no incomes. He described the situation as a serious concern for residents and called on government authorities to intervene.
Transport costs have also surged, with the cost of transporting goods in Omdurman exceeding SDG2 million. In Kassala, taxi fares have reached SDG20,000 per passenger, adding to the growing cost of living.
All bakeries in El Obeid have closed in a general strike over a dispute with local authorities concerning bread prices and rising production costs.
Journalist Omar Mohammed Omar told Radio Dabanga that the complete shutdown had disrupted bread supplies across the city, leaving residents struggling to access a basic food staple.
He criticised the size and quality of the bread being sold, saying the loaves did not meet the expected standards. He said bread prices had previously reached SDG2,000 and, in some cases, SDG3,000, amid demands for prices to reflect the actual weight, size and nutritional value of each loaf.

在有报道称 NAS 通过 Plex2Shell 漏洞链受到危害后，台湾供应商 QNAP 敦促用户更新 Plex Media Server。在有报告称威胁者利用 Plex2Shell 漏洞链危害 NAS 设备后，QNAP 敦促用户通过 QNAP App Center 更新 Plex Media Server。 “QNAP 已收到一些用户的报告，称其 NAS 上的 Plex Media Server 似乎已因这些漏洞而受到损害，QNAP 技术支持正在协助 QNAP 发布的受影响用户咨询。”供应商发布的报告中写道。 “QNAP 产品安全事件响应团队 (QNAP PSIRT) 已确认该漏洞仅存在于 Plex Media Server 中；QTS、QuTS Hero 和其他 QNAP 操作系统本身不受影响。” Plex Media Server 旨在使电影、音乐和其他媒体可以跨设备使用。但是，当服务器暴露在互联网上并运行易受攻击的软件时，它可能会成为对您的电影收藏不感兴趣的攻击者的切入点。 2026 年 10 月 16 日，安全研究员 Zach Main 发布了名为 Plex2Shell 的漏洞链的技术细节和概念验证 (PoC) 代码。一天之内，研究人员就观察到攻击者利用该漏洞攻击面向互联网的蜜罐，部署加密货币挖掘恶意软件和代理软件。这一事件提醒我们，威胁行为者可以以多么快的速度将公共漏洞武器化。
该链结合了 Plex Media Server 中的四个漏洞：CVE-2026-96652、CVE-2026-96654、CVE-2026-96655 和 CVE-2026-96656。只要满足所需条件，它们就可以允许攻击者在没有有效凭据的情况下在易受攻击的服务器上执行任意代码。该代码以 Plex 服务的权限运行，使攻击者有机会安装额外的软件并滥用主机。技术细节可在 Main 的原始分析 Plex2Shell 中找到。 Plex 于 7 月 27 日收到有关这些漏洞的通知，并于 8 月 4 日承认了该报告，并授予了漏洞赏金。该公司于 9 月份在漏洞代码公开之前发布了修复程序。加载程序不会检查库的名称、可执行权限、数字签名或符号。因此，该库的 ELF 构造函数可以使用与 Plex 服务相同的权限运行。 “它不检查 lib 前缀，不需要执行位，不验证任何签名，也不查找任何特定符号。”阅读 zmain.com 发布的报告。 “当 dlopen 加载共享对象时，它会在执行任何符号解析之前运行 ELF 的 DT_INIT_ARRAY（构造函数）。仅具有构造函数且没有导出符号的 .so 仍将在加载时执行其代码。然后我们触发第二次转码。
编解码器目录被重新枚举，我们在第 4 阶段编写的 .so 被加载，并且构造函数以 uid=1000(plex) 运行。”这个细节很重要，因为最后阶段可以利用 Plex 加载共享库的方式。该链使用与转码相关的设置来影响执行，允许特制的库在 Plex 加载时运行。结果可以是在服务帐户下执行代码，而不需要攻击者首先获得交互式登录。 QNAP 敦促用户立即更新 Plex Media Server，用户应前往 App Center，打开我的应用程序并将 Plex Media Server 更新到版本 1.43.3 或更高版本。然后他们应该检查 Plex Web，并

【原文 English Original】
Taiwanese vendor QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server after reports of NAS compromises through the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain. QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server through the QNAP App Center after reports that threat actors exploited the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain to compromise NAS devices. “QNAP has received reports from some users that Plex Media Server on their NAS appears to have been compromised through these vulnerabilities, and QNAP Technical Support is assisting the affected usersadvisory published by QNAP. ” reads the report published by the vendor. “The QNAP Product Security Incident Response Team (QNAP PSIRT) has confirmed that the vulnerabilities exist only in Plex Media Server; QTS, QuTS hero, and other QNAP operating systems are not themselves affected.” Plex Media Server is designed to make movies, music, and other media available across devices. But when a server is exposed to the internet and runs vulnerable software, it can become an entry point for attackers who have little interest in your film collection. On October 16, 2026, security researcher Zach Main published technical details and proof-of-concept (PoC) code for a vulnerability chain dubbed Plex2Shell. Within a day, researchers had observed attackers using the exploit against an internet-facing honeypot, deploying cryptocurrency-mining malware and proxy software. The incident is a reminder of how quickly a public exploit can be weaponized by threat actors. The chain combines four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server: CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656. Together, they can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable servers without valid credentials, provided the required conditions are met. The code runs with the privileges of the Plex service, giving attackers an opportunity to install additional software and abuse the host. The technical details are available in Main’s original analysis, Plex2Shell . Plex had been notified of the vulnerabilities on July 27 and acknowledged the report on August 4, awarding a bug bounty. The company released fixes in September, before the exploit code became public. The loader does not check the library’s name, executable permissions, digital signature, or symbols. As a result, the library’s ELF constructor can run with the same privileges as the Plex service. “It doesn’t check for a lib prefix, doesn’t require the execute bit, doesn’t verify any signature, and doesn’t look for any specific symbol.” reads the report published by zmain.com. “When dlopen loads a shared object, it runs the ELF’s DT_INIT_ARRAY (constructor functions) before doing any symbol resolution. A .so that only has a constructor and no exported symbols will still execute its code on load. We then trigger a second transcode. The codec directory gets re-enumerated, the .so we wrote in Stage 4 gets loaded, and the constructor runs as uid=1000(plex) .” That detail matters because the final stage can exploit how Plex loads shared libraries. The chain uses a setting related to transcoding to influence execution, allowing a specially crafted library to run when Plex loads it. The result can be code execution under the service account, without requiring the attacker to obtain an interactive login first. QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server immediately, users should go to App Center, open My Apps and update Plex Media Server to version 1.43.3 or later. They should then check in Plex Web, under Settings and General, that the installed version is 1.43.3.10861 or later. QNAP will release further updates after verifying them, but users should not wait. If Plex was reachable from the internet while running version 1.43.2 or earlier, users should treat the NAS as potentially compromised. This may apply if Plex Remote Access was enabled, port 32400 was forwarded, or the port was opened automatically through UPnP or router settings. Updating alone will not remove anything an attacker may have installed. In those cases, users should follow QNAP’s FAQ to perform a clean reinstall, check for signs of compromise and reset both their Plex and NAS credentials. The company also advises disabling Plex Remote Access if it is not needed and avoiding port forwarding for port 32400. Users who need remote access should use a VPN instead. QNAP also recommends keeping QTS or QuTS hero and all installed apps up to date. Step-by-step instructions are available in the Plex2Shell: Check and Remediation FAQ for QNAP NAS Users . CISA added Plex2Shell flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 20, 2026, urging federal agencies to addresse them by October 23, 2026. Follow me on Twitter:  @securityaffairs  and  Facebook  and  Mastodon Pierluigi Paganini ( SecurityAffairs  – hacking, QNAP)

content:
Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago | TechCrunch
3:28 PM PST · November 9, 2026
Image Credits:Jose Sarmento Matos/Bloomberg / Getty Images
Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang hired Heller Inc., a crisis communications firm known for handling sex scandals, at least a year before he publicly acknowledged an extramarital affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, Wired reported.
Heller Inc. founder Risa Heller has advised prominent men through personal scandals and sexual misconduct accusations, according to a 2023 New York Magazine profile. Her reported clients include former congressman Anthony Weiner, celebrity chef Mario Batali, and former New Yorker writer Jeffrey Toobin.
Wired also reported that Nvidia’s internal communications team was told to copy Heller Inc. on press inquiries about Huang shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report about whether Nvidia was helping Chinese companies evade U.S. chip export restrictions.
The Times reported that Megaspeed, a then little-known Singapore-based data center company with ties to China, had acquired nearly $2 billion worth of Nvidia chips. It described Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang, the woman later linked to Jensen Huang, standing next to him at a Taipei gathering of Nvidia customers.
Heller and Nvidia didn’t immediately respond to requests for comment.
On Sunday, Nvidia published a statement from Huang acknowledging an affair with a former Megaspeed executive, though he didn’t name Alice Huang. Nvidia’s board separately announced an independent investigation, citing reports that Huang “has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.”

content:
【大紀元2026年11月10日訊】中共最高檢察院11月10日通報，廣東省深圳市政協原黨組書記、主席戴北方涉嫌受賄一案，已向法院提起公訴。戴北方被指涉嫌利用職務便利大搞權錢交易，非法收受財物且數額特別巨大。
據起訴指控，戴北方利用擔任深圳市鹽田區委書記、市委常委、祕書長、組織部部長、市委副書記及市政協主席等職務上的便利，為他人謀取利益，非法收受他人財物，數額特別巨大，應當以受賄罪追究其刑事責任。
戴北方去年12月落馬。大陸媒體報導，戴北方是中共二十大以來，繼李春生、陳繼興之後，廣東落馬的第三隻「大老虎」。
今年6月22日，官方通報，廣東深圳市政協原主席戴北方被開除黨籍。
戴北方被指對抗審查，大搞權錢交易，利用職權為親屬謀取利益等。
今年4月已落馬的中共政治局委員、前新疆黨委書記馬興瑞，在2015年至2016年任深圳市委書記期間，與時任市委副書記和政協主席的戴北方共事。此前有報導說，戴北方交代了馬興瑞的問題。
公開資料顯示，戴北方為廣東惠州人，長年在深圳任職，曾任深圳市龍崗區委副書記，深圳市政協祕書長、辦公廳主任，深圳市鹽田區委書記，深圳市委宣傳部部長，市委祕書長、市委辦公廳主任，市委組織部部長、市委副書記等職，2015年任深圳市政協主席，2020年9月退休。

content:
【大紀元2026年11月10日訊】（大紀元記者鍾又淳報導）香港影帝梁家輝近日被網友拍到獨自現身大陸的某高鐵站，身旁沒有任何助理及工作人員。68歲的他疑因太疲倦，候車時靠著行李箱拉桿低頭小憩。網友紛紛感歎其低調親民，與銀幕上的霸氣形象形成強烈反差。
據港媒報導，梁家輝此次深夜趕高鐵，是為了前往廈門出席第39屆中國電影金雞獎頒獎典禮。他憑藉電影《捕風追影》中的反派角色「傅隆生」入圍金雞獎最佳男主角，這也是他五度奪下香港金像獎影帝後，首度入圍金雞獎最佳男主角。
值得關注的是，梁家輝在《捕風追影》中的動作戲均親自上陣。而此次搭高鐵的行程，是他從《捕風追影2》的拍攝間隙中抽身趕來，剛結束連續兩週的高強度打戲的拍攝。
從網友曝光的照片中可見，梁家輝當天穿著簡單便服，身旁僅有一個行李箱和一個大背包，未見任何工作人員陪同。他在月台等候時略顯疲態，靠著行李箱閉目養神，完全融入到一般旅客的隊伍之中。
照片流出後，「梁家輝坐高鐵參加金雞獎」在微博累計閱讀量迅速突破790萬，討論量持續攀升，不少人將焦點放在他「零排場」的低調作風上。
網友感慨：「真正的大佬，從來不需要簇擁。電影裡千變萬化，生活裡低調從容。褪去光環，只是趕路的普通人。好喜歡這種沉澱下來的鬆弛感。」帖文引發其他網友共鳴，留言稱梁家輝是「超級親民的老戲骨」。
最近，香港導演王晶在訪談中透露，早前在一場頒獎典禮上，親眼目睹某位明星出入竟有超過20名工作人員團團包圍，陣仗大得嚇人，甚至連他都無法看清楚對方究竟是誰。相較之下，他特別點名周潤發，雖然早已是國際級巨星，私下卻毫無架子。
有網友翻出梁家輝過去在大陸高速公路服務區被偶遇的經歷。當時對方稱他是明星，梁家輝僅淡淡回應：「不是明星，一個職業而已。」如今這段往事被重新提起，讓他與周潤發一樣「接地氣」的形象更深植人心。

content:
Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology
This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth
Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser.
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.
<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>
We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.
All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.
Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.
There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.
To sum up, the issues were:
No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature
So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.
<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>
"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience.
By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."
We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.
Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.
Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:
"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."
Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>
Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.
Supporting the editors - all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
Supporting our contributors - we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
Recruiting more people - paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
Enhance our level of expertise - we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
Expand our network - we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.
<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>
Munawwar Abdulla is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.
Sonya Imin is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.
Maidina Kadeer is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港推出“Design@HKG”2026全城地区活动
文化创意产业办公室正在资助一个名为“Design@HKG”2026的新品牌地区设计活动，该活动已于11月10日启动。文化创意产业专员黎世明表示，该计划旨在促进跨界别、跨区域的交流，展示
2026 年 11 月 10 日 19:57 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 10 日 20:19 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
文化创意产业办公室今天推出“设计@HKG”2026，这是一项由文化创意产业办公室资助的新计划，旨在将设计主题活动带到香港各区。
文化创意产业署署长黎世明在开幕礼上表示，“设计@HKG”是今年推出的新品牌，是一年一度的设计盛事“设计营商周”的地区组成部分。他表示，计划旨在举办更多以设计为主题的地区活动，促进跨界别、跨区域的交流与合作，进一步展示香港作为亚洲设计之都的创新实力。
一系列“Design@HKG”2026活动将在香港多个地区举行，包括山顶、中环、湾仔、尖沙咀、油麻地及西贡。活动将以互动装置、电车游览、设计展览、工作坊和分享会等形式，让公众和游客体验和发现设计融入日常生活的可能性和魅力。
有关“Design@HKG”2026 的更多信息，请访问 designathkg.com/zh。

Hong Kong launches ‘Design@HKG’ 2026 district events across city
The Cultural and Creative Industries Office is funding a new brand of district design events called ‘Design@HKG’ 2026, which launched on 10 November. Commissioner for Cultural and Creative Industries Lai Sai-ming said the programme aims to boost cross-sector and cross-regional exchanges, showcasing
10 Nov 2026 at 19:57 HKT · updated 10 Nov, 20:19 · 1 min read
The Cultural and Creative Industries Office today launched ‘Design@HKG’ 2026, a new programme funded by the office to bring design-themed activities to districts across Hong Kong.
Commissioner for Cultural and Creative Industries Lai Sai-ming said at the opening ceremony that ‘Design@HKG’ is a new brand introduced this year as a district-level component of the annual design event ‘Business of Design Week’. He said the programme aims to organise more design-themed district activities to promote cross-sector and cross-regional exchanges and collaboration, further demonstrating Hong Kong’s innovative strength as Asia’s design capital.
A series of ‘Design@HKG’ 2026 activities will be held across multiple districts in Hong Kong, including the Peak, Central, Wan Chai, Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Ma Tei and Sai Kung. The programme will feature interactive installations, tram tours, design exhibitions, workshops and sharing sessions, allowing the public and tourists to experience and discover the possibilities and charm of design integrated into daily life.
More information about ‘Design@HKG’ 2026 is available at designathkg.com/zh.

（中央社記者陳俊華台北10日電）民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋疑因身體不適，取消公開行程。民進黨團幹事長莊瑞雄今天說，上午有與沈伯洋通電話，聽到沈伯洋沙啞的聲音、喉嚨使用過度，早上先休息一下，中午就會到立法院程序委員會，下午繼續競選活動。
沈伯洋昨天接受媒體聯訪時，聲音明顯沙啞，他說，身體精神狀況不錯，但喉嚨越咳越嚴重，但又沒有感冒症狀，可能是掃街時傷到，所以喉嚨才發炎。沈伯洋原訂今天上午要前往台北花市掃街拜票，但行程因故取消。
民進黨立法院黨團幹事長莊瑞雄、書記長范雲、副幹事長陳培瑜上午舉行輿情回應記者會，媒體關注沈伯洋的身體狀況。莊瑞雄說，他早上9時41分才打給沈伯洋，查證一下為何暫停選舉活動，聽到沈伯洋很沙啞的聲音，是因為喉嚨使用過度。
莊瑞雄表示，早上先讓沈伯洋休息一下，中午程序委員會沈伯洋就會到立法院，沈伯洋非常認真，選前剩下十幾天，還在參與立法院的委員會，下午的競選活動就會繼續。
媒體報導，沈伯洋近日受邀上YouTuber愛莉莎莎的節目，合照曝光後引發兩極評價，因愛莉莎莎曾是知名「小草」，更曾因質疑2024年總統大選開票過程引發爭議，導致部分綠營支持者感到不解。
莊瑞雄說，這很正常、合理，沈伯洋連「戰鬥藍」的節目都去上了，不管節目屬性，既然強調要破圈，要跟不同族群溝通，他覺得非常好。沈伯洋這幾天多接觸過去不是支持民進黨的人，對選舉來講，可以看到沈伯洋是多元、誠懇，願意傾聽不同市民的聲音。
莊瑞雄表示，一座城市裡民眾的價值、認同會有所不同，要當市長的人跟各種社群的市民多互動，本來就很正常，對沈伯洋這樣的選舉策略非常讚賞。（編輯：蘇龍麒）1151110

content:
微短剧：为何愈来愈多英国人观看源自中国的“碎片化”剧集？ - BBC News 中文
图像加注文字，Spare Arrow 今年稍早在社交媒体上推出了首部微短剧《Glen's Boutique》，这是一部喜剧冒险作品。
Author, 格蕾丝·迪恩（Grace Dean）
每天晚上，希瑟·夏罗克（Heather Sharrock）都会坐下来观看自己最喜爱的剧集。
但那不是在网飞（Netflix）、BBC iPlayer，甚至不是在电视上播放，而是在她的手机里。
我们之中有些人或许每晚能看完几集最新追看的剧集，Heather 却能一口气追看几十集，因为这位来自苏格兰、55岁的女子迷上了微短剧（microdrama）。
Heather 说：“现在世界上有太多乱七八糟的事情在发生，能够暂时放空，不去想那些事情，感觉很好。”
微短剧在中国早已大受欢迎，如今在英国也愈来愈流行，可在 ReelShort、CandyJar 和 DramaBox 等应用程式上观看。上星期，制作方宣布将经典肥皂剧《家有芳邻》（Neighbours）的故事线重新剪辑成超短的直式剧集，这是这种形式正逐步走向主流的最新迹象之一。
微短剧由节奏明快、张力十足的短篇集数组成，每集通常长60至90秒。许多作品聚焦于禁忌之恋、家族纷争和隐藏身份的亿万富豪等主题，而几乎每一集都会以戏剧性的悬念作结。每部作品通常有50集或以上，因此总时长与一部长篇电影相若。
来自苏格兰、45岁的影迷黛安·艾特肯（Diane Aitken）将她喜爱的狼人与吸血鬼题材微短剧形容为1980年代美国肥皂剧《家族风云》（Dallas；《朱门恩怨》／《豪门恩怨》）或《王朝》（Dynasty；《朝代》／《锦绣豪门》）的“加强版”。
图像加注文字，Diane 和 Sarah-Jayne 都表示，她们是在社交媒体上看到广告后开始接触微短剧的。
出生于中国的电影制作人孙慧明（Samantha Sun）表示，这类剧集于2010年代末在中国出现，最初是由网络小说改编而成，制作成本低廉且拍摄快捷；对许多观众而言，它们是一种逃避现实的方式。
来自唐卡斯特、46岁的莎拉—简·伦恩（Sarah-Jayne Lunn）表示，微短剧帮助她度过人生中的艰难时期。她说：“我立刻就上瘾了。我不用想太多。”
珍·库珀（Jen Cooper）是微短剧观众，现时则担任业界顾问。她对此表示认同。她说，微短剧最初主要受到寻找爱情题材内容的中年女性欢迎，许多 BookTok 和浪漫奇幻（romantasy）爱好者都会观看，但如今已吸引更广泛的观众群。
图像加注文字，中国观众已被微短剧戏剧性的情节和快节奏的特点深深吸引。
根据中国国家广播电视总局数据，去年中国微短剧市场规模超过1000亿元人民币（138.9亿美元；4200亿元新台币），观众人数突破8亿。但微短剧在韩国（南韩）、印度和美国同样受欢迎，而亚马逊 Prime、Peacock 和 Disney+ 等串流平台都已宣布计划在服务中加入微短剧。
在英国，自称全国首个专门微短剧应用程式的 TattleTV 于今年稍早推出；而皇家电视学会（Royal Television Society, RTS）则于今夏举办有关微短剧的业界座谈会。
各家公司亦希望把握微短剧热潮，为社交媒体制作品牌短片广告，其中包括杰米·奥利弗（Jamie Oliver）、合作社（Co-op），以及第四频道电视台（Channel 4）与 Sol de Janeiro 合作推出的作品。
威尔士制作公司 Spare Arrow 的夏洛特·布罗肯布罗（Charlotte Brokenbrow）表示，微短剧必须节奏明快，才能留住观众注意力。该公司于今年制作首部微短剧系列。
她说：“如果剧本和影片留白太多，观众就会觉得无聊，然后滑走。”
除了节奏飞快之外，微短剧受欢迎的原因之一是观众可以利用零碎时间观看，因此有分析人士形容它们为“零食式内容”（snackable；碎片化内容）。
安格利亚鲁斯金大学（Anglia Ruskin University, ARU）电影与媒体副教授蒂娜·肯德尔博士（Dr Tina Kendall）表示，微短剧亦迎合了观众转向“随意、低投入、可以随时开始和停止观看”的趋势。
有受访者向BBC表示，他们会在接孩子放学时于车内观看；也有人表示，会一边处理家务或行政工作，一边把微短剧当作背景播放。
Sarah-Jayne 说，由于剧情走向通常“太容易预料”，她甚至可以一边工作一边看。
专门的微短剧应用程式通常先让用户免费观看头几集，之后则要求付费订阅。CandyJar 年费49英镑（66美元；475元人民币；1960元新台币），DramaBox 则收费110英镑。不过，大部分微短剧平台都允许追剧观众购买按周计算的订阅服务，或透过观看广告换取免费集数。
当你浏览这些应用程式时，黑帮头目、欢喜冤家变情人，以及牛仔等主题一再出现。
孙慧明表示，中国制作公司经常复制成功公式，只作微小改动，而 Heather 对此亦深有同感。
她说：“很多其实都是同一个故事，只是换了不同背景设定。”又说自己已经“看腻了”亿万富豪行政总裁题材。
较为离奇的剧名包括《我领养了被偷走的孩子》（I Adopted My Stolen Baby）、《迷恋我的英国牛仔》（Craving My British Cowboy），以及《我在圣诞节找到一位无家可归的亿万富翁丈夫》（Found a Homeless Billionaire Husband for Christmas）。
一些观众表示，部分剧情有贬低女性之嫌，其中某些作品粗糙地描绘暴力和性侵情节。曾于2024年出演首部微短剧的演员可可·泰勒（Coco Taylor）说：“这甚至变成了一个笑话，女演员在吃午饭之前就已经遭遇了无数可怕的事情，哭喊了上千万次。”
泰勒表示，她曾拒绝接演某些作品，因为她认为那些剧集过于厌女。不过，她与许多微短剧爱好者都表示，故事质素已经有所提升，他们认为这是因为现在有更多剧情由美国和英国团队编写；他们亦热切谈论微短剧正逐步拓展至喜剧、惊悚和恐怖等类型。
图像加注文字，Coco Taylor 正在主演一部由威尔士制作公司拍摄的谋杀悬疑微短剧。
制作公司 Black Swan 创办人海顿·韦克林（Haydn Wakeling）于今年稍早透过电影业界人士首次听闻微短剧。他说：“快转到现在，已经变成所有人都在谈论的话题。”
韦克林表示，从财务角度来看，微短剧对导演与制作人非常有吸引力。拍摄一部时长介乎60至90分钟的微短剧通常不足两星期，因此能有效降低成本。
导演丹·勒文斯坦Dan Löwenstein）于2024年2月执导首部微短剧《黑帮情人》（Mafia Lover），如今他已拍摄到第38部。他最初参与的是由中国应用程式平台委托制作的作品，但表示随着中国业界转向人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI；人工智慧）制作，他现正与美国平台、全球串流媒体和英国公司合作。
图像加注文字，制作公司 Black Swan 的电影制作人正在为他们首部微短剧进行最后修饰。这部作品是一套于7月拍摄、共50集的谋杀悬疑剧。
英国现已成为欧洲最大的微短剧观众市场。虽然许多观众与业界制作人都对这种形式的未来感到兴奋，但它亦不乏批评者。
有人讥讽微短剧是低质内容，会破坏人们的专注力。《卫报》（The Guardian）一篇评论文章的作者便形容这类剧集“愚蠢得近乎灾难性，而且客观而言品质低劣”。
但正如由观众转型成顾问的珍·库珀所说：“没有人会说这是甚么深刻作品，但如果它能让人产生情感共鸣、令某人展露笑容，或让艰难的一天变得稍微容易一些，那肯定是一件值得庆祝的美好事情。”

zh_title: 施耐德电气探索采矿业技术融合
summary: 施耐德电气表示，它正在将电气化、自动化和数字智能结合在一起，帮助矿山作为人工智能驱动的软件定义平台运行，连接能源和工业智能。跨越三个互联层的人工智能 该公司描述了帮助矿业公司应用人工智能的三个层面： 互联设备：智能设备感知操作条件并提供数据和控制功能；边缘控制和计算：仿真和自动化使用AI来支持灵活、高效和有弹性的系统性能；以及应用程序、分析和服务：
content:
施耐德电气表示，它正在将电气化、自动化和数字智能结合在一起，帮助矿山作为人工智能驱动的软件定义平台运行，连接能源和工业智能。跨越三个互联层的人工智能 该公司描述了帮助矿业公司应用人工智能的三个层面： 互联设备：智能设备感知操作条件并提供数据和控制功能；边缘控制和计算：仿真和自动化使用AI来支持灵活、高效和有弹性的系统性能；应用程序、分析和服务：人工智能驱动的见解支持协作、明智的行动和企业价值。施耐德电气利用其技术组合将来自设备、边缘和分析层的过程和能源数据与采矿专业知识和生态系统集成相结合。这支持整个采矿作业生命周期（从设计和施工到运营和维护）的数字孪生。 Torngat Metals：综合稀土合作伙伴 Torngat Metals 在开发加拿大 Strange Lake 稀土项目时，正在利用这些专业知识和集成能力。两家公司签署了一份不具约束力的谅解备忘录（MoU），以探索战略工业合作伙伴关系，支持弹性和负责任的稀土价值链。
拟议的合作伙伴关系以努纳维克的奇异湖、拉布拉多的相关基础设施以及计划中的九岛分离设施为中心。它将通过端到端的合作，将上游资源开发、技术集成和未来工业需求联系起来。该谅解备忘录概述了潜在的 360° 合作伙伴关系，有两个目标： 支持项目开发：将施耐德电气在电气化、自动化、数字系统和可持续工业设计方面的专业知识应用于下一代采矿和加工项目；增强供应链弹性：改善施耐德电气长期获得安全、负责任和合规的稀土和磁体生态系统的战略应用。奇湖预计将生产可再生能源、数字基础设施和先进制造中使用的永磁体所必需的重稀土元素和轻稀土元素。施耐德电气表示，拟议的合作超出了项目支持的范围：它代表着迈向值得信赖的端到端关键矿产价值链的一步。
Torngat 计划在 Strange Lake 整合一座矿山、季节性通道和港口，以及一座年产 15,000 吨稀土的分离和加工厂（照片来源：Torngat Metals） 调整项目交付和未来需求 施耐德电气全球采矿、矿物和金属主管 Vivek Kapoor 表示，此类安排在战略意图上与早期承购关系类似。施耐德的同行通常会承担责任，同时激励两家公司实现项目 KPI。 “通过在如此早期阶段参与并探索未来工业需求如何支持该项目，我们对其长期成功进行了投资，”他上个月在伦敦举行的《金融时报》金属与矿业峰会间隙告诉 IM。 Torngat 计划将一座矿山、季节性通道和港口以及一座年产 15,000 吨稀土的分离和加工厂整合在一起。施耐德电气表示，它在支持这一国际化所需的四个领域拥有经验。

【原文 English Original】
Schneider Electric says it is bringing together electrification, automation and digital intelligence to help mines operate as AI-powered, software-defined platforms that connect energy and industrial intelligence. AI across three connected layers The company describes three layers through which it helps mining companies apply AI: Connected devices: Intelligent devices sense operating conditions and provide data and control capabilities; Edge control and computing: Simulation and automation use AI to support flexible, efficient and resilient system performance; and Apps, analytics and services: AI-driven insights support collaboration, informed action and enterprise value. Schneider Electric uses its portfolio of technologies to combine process and energy data from the device, edge and analytics layers with mining expertise and ecosystem integration. This supports digital twins throughout the mining operations lifecycle, from design and construction to operation and maintenance. Torngat Metals: an integrated rare earth partnership Torngat Metals is drawing on these expertise and integration capabilities as it develops the Strange Lake rare earth project in Canada. The companies have signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to explore a strategic industrial partnership supporting a resilient and responsible rare earth value chain. The proposed partnership centres on Strange Lake in Nunavik, associated infrastructure in Labrador and a planned separation facility in Sept-Îles. It would connect upstream resource development, technology integration and future industrial demand through an end-to-end collaboration. The MoU outlines a potential 360° partnership with two objectives: Support project development: Apply Schneider Electric’s expertise in electrification, automation, digital systems and sustainable industrial design to a next-generation mining and processing project; and Strengthen supply chain resilience: Improve Schneider Electric’s long-term access to a secure, responsible and compliant rare earth and magnet ecosystem for strategic applications. Strange Lake is expected to produce heavy and light rare earth elements essential to permanent magnets used in renewable energy, digital infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Schneider Electric says the proposed collaboration goes beyond project support: it represents a step towards a trusted, end-to-end critical minerals value chain.   Torngat plans to bring together a mine, seasonal access road and port, and a separation and processing plant capable of producing 15,000 t/y of rare earths at Strange Lake (photo credit: Torngat Metals) Aligning project delivery and future demand Vivek Kapoor, Schneider Electric’s Global Lead for Mining, Minerals & Metals, said arrangements of this kind are similar in strategic intent to an early-stage offtake relationship. He described them as going beyond what Schneider’s peers typically undertake, while giving both companies an incentive to deliver on project KPIs. “By engaging at such an early stage and exploring how future industrial demand could support the project, we are invested in its long-term success,” he told IM on the sidelines of the FT Metals & Mining Summit in London last month. Torngat plans to bring together a mine, seasonal access road and port, and a separation and processing plant capable of producing 15,000 t/y of rare earths. Schneider Electric says it has experience across the four areas needed to support that integrated approach: electrification, automation, digital systems and sustainable industrial design. Engineering and operational applications Connecting engineering and operations Through AVEVA engineering solutions, the CONNECT data services platform, AVEVA PI System and its advanced analytics ecosystem, Schneider Electric says it helps organisations unify operational technology, information technology and engineering technology data. This enables these organisations to apply AI-driven insights and put those insights into practice in near real time. AVEVA’s agentic AI capabilities, built into its unified engineering software solution, are already helping mining companies and engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) firms improve detailed engineering productivity, the company says. These capabilities automate repetitive tasks and comparisons, helping teams develop and optimise 3D models more efficiently. SQM: process optimisation At SQM’s operations, Kapoor says AI-powered predictive and optimisation models delivered: A 10-15% reduction in process variability; An increase in nitrate yield of up to 1%; and A 1-3% improvement in raw material efficiency. These improvements translate into higher productivity, less waste and improved sustainability. Roy Hill: a remotely connected pit-to-port operation Kapoor also highlighted Schneider Electric’s earlier work at the 55 Mt/y Roy Hill iron ore project in Western Australia. The company delivered remote operations and demand chain planning capabilities, integrating mine, plant, rail and port operations into a single remotely controlled ecosystem. These capabilities supported one of the industry’s most advanced greenfield deployments and helped optimise the journey from resource to market. “This really was a pit-to-port project for Roy HIll,” he said. For lead EPC provider Samsung C&T, Schneider Electric delivered the port facility’s complete power infrastructure, including 14 switch rooms, transformers, drives, backup power, cooling and power management systems. Image from the Roy Hill owner-operated mine and processing operations (credit: Roy Hill) Vale: centralised monitoring Schneider Electric and AVEVA, which Schneider Electric owns, have also worked with Vale in Brazil to integrate, centralise and remotely monitor operations across its Mariana and Itabira complexes. Schneider Electric says it is also applying hybrid advanced process control and AI to improve milling-circuit performance. In other industrial applications, these solutions have reduced furnace NOx emissions. Removing data silos and putting insights to work A shared data backbone Schneider Electric sees its ability to unify siloed operational data within a scalable, enterprise-ready architecture as a key market differentiator. That capability is also important to Torngat Metals’ integrated project approach. In traditional mining and processing environments, data from sensors, control systems and laboratories often sits in disconnected systems, limiting its usefulness, the company says. Schneider Electric says CONNECT provides a centralised data backbone on top of AVEVA PI System, enabling secure, near-real-time sharing between on-premises systems and cloud analytics platforms. At SQM, for example, operational data is made accessible in Databricks through Delta Sharing. This supports advanced AI, machine-learning and simulation workflows with near-real-time refresh cycles, according to Schneider Electric. “This architecture eliminates data silos and provides an open, developer-friendly environment for building and scaling AI solutions – an essential foundation for industrial transformation,” the company says. From recommendations to operational action Schneider Electric describes a “closed-loop approach” in which model outputs are fed back into operational systems, rather than remaining separate analytical insights. At SQM, predictive and optimisation models generate real-time recommendations for feed ratios, temperatures and flows. Schneider Electric says these outputs are written back into CONNECT and displayed in operator tools such as AVEVA PI Vision. Operators can then compare actual performance with AI-driven optimal conditions and act on the recommendations. Prescriptive setpoint optimisation similarly allows AI models to recommend and guide operational adjustments. In some cases, these adjustments can run automatically to support continuous performance improvement. “This integration transforms AI from a decision-support tool into an active driver of operational performance,” it says. Adapting AI models and scaling deployment Continuous model development Schneider Electric says its architecture supports rapid development and deployment of machine-learning models, hybrid simulation models and dynamic optimisation algorithms. In practice, this includes: Training and retraining machine-learning models using the large volumes of data held in AVEVA PI System, which is widely adopted at mining sites; Developing hybrid models that combine physics-based simulations with data-driven AI; and Running real-time scenario simulations to optimise production conditions. At SQM, Schneider Electric says predictive models achieved approximately 90% accuracy, increasing operator confidence and improving decision quality. Model retraining cycles were also significantly reduced, enabling faster adaptation to changing process conditions and continuous performance improvement. From individual use cases to enterprise-wide deployment Scalability is another key differentiator, according to Schneider Electric. The company says its architecture supports deployment across multiple plants, processes and business units, rather than being limited to individual use cases. At SQM, the success of nitrate optimisation has led to plans to expand into additional plants and incorporate richer datasets, including maintenance and laboratory analytics, the company claims. Schneider Electric presents this as an example of the progression from pilot projects to broader digital transformation. Looking ahead: an integrated mine-to-metal benchmark The MoU between Schneider Electric and Torngat Metals points towards a similarly integrated approach. Schneider Electric hopes the proposed mine-to-metal collaboration will establish a benchmark for digital transformation across Torngat’s operations. “By embedding sustainability, efficiency and digital performance across the project lifecycle, from design through operations, the partnership aims to set new standards for responsible resource development,” it says. Lead image from the Roy Hill owner-operated mine and processing operations (credit: Roy Hill) The post Schneider Electric explores technology convergence in mining appeared first on International Mining .

Zen, Psychedelics & the Path of Awakening with Ryushin Marchaj, Thu, Nov 19, 2026, 5:00 PM | Meetup
Zen, Psychedelics & the Path of Awakening with Ryushin Marchaj
Hosted by The Psychedelic Advocacy N.
Portland Psychedelic Healing and Spirituality Community
REGISTER ON OUR WEBSITE to attend this Zoom event: https://psychedelicadvocacy.org/event/zen-teacher-ryushin-marchaj-zen-and-psychedelics/
After registering, you will receive a confirmation email containing information and a link to join the meeting.
In this intimate and engaging talk, Ryushin will draw from decades of Zen practice and teaching, along with his personal exploration of psychedelic medicines as sacred sacraments, to explore where these two paths meet.
He’ll reflect on how Buddhist wisdom and psychedelic experience can inform one another, opening new ways of understanding the mind, awakening, suffering, and what it means to live with greater awareness, compassion, and freedom.
Together, we’ll explore how these ancient teachings and profound experiences can help us recognize conditioned patterns, deepen our understanding of ourselves, and bring greater wisdom and presence into everyday life. Ryushin brings a rare perspective that bridges traditional Zen practice with firsthand experience of psychedelic states.
Come join the conversation, bring your questions, and connect with our community as we explore what can emerge when Zen, psychedelics, and the work of integration come together.
Rev. Konrad Ryushin Marchaj is a Zen priest in the tradition of Zen Buddhism and a dharma heir of the late John Daido Loori, Roshi. Formerly the abbot of Zen Mountain Monastery in the Catskill Mountains of New York,
Born in Warsaw, Poland, he immigrated to the United States in 1967. He earned a Bachelor’s degree in Anthropology from Yale University in 1976 and a medical degree from Albany Medical College in 1980.
Ryushin began practicing Buddhism in 1983 and entered full-time residential training at Zen Mountain Monastery in 1992. During his tenure as abbot and director of operations, he also collaborated with liberal arts educators to integrate contemplative practices into higher education.
Since 2014, he has been deeply engaged in exploring ayahuasca ceremonies within diverse traditions, guided by several teachers. Integrating his medical and psychiatric background with decades of Buddhist training, Ryushin brings a compassionate, insightful, and down-to-earth approach to teaching.
**********************************************************************
Our group exists to provide education and harm reduction and foster a supportive, heart-centered community. Our group does not offer medical advice, therapy, or psychedelic substances. Also, our events do not condone or facilitate the taking of illegal drugs.

content:
PayPal：去年有 2540 万全球买家在香港商家购物 |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 10 日，星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
PayPal：去年有 2540 万全球买家在香港商家购物
截至 2026 年 6 月，来自 100 多个市场的超过 2,540 万名买家通过 PayPal 从香港企业购买商品，其中美国、德国和英国的需求领先。报告还指出，越来越多的内地企业将香港作为海外基地，并越来越多地采用“先买后付”服务。
PayPal 周二发布的一份报告显示，过去一年，超过 2540 万全球买家通过 PayPal 从香港企业购买商品，原因是越来越多的中国大陆企业在香港设立海外扩张中心，以及越来越多地采用“先买后付”(BNPL) 服务。
2025年7月至2026年6月的数据显示，香港商户持续捕捉全球主要市场的需求，每日跨境交易量达20万笔，每月成交额达4.09亿美元（32.1亿港元）。买家来自100多个市场，其中美国、德国和英国仍然是前三大国际市场，采购量分别约为860万、620万和220万。巴西、墨西哥和马来西亚等新兴市场在此期间也出现了大量支出。
PayPal 香港和台湾企业账户管理总监 Jack Fu 表示，零售、时尚、游戏和电脑引领了香港的跨境销售，因为越来越多的中国大陆公司正在国际贸易中心建立业务，以发展其全球业务。他补充说，内地品牌的吸尘器、3D打印机和无人机表现出色。香港官方数据显示，到2025年，通过香港转口的内地商品约占该市出口总额的41.2%。傅说：“调查结果证明了该城市的全球影响力、吸引力以及跨境贸易为当地商人带来的机会。”
该报告还强调了不断变化的消费者行为，数字支付体验的价值更高，BNPL 越来越受欢迎。 PayPal 的 BNPL 交易量在 2026 年第二季度增长了 26%，美国和澳大利亚是成熟市场，欧洲和日本的采用率也在上升。据 Global Market Insights 预测，未来十年全球 BNPL 市场将增长 21% 至 23%。
PayPal 的另一项调查显示，63% 至 70% 的消费者计划保留或增加节日支出，而 18% 至 27% 的消费者会提前开始购物。傅建议商家可以根据自己的产品和不同的市场调整资源配置，为年末假期购物季提前做好准备，包括尽早推出早鸟优惠或限量优惠券。

PayPal: 25.4m global buyers shopped from HK merchants in past year | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
PayPal: 25.4m global buyers shopped from HK merchants in past year
More than 25.4 million buyers from over 100 markets purchased from Hong Kong businesses via PayPal in the year to June 2026, with US, Germany and UK leading demand. The report also noted rising mainland firms using Hong Kong as an overseas base and growing adoption of buy now, pay later services.
More than 25.4 million global buyers purchased from Hong Kong businesses via PayPal over the past year, driven by an increase in mainland Chinese firms setting up in the city for overseas expansion and growing adoption of buy now, pay later (BNPL) services, according to a PayPal report released on Tuesday.
Data from July 2025 to June 2026 showed that Hong Kong merchants continued to capture demand from major global markets, with 200,000 daily cross-border transactions and US$409 million (HK$3.21 billion) in monthly turnover. Buyers came from more than 100 markets, with the US, Germany and the UK remaining the top three international markets, recording roughly 8.6 million, 6.2 million and 2.2 million purchases respectively. Emerging markets including Brazil, Mexico and Malaysia also saw significant spending over the period.
Retail, fashion, gaming and computers led Hong Kong's cross-border sales, as an increasing number of mainland Chinese companies are establishing a presence in the international trade hub to grow their global business, said Jack Fu, director of Enterprise Account Management of Hong Kong and Taiwan at PayPal. He added that vacuum cleaners, 3D printers and drones from mainland brands recorded outstanding performance. Mainland-made goods re-exported through Hong Kong made up roughly 41.2 per cent of the city's total exports in 2025, according to Hong Kong official data. "The findings demonstrate the city's global reach, attractiveness and opportunities that cross-border commerce presents for local merchants," Fu said.
The report also highlighted evolving consumer behaviour, with digital payment experiences valued more highly and BNPL gaining traction. PayPal's BNPL volume climbed 26 per cent in the second quarter of 2026, with the US and Australia as mature markets and adoption picking up in Europe and Japan. The global BNPL market is forecast to grow 21 to 23 per cent over the next decade, according to Global Market Insights.
A separate PayPal survey showed that 63 to 70 per cent of consumers planned to keep or raise their festive spending, while 18 to 27 per cent would start shopping early. Fu suggested merchants could adjust resource allocation according to their products and different markets, and prepare earlier for the year-end holiday shopping season, including rolling out early-bird offers or limited coupons sooner.

中國國民黨台中市長參選人江啟臣（後中）辦多場問政說明會，懇請民眾當他分身與靠山。（江啟臣競選總部提供）中央社記者趙麗妍傳真 115年11月10日
（中央社記者趙麗妍台中10日電）中國國民黨台中市長參選人江啟臣懇請民眾當分身與靠山，而民主進步黨台中市長參選人何欣純今天說，持續規劃民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋合體活動，也再邀前總統蔡英文訪台中。
何欣純表示，依既定計畫且與沈伯洋競選總部保持聯繫、討論細節，活動方式確定後第一時間公布；選前黃金週末與選前之夜都有規劃活動，除車隊掃街所有行政區，將再邀蔡英文到台中，總統賴清德與副總統蕭美琴也都將出席造勢活動。
江啟臣9日晚間連趕北屯區、南區與西屯區多場問政說明會，國民黨籍立法委員王鴻薇南下站台助講，國民黨籍立委黃健豪、廖偉翔及多名台中市議員相挺，展現團結氣勢。
江啟臣表示，選戰最後關頭，跑行程需要很多分身，鄉親是他最有力分身與靠山，而議會戰友是推動市政不可或缺的力量，懇請鄉親支持，才能承接台中市長盧秀燕政績，幸福感再升級。
此外，何欣純到海線車掃，接受媒體聯訪表示，海線是第2故鄉，希望讓鄉親了解她的海線政見，讓區域均衡發展。她會持續一步一腳印拉近與選民距離，爭取支持與認同。（編輯：李明宗）1151110
選戰倒數，民主進步黨台中市長參選人何欣純（中）到台中海線路口拜票，希望民眾看到何欣純、了解海線政見，爭取支持與認同。（何欣純競選總部提供）中央社記者趙麗妍傳真 115年11月10日

台馬經貿會議傳遭擱置 大馬業界：獲知延後非取消 | 綜合 | 要聞 | 聯合新聞網
Your browser does not support HTML5 Audio! 😢
原訂10月下旬舉行的第11屆台馬經濟合作委員會（MTECC）會議未如期召開，馬來西亞製造業聯合總會總會長李祖國今天表示，他獲知的訊息是會議延後，而非取消；台灣是大馬重要經貿夥伴，雙方仍會維持溝通管道，目前企業生意與投資活動一切如常。
日經亞洲日前引述馬來西亞政府消息人士報導，台灣擱置原定10月下旬與大馬舉行的擴大雙邊貿易會談，並指首相安華（Anwar Ibrahim）8月涉台言論引發的雙邊關係緊張，可能影響未來台灣半導體業者赴大馬投資。
李祖國（Jacob Lee）今天接受中央社記者訪問指出，台馬經濟合作委員會架構下有數個小組須召開會議，其中一個小組尚未開會，今年的委員會會議也隨之延後。
他說：「會議沒有取消，而是延後，這是我所得到的訊息。」
李祖國表示，第7屆MTECC企業諮詢小組（BAG）聯席會議已於今年9月22日舉行，屬於企業諮詢層級，將產業界建議提交台馬經濟合作委員會。
根據大馬投資、貿易及工業部（MITI）資料，MTECC下設貿易、投資及中小企業發展3個工作小組，企業諮詢小組則是產業界提供建議的平台。
他認為，台灣是馬來西亞重要的經貿夥伴，台商在大馬投資規模龐大，雙方一定會維持溝通管道，會議應不至於取消。他相信，待尚未召開的小組會議完成後，委員會會議將再舉行。
他說，對企業界而言，目前仍是「一切照常」，生意與投資活動如常進行。至於檯面下是否存在「暗潮」，則非企業界所能掌握。
駐台北馬來西亞友誼及貿易中心代表黃奕瑞10月上旬曾在一場慶祝酒會中，祝願即將赴馬來西亞參加第11屆台馬經濟合作委員會及投資工作小組會議的台灣代表團，進行建設性交流，取得豐碩成果。
不過，會議最終未如期舉行，也引發對大馬外交立場及台馬經貿關係後續發展的討論。熟悉台北外交事務的消息人士透露，無論會議以技術性問題為由取消、擱置或延後舉行，都是針對安華涉台言論採取的反制措施，後續仍須觀察大馬的回應與態度。
至於會議未如期舉行原因及後續安排，駐馬代表處與大馬投資、貿易及工業部未公開說明。
安華8月接受半島電視台（Al Jazeera）專訪談及台灣議題，相關言論引發中華民國外交部嚴厲譴責。外交部重申，中華民國台灣與中華人民共和國互不隸屬，並批評相關言論危害區域和平穩定、傷害台馬政治互信。
馬來西亞拉曼大學（UTAR）經濟學教授黃錦榮（Chin-Yoong Wong）受訪指出，「不結盟」本來就是大馬的外交立場。即便不結盟空間在大國科技競爭下不斷萎縮，不結盟立場正是大馬能夠同時吸引兩方投資，各取所需的關鍵所在。安華過去的種種外交行為和言論，包括針對台灣地位的論斷，也違背了大馬外交的中立性。
他認為，就實際經濟合作和發展而言，大馬至今仍保持一貫多向發展。美國和中國分別仍是大馬進出口最為依賴的國家。對美出口的依賴就以半導體相關產業為最重，而台灣正是大馬對美半導體雙向貿易中重要的一環，所以台灣才成為大馬前5大貿易夥伴。
黃錦榮說，台灣的反應是預期中的外交回應，但他不認為馬台經貿往來，尤其是半導體產業，會因此而出現巨大轉折，畢竟國際價值鏈底下維繫的經貿關係有極強的穩定性。
他說，他不覺得安華會因此改變外交措辭，但會推動高階官員與企業界私下接觸，以緩和局面。
另外，新加坡國立大學政治學系副教授莊嘉穎（JaIan Chong）也指出，包括馬來西亞在內，許多東南亞國家認為，可以毫無成本地消費台灣及其他議題，透過不斷「對沖」，避免承受壓力與代價。
他表示，過去國際競爭較不激烈，部分第三方可以較少顧忌地「見人說人話，見鬼說鬼話」，最終仍能左右逢源。但隨著各國競爭加劇，這種彈性空間持續縮小，過去被視為理所當然的做法，如今更容易引發反彈。
莊嘉穎認為，這不只是選不選邊的問題。維持折衷立場的前提，是其他各方願意接受，甚至鼓勵這類做法。然而，當前國際環境已經改變，反覆搖擺不僅可能造成信任流失，也可能面臨制裁。能採取制裁措施的不只有大國，具備能力的中小型國家，必要時也會反制；若不作出回應，對方行為可能更加不受約束。
馬來西亞台灣商會聯合總會8月20日曾發表聲明，反對以「內政」或「統一」之名合理化武力改變台海現狀，若台灣科技產業投資者對大馬面對台海危機時的態度產生疑慮，可能增加未來投資布局的顧慮。
台馬近年經貿往來持續成長，今年1月至8月雙邊貿易額成長約40%，馬來西亞對台灣出口增加75.5%。台灣是馬來西亞第4大貿易夥伴，也是第3大進口來源。
駐馬代表處持續推動升級台馬雙邊投資協定（BIA），盼完善投資保障，深化雙方產業與供應鏈合作。

title: Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy further complicates Nvidia’s China problem
zh_title: 黄仁勋与中国间谍的恋情使英伟达的中国问题进一步复杂化
summary: 黄仁勋与被指控的中国间谍的恋情使英伟达中国问题变得更加复杂 对黄仁勋的指控让人们重新关注这位英伟达首席执行官对美国对华芯片销售政策的潜在影响力。立法者正在寻求调查英伟达与中国的关系。 Moor Insights & Strategy 首席执行官帕特里克·穆尔黑德 (Patrick Moorhead) 表示：“35 年来，我还没有见过一位芯片首席执行官对出口政策具有如此大的直接影响力。”关注您最喜爱的股票 创建免费账户 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 周日承认与芯片制造商涉嫌中国间谍的黄仁勋 (Alice Huang) 有婚外情
content:
黄与涉嫌中国间谍的恋情使英伟达中国问题复杂化
针对黄仁勋的指控让人们重新关注这位英伟达首席执行官对美国对华芯片销售政策的潜在影响力。
立法者正在寻求调查英伟达与中国的关系。
Moor Insights & Strategy 首席执行官帕特里克·穆尔黑德 (Patrick Moorhead) 表示：“35 年来，我还没有见过一位芯片首席执行官对出口政策具有如此大的直接影响力。”
关注您最喜欢的股票创建免费帐户
继英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋周日承认与所谓的中国间谍黄爱丽有婚外情后，这家芯片制造商与中国的关系即将在华盛顿特区受到严格审查。
自 2022 年 10 月拜登政府宣布全面控制以限制中国获得美国先进芯片的能力以来，英伟达在全球第二大经济体的业务不断萎缩。在特朗普政府实施更严格的规则几个月后，黄在 2025 年 10 月表示，“我们 100% 脱离中国。”
最近针对黄仁勋的指控虽然让这家芯片制造商陷入了危机，但也引起了人们对这位英伟达首席执行官对美国对中国芯片销售政策的潜在影响的关注，该公司在中国的业务曾经蓬勃发展。特别令人感兴趣的是，受限制的 Nvidia 芯片是否已通过新加坡的 Megaspeed（该公司与 Alice Huang 有联系）等客户到达中国公司。
据了解特朗普政府今年春天一份备忘录中流传的情报的人士透露，《纽约时报》首先报道称，这名中国女商人是中国国家安全部的间谍。中国称这一指控是诽谤。
黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统第二届执政期间一直与他保持密切联系，帮助白宫就人工智能安全法规提供建议，同时还推动放宽对向中国出售人工智能芯片的限制。去年 12 月，特朗普表示，只要美国的销售额减少 25%，Nvidia 将被允许向中国出口 H200 芯片。今年三月，黄告诉记者，英伟达“已经收到采购订单，我们正在重启生产”。

英伟达首席执行官的动荡为新获得权力的民主党寻求监督提供了新的弹药
由于新云信用风险盖过了增长，CoreWeave 面临“末日周期”的说法
亚马逊的 Astro 家庭机器人拥有粉丝，但看起来注定会被扔进“垃圾堆”。为什么它会再次尝试
据《泰晤士报》报道，在特朗普听取了有关情报问题的简报后，黄仁勋是在最后一刻加入了与特朗普一起访问中国的科技高管名单。
Moor Insights & Strategy 首席执行官帕特里克·穆尔黑德 (Patrick Moorhead) 在一封电子邮件中表示：“35 年来，我还没有见过一位芯片首席执行官对出口政策具有如此大的直接影响力。”
自上周中期选举民主党在全国范围内取得压倒性胜利以来，华盛顿的情绪发生了变化。众议院的三个委员会已要求与 Nvidia 首席执行官就他与 Megaspeed 的关系进行闭门简报。
即将在参众两院掌权的民主党议员公开表示，国会将进行调查并寻求答案。特朗普周一表示，他对这些指控感到“惊讶”，黄告诉他，他“不知道她是间谍”。特朗普表示，联邦调查局正在调查这个问题

【原文 English Original】
Huang affair with alleged Chinese spy complicates Nvidia China problem
The allegations against Jensen Huang have brought new attention to the Nvidia CEO's potential influence over U.S. policy on chip sales to China.
Lawmakers are looking to investigate Nvidia's China ties.
"In 35 years, I haven't seen a chip CEO with this much direct influence on export policy," said Patrick Moorhead, CEO at Moor Insights & Strategy.
Follow your favorite stocksCREATE FREE ACCOUNT
Following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's admission on Sunday to an extramarital affair with alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, the chipmaker's relationship to China is about to come under intense scrutiny in Washington, D.C.
Since October 2022, when the Biden administration announced sweeping controls to limit China's ability to obtain advanced U.S. chips, Nvidia has seen its business diminish in the world's second-largest economy. Months after an even stricter set of rules was implemented by the Trump administration, Huang said in October 2025, "We are 100% out of China."
The recent allegations against Huang, while throwing the chipmaker into crisis, have also brought attention to the Nvidia CEO's potential influence over U.S. policy on chip sales to China, where its business once flourished. Of particular interest is whether restricted Nvidia chips have reached Chinese companies through customers like Singapore-based Megaspeed, the company linked to Alice Huang.
The New York Times first reported that the Chinese businesswoman was a spy for China's Ministry of State Security, according to people briefed on the intelligence circulated in a memo among the Trump administration in the spring. China has called the allegation a smear.
Jensen Huang has been closely aligned with President Donald Trump during his second administration, helping advise the White House on artificial intelligence safety regulations, while also pushing for looser restrictions on selling AI chips to China. In December, Trump said Nvidia would be allowed to ship its H200 chips to China, provided the U.S. got a 25% cut of sales. In March, Huang told reporters that Nvidia had "received purchase orders, and we're in the process of restarting our manufacturing."
Anthropic IPO meets AI backlash after midterms show stinging rebuke of data centers
Nvidia’s CEO turmoil gives newly empowered Democrats fresh ammunition in pursuit of oversight
CoreWeave confronts 'doom cycle' narrative as neocloud credit risk overshadows growth
Amazon’s Astro home robot has fans but looks destined for the ‘trash heap.’ Why it’s trying again
Huang was a last-minute addition to the roster of tech executives who joined Trump on a trip to China in May, after the president was briefed on intelligence concerns, according to the Times.
"In 35 years, I haven't seen a chip CEO with this much direct influence on export policy," said Patrick Moorhead, CEO at Moor Insights & Strategy, in an email.
Since last week's midterm elections that included sweeping victories across the country for Democrats, the mood in Washington has changed. Three House committees have requested closed-door briefings with the Nvidia CEO about his relationship with Megaspeed.
Democratic lawmakers, who are about to take power in the House and Senate, have said publicly that Congress will investigate and seek answers. Trump said Monday that he was "amazed" by the allegations and that Huang told him he "had no idea that she was a spy." The FBI is now looking into the issue, Trump said at a White House briefing.
It's been a long four years for Nvidia in China.
Before the initial export controls in 2022, China made up nearly a quarter of Nvidia's revenue. Nvidia responded to the Biden-era restrictions by redesigning some of its products to comply with the new regulations.
How Nvidia's Huang influenced Pres. Trump's China policy
"It was a turbulent month or so as the company went upside down to re-engineer" the products, Huang told CNBC in a 2023 interview. Still, he was confident the company could continue selling chips to China. "I think we're going to be just fine in the ability to serve the customers there," he said.
After the Biden administration tightened export restrictions again, Nvidia redesigned another AI graphics processing unit for China, the H20. Following reports that Chinese model developer DeepSeek was using restricted Nvidia chips, the Trump administration limited sales of H20. Nvidia revealed it would incur $5.5 billion in costs related to canceled orders for the redesigned chip.
However, despite saying in its forecasts that "we're assuming 0% for China," the company maintained business in the region. In the last fiscal year, Nvidia reported that about 9% of its revenue came from China, including Hong Kong, although that includes revenue from segments outside of restricted data center chips, such as gaming, auto and industrial. Nvidia's China revenue was 8% in the most recent quarter.
A report in May from short seller Culper Research alleged Nvidia's China exposure was much higher. The firm said that more than 20% of Nvidia's fiscal 2026 compute revenue was driven by China, supported by "illegal GPU diversion and Southeast Asian intermediaries," according to the report.
A loophole allows Chinese companies to rent Nvidia GPUs in data centers, even when they're restricted from buying them outright. For example, a Chinese company could lease Nvidia computing power in Europe by renting server capacity from a non-Chinese neocloud or data center operator that's exempt from export controls.
Nvidia didn't respond to a request for comment for this story.
US President Donald Trump speaks to NVIDIA President and CEO Jensen Huang, as US House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-LA) looks on, at the White House driveway following a luncheon for tech leaders in the East Room, in Washington, D.C., US, Sept. 29, 2026.
Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer based in Singapore, has been accused of diverting its own supply of Nvidia's restricted AI chips to Chinese companies. Megaspeed denies wrongdoing and said inspections found no evidence of violations.
In 2025, Nvidia changed the way it reported regional sales to categorize by customer headquarters, instead of by where the products were billed. Nvidia also stopped reporting Singapore sales during the same period.
"Whether Blackwell chips reached China is a Megaspeed question that predates this week," said Moorhead, pointing to Bloomberg reporting in December 2025 that found Megaspeed had imported 50,000 more Nvidia chips than Nvidia tallied in its data centers.
In 2025, a House Select Committee opened an investigation into whether China's DeepSeek operates on Nvidia's chips.
A separate investigation by the U.S. Commerce Department was centered on Megaspeed. That probe was abruptly transferred to the Justice Department, the Times reported, following an email from Nvidia's general counsel to the Commerce Department seeking information about the investigation.
The restrictions aren't just coming from the U.S. China has continued to limit the amount of Nvidia chips it will allow into the country, keeping Nvidia's China sales numbers down. The U.S. has licensed H200 sales to Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and other Chinese companies, but Beijing hasn't approved large-scale imports, Moorhead told CNBC. Nvidia said H200 shipments to China made up less than 1% of data center revenue for the quarter that ended in July.
Moorhead expects more export control legislation to pass as a result of the latest turmoil. Proposals could allow Congress oversight of chip export licenses or require chipmakers to install security mechanisms to track the location of chips to determine if they've found their way to China.
"Every China license now gets read through this story," Moorhead said. "Jensen has been Nvidia's lead voice on China, and that voice is weaker."
— CNBC's Kif Leswing and Seema Mody contributed reporting to this report.
Correction: Three House committees have requested closed-door briefings with the Nvidia CEO about his relationship with Megaspeed. An earlier version misstated the time element.

content:
香港与深圳在香园围口岸举行APEC联合安全演习 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港与深圳在香园围口岸举行APEC联合安全演习
香港入境事务处与深圳边检机关11月10日在香园围口岸进行联合应急演练，为APEC安保做好准备。此次演练旨在提高一线人员安全意识和应急处置能力
香港入境处表示，周二（11月10日）与深圳边检总站在香园围检查站进行联合应急演习，为即将举行的APEC会议执行安保任务。此次演练名为“APEC安全粤港口岸联合应急演练”，重点强化一线人员边检安全意识，提高应对突发事件的能力。
入境事务处处长郭俊辉率领稽查人员到场，深圳边检总站站长徐晓伟等人员前往现场督导演习。该部门表示，演练中双方密切配合，全面加强紧急情况下的沟通协调和相互理解。
此次演习是为即将召开的APEC会议做准备，旨在保护公共安全、维护国家安全。移民部门表示，致力于保障公民生命财产安全，坚定维护国家安全。

Hong Kong and Shenzhen hold joint APEC security drill at Heung Yuen Wai checkpoint | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong and Shenzhen hold joint APEC security drill at Heung Yuen Wai checkpoint
Hong Kong's Immigration Department and Shenzhen's border inspection authorities conducted a joint emergency response drill at the Heung Yuen Wai checkpoint on 10 November to prepare for APEC security. The exercise aimed to improve frontline personnel's security awareness and emergency response capab
Hong Kong's Immigration Department said it conducted a joint emergency response drill with the Shenzhen Border Inspection General Station at the Heung Yuen Wai checkpoint on Tuesday (10 November) to implement security tasks for the upcoming APEC meetings. The drill, called the “APEC Security Guangdong-Hong Kong Port Joint Emergency Response Exercise”, focused on strengthening border inspection security awareness among frontline personnel and improving their ability to respond to emergencies.
Immigration Department Director Mr. Kwok Chun-fai led inspection staff to the scene, alongside Shenzhen Border Inspection General Station Director Mr. Xu Xiaowei and other officials, to oversee the exercise. The department said the two sides cooperated closely during the drill, comprehensively strengthening communication, coordination and mutual understanding in emergency situations.
The exercise was designed to prepare for the forthcoming APEC conference, with the aim of protecting public safety and safeguarding national security. The Immigration Department said it was committed to ensuring the safety of citizens' lives and property, and to firmly upholding national security.

title: 'Markets bottom on bad news' maxim rings true as chip stocks rally amid Nvidia scandal
zh_title: 随着芯片股因英伟达丑闻而上涨，“市场因坏消息而触底”这句格言是正确的
summary: 尽管英伟达丑闻，芯片股仍在上涨，周一科技股的上涨可能是牛市卷土重来的开始，但仍有很多事情需要证明。 MLB 所有球场中只有大约 7% 位于好球区的正中心。投资者可以从中学到什么。特斯拉、Coinbase 过去五年的表现不佳提醒我们，市场上最有趣的领域不会永远保持这种状态。关注您最喜欢的股票 创建免费帐户 首先将 Mike Santoli 的市场备忘录放入您的收件箱。 “市场因坏消息而触底”是听起来很聪明的经验法则之一，但事实证明，这种法则经常是正确的。
content:
尽管英伟达丑闻，芯片股仍上涨
周一科技股的上涨可能是牛市卷土重来的开始，但仍有很多事情需要证明。
MLB 所有球场中只有大约 7% 位于好球区的正中心。投资者可以从中学到什么。
特斯拉、Coinbase 过去五年的表现不佳提醒我们，市场上最有趣的领域不会永远保持这种状态。

“市场因坏消息而触底”是听起来很聪明的经验法则之一，事实证明它是正确的，足以成为华尔街的陈词滥调。
人工智能股票长达数周的残酷惩罚是否在上周达到顶峰，并在一系列不利头条新闻后于周一逆转走高？过去一周，美国选民强烈反对在全国大部分地区建设数据中心，就在性丑闻和间谍丑闻袭击整个人工智能经济的独角兽——英伟达 (Nvidia) 的黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 之前，Anthropic 降低了其 IPO 目标估值。
周一纳斯达克 100 指数上涨 3.4%，费城半导体指数 (SOX) 下跌 7%，尽管英伟达下跌 4.3%，但市场在遭遇严重挫折后从不断增加的坏消息中得到暗示，从而实现大幅反弹的故事目前来看还算不错。
纯粹基于战术证据，科技硬件综合体进入本周后就已经被淘汰并准备反弹。许多交易柜台报告称，在上周四的风险清理行动中，机构对该集团的净抛售强度是历史罕见的。纳斯达克 100 指数在多项指标上都处于超卖状态，与 3 月 30 日伊朗抛售低点时一样。 CBOE 标准普尔 500 波动率指数出现了通常与暴风雨过去相关的大幅飙升，飙升至 28，然后回落到 20 以下。
Baird Strategas 期权策略师 Laurent Laskowski 表示，近期纳斯达克指数的暴跌和避险情绪的上升，“有很多投降的因素”：“创纪录的期权活动，波动性、偏差和相关性急剧上升，VIX 曲线倒挂，以及强制清算……因此，市场的[下行]左尾正在缩小，而[上行]右尾正在肥大。”
几位技术分析专家（包括宏观风险顾问公司的约翰·科洛沃斯（John Kolovos），他的著作在下面引用）认为，市场还没有完全提供一个“大力度的策略”来积极买入回调。也许是这样。但 FanGraphs 计算得出，在美国职业棒球大联盟中，只有大约 7% 的球场位于好球区的正中心。虽然这些宽大的球场导致了大约 23% 的全垒打，但飞过墙的其他四分之三的球在区域边缘的设置不太完美。
由于这些原因以及估值已经变得不那么苛刻的事实，我不会太强烈地反对这种以科技为中心的反弹持续一段时间。上周，我指出大型科技公司尚未对适度压力的情况做出反应，但已经越来越接近，“基于人工智能故事的牛市几乎肯定需要人工智能故事重回正轨才能继续前进。等权重标准普尔 500 指数跑赢市值加权版本的长期时期通常被称为熊市。”周一的小幅上涨可能只是一个开始，但还有很多事情需要证明。
但这个由人工智能驱动的市场部分最近表明自己不太值得投资

"Markets bottom on bad news," is one of those smart-sounding rules of thumb that proves true just often enough to remain a Wall Street cliché in good standing.
Did the brutal weeks-long punishment of AI stocks culminate last week and reverse higher Monday after a pileup of adverse headlines? In the past week, American voters resoundingly opposed data-center construction across much of the country and Anthropic lowered its target IPO valuation just before a sex-and-espionage scandal struck the one-man embodiment of the entire AI economy, Nvidia's Jensen Huang.
The story of a market taking a cue from a crescendo of bad news after a nasty setback to stage a resounding bounce holds together well enough for now, after Monday's 3.4% jump in the Nasdaq-100 and 7% rip in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX), even as Nvidia shed 4.3%.
Based purely on the tactical evidence, the tech-hardware complex came into the week pretty well washed out and primed to bounce. Numerous trading desks reported historically rare intensity of net selling in the group by institutions into last Thursday's risk purge. The Nasdaq-100 was as oversold on several metrics as it had been at the March 30 Iran-selloff low. The CBOE S&P 500 Volatility Index has put in a nice spike of the sort usually associated with a passing storm, shooting up to 28 and then receding below 20.
The recent dump in the Nasdaq and uptick in risk aversion, "had many elements of capitulation," says Laurent Laskowski, options strategist at Baird Strategas: "record options activity, a sharp spike in volatility, skew and correlations, an inverted VIX curve, and forced liquidations…The setup, therefore, is one where the market is seeing the [downside] left tail narrowing while the [upside] right tail is fattening."
Several technical-analysis gurus (including Macro Risk Advisors' John Kolovos, whose work is cited below) argue the market hasn't quite served up a "fat pitch" to buy the pullback aggressively. Maybe so. But FanGraphs calculates that in Major League Baseball only about 7% of all pitches are in the very center of the strike zone. While those fat pitches result in some 23% of all home runs hit, the other three-quarters of balls that fly over the wall come with less-perfect setups around the edges of the zone.
I wouldn't argue too strenuously against this tech-centered rally carrying on for a bit, for these reasons as well as the fact that valuations have become far less demanding. Last week, I noted Big Tech had not to that point responded to moderately stressed conditions but was getting closer, and "the bull market built on the AI story will almost surely need the AI story to get back on track to keep advancing. A prolonged period when the equal-weight S&P 500 outperforms the market-cap-weighted version is otherwise known – usually – as a bear market." Monday's blip higher could be a start, with plenty still to prove.
But this AI-driven part of the market has lately shown itself less worthy of investor trust, leaving enough hints of structural damage to the bull case that faith can't be restored right away.
In a late-June column, I asked, "Was May 14 a consequential moment for this market, at least tactically?" That date, nearly six months ago, was when the S&P 500 spurted higher to reach the 7500 level for the first time; the index has never reached escape velocity since and in fact crossed above 7500 again just yesterday.
May 14 was when highly touted AI-chip upstart Cerebras came public and its shares more than doubled to a high of $386, as President Trump and China's leader were reported to have made progress on ending the Iran war. Since then, Cerebras has collapsed to $97, the semiconductor group is off 17% and the Iran conflict continues.
A month later the SpaceX IPO was another apparent culmination of New Era tech enthusiasm; it might not have been an important peak in AI excitement, but if it were the market action since would possibly resemble what we've seen since.
Perhaps a half-year reckoning period during which the market has refused to pay up for 30% annual earnings growth for two straight quarters is enough to build a new base constructed on more modest expectations. I've been focused on late-cycle tremors unsettling markets in the form of peak earnings growth, peak capex, peak index concentration, a tighter Federal Reserve and credit flareups. This all explains the market's multi-month stall, and they remain.
But it's important to remain open to the chance that these could end up amounting to mere mid-cycle turbulence, as Morgan Stanley chief investment officer Mike Wilson has been arguing.
First, though, the tape will need to show more progress than a nice, broad single-day comeback. Another rule of thumb holds that a rebound rally needs at least to carry above the 20-day moving average to prove that it's not merely a reflexive dead-cat bounce. This would require a 1.3% gain from Monday's close for the S&P 500, 3.7% for the Nasdaq-100 and 9% for the SOX.
Without pretending any clear sense of what the various Nvidia investigations will mean for its China sales, leadership or long-term earnings power, we can say for sure that the scandal arrived at a fairly opportune time for the market.
Valuations have been pounded to multi-year lows on persistent worry that current profits are unsustainable and the group remains vulnerable to any slowdown in data-center builds. This allowed, for a day, every other semiconductor stock to whistle higher as Nvidia lost some $200 billion in market cap on a blistering $80 billion in dollar-volume traded in the stock.
The S&P 500 as a whole, of course, has grown optically cheaper, too, with semis bolstering the projected earnings and investors declining to give the group credit for their sustainability.
The issue remains that less of those earnings are set to manifest as free cash flow as the hyperscalers spend manically. As this chart comparing the valuation gauges shows, the market looks a good deal less cheap on free cash flow than earnings.
A proper bull case for the market from here might be that the likes of Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Microsoft will resume harvesting free cash flow, on which investors might place a higher multiple than they're willing to bestow on those hot but hard-to-trust chip makers. Not yet a provable argument.
John Kolovos of Macro Risk Advisors on the latest reading: "While sentiment is dire, our concern is that technology is in a 'bad oversold' condition, where seductive bounces fail to produce lasting lows. Instead, the broader equity market may need to follow technology lower, with a more widespread capitulation ultimately needed to wash out weak hands and establish a durable bottom."
-This enjoyable and illuminating review in the New Yorker of James Gleick's "The Telephone: A New History" inevitably summons parallels between the advent of telecommunications and the current AI buildout. Huge privately financed infrastructure buildout, destabilizing new habits of interaction with technology and constant calls for government regulation in exchange for near-monopoly power. The book cites an AT&T ad from 1909 calling telephones "tools of 'civilization . . . one of the most powerful influences for broadening human intelligence.'"
-Moody's Analytics economist Mark Zandi has a helpful thread suggesting AI is so far adding more jobs than it's costing the U.S. economy. The main reasons are sobering though, with most gains coming from data-center construction and wealth creation for those who own AI-dependent stocks. Cold comfort for information-economy job seekers.
-Last week's election triggering a Democratic takeover of Congress brought comparisons to the 1994 "Contract with America" Republican sweep for its magnitude and message. That election, in Bill Clinton's first term, highlighted deep societal fissures and economic instability.
With hindsight, many view the '90s as a placid era of consensus and prosperity, but between the '94 backlash election, constant corporate downsizing, scare-mongering over Federal debt levels, the 1995 Oklahoma City bombing and discomfort with technological change, that decade hit many of today's narrative beats. This Chicago Fed paper, "The decline of job security in the 1990s: Displacement, anxiety, and their effect on wage growth" can fill in some blanks for those not around for it.
Happy fifth anniversary to the peak of a pandemic speculative-tech bull market. Not quite two months before the S&P 500 hit a top in January 2022 as the Fed prepared to choke off surging inflation, perhaps by causing a recession, several key retail-trader-driven subsectors peaked.
The third week of November 2021 was the relative-performance peak in Tesla, as well as the absolute top in Coinbase and the Wisdom Tree Cloud Computing ETF (WCLD).
The five-year lookback period is one of the few time spans shy of 25 years over which the Nasdaq Composite has not outperformed the S&P 500. It's a plus that the broad market can withstand such internal speculative blowoffs, though also a good reminder that the most fun pockets of the market don't stay that way forever.
